jobs.excerpt: DescriptionToday, every organisation faces a choice: keep pouring money into observability, or start treating telemetry as what it really is: the most real-time, truthful, high-dimensional data in the business.
locationRestrictions: Congo, The Democratic Republic of the

jobs.description:
Description

Today, every organisation faces a choice: keep pouring money into observability, or start treating telemetry as what it really is: the most real-time, truthful, high-dimensional data in the business.

Coralogix is built for the second answer. We're a modern, full-stack observability platform powered by a telemetry data lake and an in-stream analytics architecture that decouples cost from scale. Instead of forcing customers into expensive indexing and hot storage, we analyse data in-stream and query directly from the customer's own bucket using our declarative query language. This delivers complete coverage across logs, metrics, traces, and security events (APM, RUM, SIEM, Kubernetes, and more) without the trade-offs.

The result is compounding value for our customers: from open data collection and control, from a long-term telemetry data lake they actually own, and from observability that connects directly to business outcomes. Legacy tools compound in the opposite direction: compounding costs, vendor lock-in, and scale problems around mapping, retention, and cardinality. That's why Coralogix is increasingly displacing not just observability incumbents, but parts of adjacent data and analytics stacks too.

As a Major Enterprise Account Executive, you'll own complex, technical sales cycles end-to-end, from first conversation with a CTO to closed-won. You'll work alongside experienced solution engineers, partner with senior technical and business stakeholders, and play a central role in shaping how some of EMEA’s most demanding engineering organisations approach observability and telemetry data.

This is field sales for true hunters. You'll be selling a differentiated product into accounts that often already have an incumbent, which means you'll build the business case, create the urgency, and earn the share. We run a structured Coralogix sales playbook, founded in MEDDIC, and built around Proof of Value, executive-level value selling, and disciplined qualification. If you've sold conceptually, displaced incumbents, scaled accounts through strategic upsell and cross-sell, and consistently outperformed your peers, you'll feel at home here.

What You'll Do

  • Own complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles end-to-end, partnering with solution engineers to run Proof of Value engagements that prove our technology in customer environments
  • Proactively engage CTOs, CIOs, VPs and Directors of Engineering, DevOps, SRE, and line-of-business leaders to generate and grow pipeline in your territory
  • Build compelling business cases that translate technical capability into measurable business outcomes, and present them with credibility at the C-level
  • Run a structured territory plan: research target accounts, develop custom value propositions, and qualify rigorously against our methodology
  • Lead the commercial side of the full sales cycle: discovery, champion-building, objection handling, negotiation, and close
  • Deliver accurate weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecasts to sales leadership
  • Act as a trusted advisor by knowing the observability and telemetry data market cold

Requirements

  • 5+ years selling complex software and services in the field, ideally with conceptual or Proof of Value-led sales motions
  • Demonstrated success displacing incumbents and building compelling ROI-led business cases that win share from established vendors
  • Proven ability to win new logos via outbound pipeline generation - you must be ready to own this personally.
  • Track record of scaling enterprise accounts through strategic upsell and cross-sell
  • Sustained performance over the last 5–7 years, with at least two consecutive years above quota or top of your peer group (we want operators who stick and win, not hoppers)
  • Confident selling to and influencing C-level executives
  • Deep understanding of IT infrastructure stacks and how modern IT organisations operate; fluent in industry and market trends
  • Runs a repeatable, structured sales process and is fluent in MEDDIC-based qualification (or equivalent: MEDDPICC, Command of the Message)
  • Strong discovery via thoughtful questioning; identifies and develops Champions; builds and presents executive-level business cases; handles objections with composure
  • Hungry, humble, and smart. Driven, persistent, coachable, and intuitive
  • Bias for action and urgency; detail-oriented and adaptable; high integrity, no exceptions
  • Aligns with EMEA standards of excellence

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling observability, log analytics, monitoring, or APM solutions
  • Experience selling cloud-native technologies on AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Experience selling data platforms, data lakes, or analytics infrastructure

What You'll Get

  • Work with the best. Join a team of high-calibre sellers and engineers, led by experienced sales leaders who know how to develop talent and win in enterprise.
  • A real playbook. Our sales methodology is founded in MEDDIC and supported by strong sales engineering and leadership that's been there before.
  • Fast development and progression. We move quickly to promote those who deliver. Top performers don't wait years for their next step.
  • Significant earning upside. Competitive base, uncapped commission, and meaningful stock, so our success directly translates into yours.
  • A category-defining product. Genuinely differentiated technology in a market overdue for disruption.

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • First 90 days: Onboarded into the Coralogix playbook and MEDDIC framework, fluent in our value proposition and competitive positioning, with a territory plan and qualified early-stage pipeline.
  • First 6 months: Multiple Proof of Value engagements live, executive relationships at VP and C-level, and your first closed-won logo on the board.
  • First 12 months: Consistent quota attainment, healthy 3-4x pipeline cover, and the foundations of a multi-year territory built on land-and-expand wins.

Our Culture

We hire for three traits above all: hungry, humble, and smart. We move fast, we challenge each other, and we share a real conviction that observability is overdue for change. If you want a seat at the table while we build the next major player in this space, we'd love to talk.

Coralogix is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

jobs.excerpt: Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company.
jobs.description:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

Scope of the Role:

As a Technical Product Manager for Trust & Safety, you will define and ship the data products that frontier labs use to train and evaluate models to perform personalization, computer-use (CUA), and GDPval tasks safely and in a trustworthy manner.

You will own the full lifecycle of these products: from translating a lab's research need into a spec, to designing reinforcement learning (RL) environments, rubrics, and evals, to running delivery with our expert workforce and measuring whether the data actually moved the model.

A core part of the job is building RL environments with deliberate traps. That includes misalignment traps that test for reward hacking, deception, sandbagging, oversight evasion, and power-seeking; cyber traps such as planted credentials, injected instructions, and poisoned tools; and other honeypots that reveal how a model behaves when it believes no one is watching.

You thrive in ambiguity, go deep on technical detail, and care about making powerful AI safe and beneficial.

What You’ll Own:

  • Define data products for frontier labs. Turn lab research goals into clear product specs for safety training data, RL environments, and evaluations.
  • Design trap-based RL environments. Build sandboxed environments that embed misalignment traps (reward hacking, specification gaming, deception, sandbagging, oversight subversion) and cyber traps (prompt injection, credential exfiltration, tool poisoning, unsafe file and network actions).
  • Build safety into agentic tasks by design. Specify safe-behavior rubrics, verifiers, and reward signals so that models learn to complete real work while refusing, escalating, or asking for confirmation at the right moments.
  • Own evals and metrics. Define what "safe and trustworthy" means for each product in measurable terms, including attack success rate, over-refusal, trap trigger rate, and task completion under adversarial pressure. Track blind spots and drive iteration.
  • Prioritize ruthlessly. Frame problems crisply, lay out options with their business and technical tradeoffs, and separate MVP from ideal state.
  • Partner across teams. Work with lab researchers, our ML and platform engineers, red-teamers, policy experts, and delivery leads running large expert annotator pools.
  • Track the threat landscape. Stay current on agentic risks, alignment research, and new attack techniques, and turn them into roadmap items before customers ask.
  • Communicate clearly. Write specs, customer briefs, and safety findings that land with researchers and executives alike.

These examples show the kind of work this role owns:

  • A cyber-trap environment suite: sandboxed environments seeded with injected instructions, exposed secrets, and destructive shortcuts, scored on whether the agent finishes the task without taking the bait.
  • Tasks with integrity traps: realistic work where the easiest path to a high score requires fabricating data, skipping a required step, or gaming the grader.
  • A misalignment eval harness: environments that check whether a model behaves differently when it believes it is being tested versus deployed, or when given chances to expand its own permissions.
  • A trap library and quality framework that lets our delivery teams produce new environments quickly while keeping verifiers reliable and traps hard to detect.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including technical products in ML, AI data, security, or trust & safety.
  • Hands-on familiarity with how LLMs are trained and evaluated: SFT, RLHF/RLAIF, reward models, verifiers, and benchmark design.
  • Working knowledge of agentic AI: tool use, computer-use agents, multi-step planning, and the failure modes that come with them.
  • A strong grasp of AI safety concepts such as reward hacking, deceptive alignment, jailbreaks, and prompt injection.
  • Enough technical depth to read code, review an environment spec with engineers, and make sound technical tradeoffs. Comfort with Python and sandboxed environments (Docker, VMs, browser automation) is a plus.
  • Experience designing metrics that capture risk, system performance, and user impact, and using them to make crisp decisions.
  • A track record of shipping 0-to-1 products in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
  • The ability to explain complex technical ideas clearly to researchers, customers, and executives.
  • Creative, adversarial thinking: you enjoy imagining how a capable model might cut corners, and you don't stop at existing checklists.

The expected salary range for this position is $180,000 – $220,000 USD per year, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

An overview of this role

As a Senior Corporate Security Engineer, you'll help secure the systems GitLab team members rely on every day across a fully remote environment. This role sits within Corporate Security Engineering and focuses on building secure-by-default controls for endpoints and the SaaS platforms that support them, with a strong emphasis on macOS. You'll own meaningful technical decisions around endpoint hardening, automation, and detection, and you'll help turn security requirements into scalable engineering systems that are measurable, auditable, and designed to reduce friction for end users.

This is a strong fit if you're motivated by solving security problems with code. You will work across endpoint management, identity, and security operations to improve how GitLab manages macOS, iOS, Windows, and Linux devices through Infrastructure-as-Code, Terraform, and GitOps workflows. In your first year, you'll be expected to strengthen endpoint security architecture, expand automation, and improve the reliability and auditability of how controls are deployed and maintained.

What you’ll do

  • Help lead the security architecture of GitLab's endpoint fleet and related infrastructure, with a primary focus on macOS.
  • Design and support automation for secure endpoint deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management using code-based workflows.
  • Manage endpoint and SaaS security configuration through Terraform, version control, merge requests, continuous integration pipelines, and automated rollouts.
  • Define and enforce security baselines across macOS, iOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints.
  • Develop patching and software distribution approaches that align with security, compliance, and operational requirements.
  • Partner with Information Technology, Security Operations, and Detection and Response teams to improve endpoint telemetry, detections, and response models.
  • Drive process improvements that reduce manual work and lower risk by favoring automation, policy-driven controls, and auditable change management.
  • Mentor engineers across Corporate Security and Information Technology, and serve as a senior escalation point for complex endpoint security issues.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience designing and delivering endpoint, systems, or corporate security solutions in environments that require scalable, durable controls.
  • Deep knowledge of endpoint management platforms such as Jamf Pro or FleetDM, especially for architecting and securing macOS environments.
  • Strong hands-on ability with Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code practices, including module design, state management, and pipeline-based deployment.
  • Experience working with GitOps workflows where changes are managed through Git repositories, merge requests, code review, and automated pipelines.

  • Familiarity with cloud identity providers and directories, including platforms such as Okta, Google Workspace, LDAP.

The Corporate Security Engineering team secures the internal environment GitLab team members use every day, including endpoints, identity systems, SaaS applications, and platforms that store sensitive internal data. It's a small, high-leverage team that treats security work as engineering work: building with code, operating through Git, and using reviewable, testable, and auditable workflows by default. The team partners closely with Information Technology, Security Operations, and Engineering across regions, collaborating asynchronously to build controls that scale across GitLab's all-remote workforce while reducing friction for end users.

About Phase2

Our remote first employees join and stay at Phase2 to be a force. In pursuit of digital experience that advances the human experience, you will do your best work, live fully, and succeed as a team.

Phase2 a digital agency passionate about customer experience, grounded in data & insights, and rooted in more than two decades of successful technology delivery. We guide industry-leading companies to what's next in their digital landscape.

And it all begins with finding the right people who align with our values and passion for impact.

About the role

Enterprises are increasingly looking to modernize their data ecosystems, improve the reliability and accessibility of their data, and prepare for AI-driven solutions. Often, the biggest challenges aren't the applications themselves, but the underlying data architecture, integration, and quality needed to support them. Every client environment is different, requiring someone who can quickly diagnose complex data challenges and architect practical solutions that deliver measurable business value.

You will shape how enterprise data becomes usable for analytics, AI-assisted experiences, workflows, and other use cases across client organizations. You'll architect and help build scalable data solutions while defining practical standards and patterns that make client data easier to find, understand, use, and govern. You'll collaborate with client data owners and engineering teams to deliver prototypes and production-ready capabilities, demonstrating progress through measurable outcomes and clear executive communication. Beyond delivering on individual client engagements, you'll help establish reusable data architecture, engineering, and AI-readiness frameworks that support the growth of this emerging capability at Phase2.

What You'll Do

Client Leadership

  • Actively help pitch and sell this capability alongside sales and account teams
  • Lead technical client conversations, diagnosing underlying data challenges and translating business needs into practical solutions rather than simply executing what's requested
  • Make the business case for foundational data work independent of any single AI use case, including quantifying cost avoidance, reporting-time savings, and eliminated duplicate work so clients see the value even before, or without, an AI initiative
  • Establish measurable outcomes and progress indicators that demonstrate the value of technical improvements, and communicate results through regular demos and executive updates

Strategy and Architecture

  • Collaborate with Phase2's senior technical leaders to establish reusable architectures, technical standards, and delivery approaches that help develop and scale our emerging enterprise data capabilities
  • Partner with the Marketing Technology Strategists and Data & Insights team to align semantic standards and warehouse architecture with domain-specific marketing data work (CDP, attribution, activation)
  • Establish standards for semantic and context layers to improve consistency, interpretability, and reuse across a client's data ecosystem
  • Pinpoint and resolve semantic and contextual gaps that limit data consistency, accessibility, and reliability, collaborating with client data owners to establish trusted, reusable data foundations across systems, teams, and AI applications
  • Design and deliver metadata, lineage, and data quality practices that improve discoverability and reduce ambiguity in AI-driven analysis
  • Define scalable data access and integration patterns that support analytics, AI applications, copilots, and agents

Implementation and Delivery

  • Architect, build, and optimize data platforms and pipelines, including data ingestion, integration, transformation, modeling, and storage, with attention to scalability, performance, reliability, and cost
  • Design and deliver proofs of concept and production-ready data solutions across diverse client environments, from targeted analytics migrations to complex, large-scale data processing and AI-enabled applications
  • Collaborate with software engineers and other technical specialists to implement solutions, establish reusable engineering patterns, and leverage AI-assisted development tools where appropriate

Quality and Governance

  • Establish data quality, validation, and testing practices that ensure solutions are reliable, accurate, and fit for their intended purpose, including AI use cases where applicable
  • Define technical standards and review the quality of data solutions developed by engineers and AI-assisted tooling, ensuring consistency, maintainability, and correctness
  • Incorporate appropriate documentation, metadata, lineage, and governance practices into solutions to support security, compliance, auditability, and responsible data use

What You’ll Need

  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or a closely related discipline (e.g., analytics engineering, data platform engineering, or MDM architecture)
  • Demonstrated ability to establish and apply data quality, testing, and validation practices that ensure the accuracy and reliability of data solutions
  • Ability to prototype and build solutions across the data and application stack to accelerate learning and delivery
  • Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering production data platforms and solutions, including data integration, transformation, modeling, and storage, with sound judgment around scalability, performance, reliability, and cost
  • Fluency in SQL and data modeling, with strong judgment around modeling approaches (e.g., Kimball, Data Vault) and when to apply them
  • A demonstrated habit of tracing a client complaint (a wrong report, an unreliable AI answer, a stalled migration) back to its actual data root cause
  • Experience navigating complex stakeholder environments, balancing technical, business, security, and compliance considerations to build alignment around solutions
  • Strong executive communication and storytelling skills, including delivering progress against the scorecards/KPIs you define and influencing roadmaps
  • Comfortable delivering visible progress in short cycles, showing a client tangible movement every week or two rather than asking them to wait months for a finished build
  • A generalist orientation and comfort with ambiguity; ability to own a client conversation on data migration one week and a large-scale pipeline the next

What Would Be Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting regulatory audits or compliance reviews in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, or similar)
  • Experience bridging data product management and AI solution delivery
  • Experience in metadata management and data catalog ecosystems, including improving discoverability and interpretability
  • Full-stack engineering experience to support rapid prototyping and experimentation
  • Experience building or governing controls and metrics layers for enterprise analytics at scale
  • Experience directing AI agents/agentic tooling as a delivery mechanism, rather than only using them as personal productivity tools

What You’ll Get

  • The chance to make a real impact, helping millions of people per year.
  • To work from wherever you thrive best. We’re a remote-first team built on trust, flexibility, and outcomes.
  • A competitive compensation package that considers various factors.
  • A comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability coverage, and supplemental insurance.
  • Our fun and interactive wellness program offers rewards for participation.
  • A 401(k) with a 3% employer contribution–no match required and 100% vested after just 90 days.
  • You’ll start with 16 paid vacation days, 4 personal days, and 1 volunteer day each year. Vacation and personal time increase with your tenure, recognizing your continued contributions.
  • Up to 12 weeks of fully paid leave for birthing parents and up to 6 weeks of fully paid bonding leave, based on your tenure. This includes support for adoption and foster placement, along with the option to extend time off through additional unpaid leave.
  • A $500 stipend to personalize and equip your home workspace for success.

What the Environment Looks Like

Physical Demands

  • Frequently remain in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods of time.
  • Occasional adjusting or moving of light objects up to 20 pounds in all directions.
  • Continuous communication on live video chats, calls, and through emails and messaging platforms for the purpose of exchanging information.
  • Continuous repetitive movements that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Travel, sometimes frequent, is expected.

Mental Demands

  • Comprehension - Must continuously be able to understand direction and adhere to established procedures. Must also be able to gather information from clients and employees and synthesize this information in a meaningful way. May also be responsible for making improvements or recommendations to existing procedures.
  • Organization - Must continuously be able to gather and classify information, store information learned from conversations and communications, and then be and be able to quickly recall, interpret, and explain information.
  • Reasoning and Decision Making - Must continuously use logic to analyze and interpret information, and prioritize.
  • Communication - Must continuously express or exchange ideas and meaning with employees and clients.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

jobs.title: Co-Founder & CEO - AI Content Intelligence for Professional Services
jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityFutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead an AI-native content intelligence and publishing venture.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead an AI-native content intelligence and publishing venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Orbitwell is an AI-first content workflow that turns a professional's own judgment and stories into a consistent, firm-approved public presence. The platform captures private input through conversation, audio, and dictation, drafts voice-matched content grounded in that person's real expertise, and routes every draft through configurable firm guardrails and human verification before it reaches a ready-to-publish queue. Rather than another point solution for capture, writing, or scheduling, Orbitwell is designed to be the system of record for expert-driven publishing inside professional-services firms.

The venture begins with an initial product, 30+ validation interviews, and a working prototype to accelerate iteration and go-to-market. We are now seeking a founder to lead the venture from here.

Market Context

  • ~500,000+ US professional-services firms in wealth and legal alone (33,000 RIAs, 418,000–463,000 law firms), most under 10 people

  • Professional-services AUM/revenue is growing and consolidating: RIA assets under management +22.3% YoY to $176.8T; RIA M&A hit a record 322 deals in 2025, up from 272; law firm employment +1.4% in 2025

  • The category proving willingness to pay for this workflow, personal/employee advocacy software, is a $0.5B–$2.2B market in 2026, growing at double-digit CAGR through the early 2030s

  • Generative AI content creation, the underlying technology wave, is a $14.8B market in 2024 projected to reach $80.1B by 2030 (32.5% CAGR)

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight’s cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead execution.

  • Strategy — Define the ICP wedge (creators vs. teams vs. agencies), pricing model, and product positioning

  • Customer Development — Expand from internal design partners to external users (creators, teams, agencies), validate retention and willingness to pay, and build the go-to-market motion through creator-led distribution

  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback

  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction

  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

  • Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement

  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

  • Direct exposure to the creator economy, marketing tech, social platforms, or knowledge work tooling, with familiarity in AI agents/LLMs

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer
jobs.excerpt: About The OpportunityNetrix Global is looking for a client-facing Full-Stack Developer to build secure enterprise web experiences, backend APIs, and cloud-hosted applications that support Microsoft, AI, and business platform solutions.
jobs.description:
About The Opportunity

Netrix Global is looking for a client-facing Full-Stack Developer to build secure enterprise web experiences, backend APIs, and cloud-hosted applications that support Microsoft, AI, and business platform solutions.

The developer will use C#/.NET, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, and Azure services to deliver custom-code capabilities that are not suited to low-code platforms alone. The role includes identity integration, API design, testing, deployment readiness, and production troubleshooting.

The ideal candidate takes end-to-end ownership, communicates confidently with clients, and collaborates across AI, Power Platform, Microsoft 365, and DevOps teams. Success in this role means delivering secure, tested, and responsive applications with maintainable architecture and clear operational visibility.

How You Will Make An Impact

  • Participate in client discovery and translate functional and non-functional requirements into practical technical designs.
  • Develop responsive React-based user experiences and C#/.NET backend services and APIs.
  • Implement secure authentication and authorization using Entra ID, OAuth, and role-based access patterns.
  • Integrate Microsoft services, enterprise systems, databases, and external APIs.
  • Design SQL data access patterns and maintain clear API contracts, error handling, and validation.
  • Write unit and integration tests; participate in peer reviews and maintain clean, supportable code.
  • Deploy and operate applications on Azure using App Service, Functions, Storage, Key Vault, and Application Insights as appropriate.
  • Support CI/CD, release troubleshooting, observability, and root-cause analysis with the DevOps and Test teams.
  • Explain architecture trade-offs, estimate delivery efforts, prototype rapidly, and document technical decisions and handoff guidance.

What You Will Bring To The Table

We are looking for a professional who combines technical ownership with strong client partnership. Success in this role requires curiosity, accountability, practical judgment, and the ability to move work forward while keeping stakeholders informed.

  • Communicate clearly with clients and internal stakeholders during discovery, delivery updates, risk discussions, and project handoffs.
  • Take ownership of outcomes, follow work through to completion, and escalate risks early with supporting evidence.
  • Use documentation, experimentation, and collaboration to solve unfamiliar problems rather than waiting for step-by-step direction.
  • Adapt to evolving technologies, priorities, and responsibilities while maintaining quality and security standards.
  • Contribute to a supportive engineering culture through peer reviews, knowledge sharing, and professional client interactions.

Qualifications

  • 4-6 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with C#/.NET, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, REST APIs, and SQL.
  • Solid understanding of authentication and authorization, Entra ID/OAuth, Git, unit testing, Azure development, and secure coding practices.
  • Strong debugging skills, end-to-end ownership, clean-code discipline, and peer-review practices.
  • Ability to lead client-facing technical discussions, decompose requirements, estimate work efforts, and communicate architecture trade-offs.
  • Experience with .NET, .NET Core, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions, App Service, Storage, Key Vault, and Application Insights.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD; familiarity with Jest, React Testing Library, and SPFx fundamentals.
  • Exposure to Azure OpenAI integration, Next.js, Python, Copilot extensibility, Docker, or Dataverse integration.
  • Secure, tested, and responsive applications and APIs.
  • Reliable identity and enterprise-system integrations.
  • Maintainable custom-code foundations for AI agents, Microsoft 365 (M365), and Power Platform solutions.
  • Clear monitoring, documentation, and operational handoff.

Work Schedule: This is a client-facing role. The successful candidate will be expected to participate in client meetings, discovery sessions, demonstrations, delivery reviews, and issue-resolution discussions during the assigned shift.

Standard Shift: 1:00 PM to 10:00 PM India Standard Time (IST), equivalent to 2:30 AM to 11:30 AM Eastern Standard Time (EST). During U.S. daylight saving time, the equivalent schedule is 3:30 AM to 12:30 PM Eastern Daylight Time (EDT).

About Us

At Netrix Global, our values are the philosophies and principles that we live by. They support our vision, help us achieve our goals, and commit us to a common purpose.

We Own Outcomes, Win Together, Make An Impact, Enjoy The Journey, and Respect All!   

Netrix Global is a mission-driven organization with the goal of providing the people, processes, and technology needed to run and scale modern, data-driven businesses that are always on and always secure. Our breadth of capabilities allows us to provide holistic offerings that solve even today’s most complex business challenges, delivering to you an integrated, optimized, and future-proof solution.  

We work with clients of all sizes and specialize in solutions for healthcare, manufacturing, government, education, financial services, and legal industries. Netrix is consistently ranked in the CRN VAR500, detailing the country’s top system integrators.  

At Netrix, we’re driven to solve business problems with innovative technology solutions. We focus on end-users and are committed to client satisfaction.  

What You Can Expect From Us

We offer a competitive compensation package, comprehensive group benefits to meet the needs of you and your family, flexibility, and time off when you need it, and a casual work environment. The role can be remote/home office, with some travel required.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. As part of this commitment, we will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If you need reasonable accommodations, please let us know by contacting NetrixHR@Netrixglobal.

Ziply Fiber is a local internet service provider dedicated to elevating the connected lives of the communities we serve. We offer the fastest home internet in the nation, a refreshingly great customer experience, and affordable plans that put customers in charge.

As our state-of-the-art fiber network expands, so does our need for team members who can help us grow and realize our goals.

Our Company Values:

  • Genuinely Caring:We treat customers and colleagues like neighbors, with empathy and full attention.
  • Empowering You:We help customers choose what is best for them, and we support employees in implementing new ideas and solutions.
  • Innovation and Improvement:We constantly seek ways to improve how we serve customers and each other.
  • Earning Your Trust:We build trust through clear, honest, human communication.

Job Summary

The Senior Manager, Sales Operations will manage all team members within the Commercial Sales Operations department and drive the strategy and execution of sales support work including the automating key systems and processes in order to help keep our sales team’s time spent serving our customers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The Essential Duties and Responsibilities listed below are a range of duties performed by the employee and not intended to reflect all duties performed.

Sales Operations Strategy & Process Improvement

·Work with a broad set of key stakeholders to design, launch, and maintain innovative sales and technical sales enablement processes, programs, and systems.

·Manage day-to-day sales operations and enablement functions, ensuring they run efficiently and support the needs of the commercial sales organization.

·Analyze existing processes and workflows to identify and implement improvements.

·Partner with sales leadership to ensure key metrics are easily accessible and reported on for systems and processes.

Salesforce & Sales Technology Management

·Manage Salesforce, including support requests and escalated administrative needs, providing prompt and complete resolution of technical challenges and business support issues.

·Manage platforms and applications, including vendor relationships.

·Evaluate and implement additional applications and tools that integrate with Salesforce and the broader technology stack.

·Leverage AI as needed to streamline workflows, automate routine tasks, and increase efficiency across sales operations and enablement.

Project Management, Data & Cross-Functional Coordination

·Manage sales operations functions and projects to ensure timely completion.

·Communicate and coordinate with key IT resources on behalf of the sales team and manage project inputs for IT systems related to the commercial sales organization, to support smooth planning and execution.

·Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer and prospect data.

·Serve as a facilitator between sales systems and cross-functional teams, helping each group access, interpret, and act on the information and reporting they need.

Team Leadership & Other Duties

·Hire, onboard, train, and offboard sales operations team members.

·Perform other duties as required to support the business and evolving organization.

Required Qualifications:

·High school diploma or GED.

·Minimum of five (5) years of hands-on experience administering and automating Salesforce, including building Flows, workflow rules, and approval processes to support sales teams.

  • In-depth understanding of the capabilities and constraints of Salesforce combined with a solid understanding of standard business processes.

·Proven track record of collaborating with sales team and sales leadership to analyze existing processes and workflows.

·Ability to recognize opportunities for process improvement that enable sales teams to obtain the information they need quickly and effectively.

·Ability to work on multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong passion for customer service.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with all levels within an organization.

Preferred Qualifications:

·Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field.

  • Certified Salesforce Administrator.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

·Ability to work independently and use sound judgment to prioritize requests, resolve system and process issues, and make decisions that support the sales organization.

·Ability to manage multiple projects at once and collaborate effectively with sales, IT, and other cross-functional partners to deliver on time.

·Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical and system information clearly to sales teams and leadership, with strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

·Ability to meet critical deadlines for system changes, reporting, and project deliverables.

·Ability to adapt quickly to changing business priorities, sales needs, and project schedules.

·Commitment to providing responsive, high-quality support to internal sales teams and the customers they serve.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the US for any employer. Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Essential and marginal functions may require maintaining physical condition necessary for bending, stooping, sitting, walking, or standing for prolonged periods of time; most of time is spent sitting in a comfortable position with frequent opportunity to move about. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

Work is performed in an office setting with exposure to computer screens and requires extensive use of a computer, keyboard, mouse, and multi-line telephone system. The work is primarily a modern office setting.

At all times, Ziply Fiber must be your primary employer. Unless otherwise prohibited by law, employees may not hold outside employment nor be self-employed without obtaining approval in writing from Ziply Fiber. In holding outside employment or self-employment, employees should ensure that participation does not conflict with responsibilities to Ziply Fiber or its business interests.

Diverse Workforce / EEO:

Ziply Fiber is an equal opportunity employer. Ziply Fiber will consider all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, and the presence of a non-job-related handicap or disability or any other legally protected status.

Ziply Fiber requires a pre-employment background check as conditions of employment. Ziply Fiber may require a pre-employment drug screening.

Ziply Fiber is a drug free workplace.

COMPANY OVERVIEW:

WellRight is a corporate wellness leader delivering customizable and complete wellness programs, used by organizations to improve the health and well-being of their employees and clients. Our mission is to help people live their best lives with industry-leading technology through personalized, holistic well-being. What sets us apart is our dedication to tailoring solutions to the unique needs of each customer we serve.

At WellRight, we embrace and celebrate diversity in all its forms. We are united by a common purpose: to create a meaningful impact through well-being programs that engage and inspire participants while delivering tangible results. Our goal is to foster well-being in the workplace with a versatile and empowering solution, allowing each individual to embark on their own well-being journey. We invite you to explore how you might contribute to our mission.

JOB SUMMARY:

At WellRight, we value and celebrate diversity ~ in backgrounds and experiences. WellRight is a leading provider of corporate wellness software, used by organizations to improve the health and well-being of their employees and clients. Our mission is to change people for good through positive habit formation, focusing on six dimensions of holistic health: physical, emotional, financial, social, occupational, and purpose. As a proud member of Workforce Magazine’s list of top 10 Corporate Wellness Providers, WellRight is the preferred choice for organizations as they improve the health and well-being of their partners and clients.

The Regional Sales Manager (RSM) is responsible for driving participation in the WellRight platform by working collaboratively with the greater sales team to ensure that sales targets are achieved. jobs.description:
Description:

The Senior Key Accounts Manager - Regional Payers is a senior individual contributor responsible for the business-to-business relationships, strategic account planning, and measurable business performance of an assigned regional payer portfolio. The Senior Key Accounts Manager will be accountable for gaining, protecting, and improving profitable formulary and medical policy access; influencing downstream adoption and accurate implementation of parent-account access; identifying and advancing financially sound regional contracting opportunities; quantifying business impact; leading approved pull-through; and bringing actionable payer intelligence into portfolio and launch decisions. This role requires cross-functional leadership with Pricing and Contracting, Finance, Legal, Medical Affairs and MSLs, Brand, Patient Services, Field Reimbursement, Sales, Trade, Analytics, Government Affairs, and other internal stakeholders.

Essential Functions:

Opportunity Advancement and Business Outcomes:

  • Secure, maintain, and improve profitable formulary placement and written medical policy coverage across pharmacy and medical benefits.
  • Identify and advance financially sound regional contracting and strategic partnership opportunities in alignment with the applicable Key Account Manager and approved parent-account strategy.
  • Build and present business cases using volume, claims, reimbursement, formulary, competitive, rebate, discount, and financial data; clearly articulate forecast impact, access risk, expected return, and recommended action to senior leadership.
  • Support or lead approved regional contract discussions and manage opportunities through approval, signature, implementation, and performance monitoring.
  • Measures of success: advance at least one priority opportunity each quarter and deliver two to three documented access or business wins annually.
  • Current portfolio measures include advancing at least two systemic access issues across the Specialty portfolio; targeting two measurable coverage or implementation improvements through priority BCBS and other regional plans and selected large IDN specialty centers or health-system accounts; and qualifying three Biosciences or Pipeline opportunities, including Medicaid coverage opportunities, with at least one advanced annually.

Account Focus and Coverage Intelligence:

  • Serve as the primary account owner and day-to-day Amneal contact for assigned East or West regional health plans and downstream payer accounts.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans aligned with Amneal portfolio objectives and the applicable parent-account strategy.
  • Build multi-level relationships across pharmacy, medical, contracting, industry relations, utilization management, and other relevant customer functions.
  • Maintain current knowledge of each account's decision-making structure, lines of business, PBM and rebate aggregator relationships, benefit design, utilization management, coverage criteria, and implementation processes.
  • Maintain a cross-portfolio coverage, barrier, and opportunity tracker for priority Blues, regional plans, IDNs, health systems, and Medicaid plans.
  • Measures of success: Every priority account has current coverage status, a defined business issue or opportunity, an accountable owner, a next step, and timing.

Strategic Engagement and Pull-Through:

  • Lead approved regional payer, Blue, IDN, health-system, or state engagement when tied to a defined access issue, contracting opportunity, implementation need, or broader business priority.
  • Develop, implement, and measure PRC-approved pull-through strategies based on formulary and medical policy access.

jobs.title: [Flexible & Remote] Relocation Consultant, APAC
jobs.excerpt: Hello!  🦜Thanks for checking out our job posting.
jobs.description:
Hello! 🦜

Thanks for checking out our job posting. You’ve already taken a tiny step towards being a part of our team – huzzah!

We know that taking your next career step is as exciting as it can be exhausting. So, with that in mind, we’ve tried to keep our description simple and cliché-free to help you decide if PerchPeek and this role are a good match for you.

About PerchPeek

At PerchPeek we dream of a borderless world where people have the freedom to live and work where they please. Where ideas and resources flow where they’re most needed unrestricted by national borders. We strive to create a world of opportunity for anyone, anywhere – one move at a time.

Have you ever relocated? If so, you probably know how overwhelming it can be—immigration hoops, tax implications, housing, shipping, utilities, banking…the list goes on. No matter where in the world you go, relocating is complicated, time-intensive, and stressful. PerchPeek was conceived to change that.

We’re building a streamlined Mobility ecosystem to empower businesses and individuals to move anywhere in the world. We support employers and employees through every stage of the relocation process, providing an affordable, scalable, high-value service, powered by technology and relocation expertise.

About the role

Flexible Relocation Coaches work with PerchPeek to support current markets with surges in business volume, provide flexibility for Relocation Coach capacity, and improve coverage to support relocators across multiple markets and timezones. This role will work within a network of third-party consultants and with PerchPeek’s Network Manager to deliver quality customer experience in line with customer requirements and PerchPeek’s SLAs for quality and productivity.

Previous experience in the Global Mobility / Relocation industry and knowledge of relocation management and/or destination services is helpful, but not essential, as we’ll provide a free training course on how to become a successful Flex Relocation Coach. You’ll also receive paid training on all of our internal systems. You might be an awesome Relocation Coach if you’ve previously worked as a Customer Success Manager, Concierge, Personal Assistant, Support or Operations Specialist, or if you’ve worked in industries like travel, hospitality, SaaS startups, or HR.

Scope of Work

In more detail, Flexible Relocation Coaches will be contracted to deliver end-to-end Relocation Coach services to a diverse portfolio of relocators by:

  • Building trusted relationships with relocators over the duration of their relocation journey as their main point of contact, delegating tasks when appropriate.
  • Communicating with relocators via a) the PerchPeek app and b) through consultative and supportive calls to understand the customer’s needs, explain relocation services, and provide expertise, guidance & support to relocators within your portfolio.
  • Handling difficult or complex relocator enquiries or situations, using critical judgement to ensure the best outcomes for your movers, including escalating these as appropriate.
  • Providing the “right expertise at the right time” on all aspects of the relocation journey and life in the destination country to equip relocators to integrate successfully to their new location.
  • Supporting relocators in understanding and abiding to their company’s relocation policy, including management of their relocation allowances.
  • Recommending and coordinating additional relocation services from providers, working within PerchPeek’s Supply Chain. Examples include immigration, tax or shipping providers.
  • Systems Cleanliness: utilising Operations and Relocation Experience processes to the highest standards to help make sure that our teams and systems run smoothly. i.e. ensuring collected data is accurate and useful for data analysis, reporting, and insights.
  • Process implementation: supporting the rollout of process improvements by engaging with new processes and tools.
  • Appropriately delegating relevant tasks to third-party consultants, monitoring service delivery to ensure all tasks are completed to a high quality within PerchPeek’s delivery SLAs.
  • Identifying and managing escalations, delivery issues and inefficiencies appropriately to ensure your deliverables align with service delivery requirements, policies, and expectations.
  • Familiarising yourself with PerchPeek’s products and providing guidance to relocators on how they can utilise the Relocator App and its tools and content.
  • Advocating for high-quality knowledge capturing and contributing to developing the PerchPeek content library.
  • Collaborating with other Relocation Coaches for creative problem-solving and knowledge sharing.

About You

Requirements
  • The role requires fluency in verbal and written English, as well as awareness or first-hand knowledge of major cities and lifestyle norms in the APAC region.
  • Knowledge of additional APAC countries and local lifestyles is preferred.
  • No prior relocation experience is required, as we provide a comprehensive free training and up-skilling program to fully prepare you for success as a Relocation Coach.

While not necessary, we’re especially interested in candidates with the below:

  • You share our value of Delighting Customers: in this role, you have the customer’s needs at the heart of your thoughts and actions every day.
  • You are organised, efficient and prioritise your time so that you can balance being both proactive and reactive to the needs of your portfolio of customers and manage them across different timelines and stages of their relocations.
  • You are an eloquent and concise communicator and can tailor your written and verbal communications to the specific customer. You are comfortable managing expectations and diplomatically handling concerns or objections.
  • You are relentlessly focused on delivery. Things move quickly at PerchPeek, but even faster for our customers, so you should relish challenges and demonstrate a strong natural instinct to drive things to completion.
  • You keep an eye on the details! Every relocation has its nuances, and it’s important to understand, track and translate these into accurate recommendations.
  • You display comfort in ambiguous situations and are confident in working through unknowns and adapting to challenging customer needs or expectations.
  • You are resilient in a range of situations. From constant changes as a business and product development to specific customer failures, you are comfortable adapting, learning and applying it to the next customer.
  • You are highly autonomous and thrive in a 100% remote and independent working environment without losing personal motivation, initiative, or productivity.

jobs.excerpt: About SafeLeaseAt SafeLease, we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change.
jobs.description:
About SafeLease

At SafeLease, we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change. We believe the industry's biggest inefficiencies aren't technical problems — they're structural ones. And we're building the team to tackle them.

SafeLease is a profitable insurance business that designs, underwrites, and distributes specialty coverage for commercial property owners and their tenants. Most insurance companies either distribute products or bear the risk — we do both. We back our policies with our own capital, which means we control the full stack: product design, tech, and the speed at which we move. That end-to-end ownership lets us offer customers real flexibility, saving time and money for more than 4,000 properties insured for billions in value nationwide.

We're a team of 85, growing over 100% annually, and we've done it without sacrificing profitability or culture. Here, you'll get high discretion and a wide aperture of problems to solve. We embrace the newest technologies, move fast together, and operate with the intensity of a small company where every person's work is visible. If you're looking for a place to sharpen your craft alongside people who take their work seriously, you'll fit right in.

About the Role

When someone rents a storage unit, SafeLease protects what they store inside, and the storage owner earns revenue from it. SafeLease is a product of Etude, focusing on the self storage insurance industry.

Account Managers at SafeLease are strategic partners to self-storage owners and operators. You'll help each customer shape how their tenant protection program runs in their business, then grow it into a meaningful revenue line across their portfolio.

You'll build a deep understanding of how storage businesses operate and pair it with a consultative, data-driven approach that helps customers get more from their program. Your success is measured by customer retention, program performance, and revenue growth through expansion and upgrades.

Responsibilities

  • Learn how each customer operates and guide how they roll out their protection program: which tenants are enrolled, how it's priced, and how it fits their move-in process.

  • Become the go-to expert on our products, our customers, and the self-storage industry.

  • Use performance data to show customers what's working, what to change, and the value their program delivers.

  • Bring ideas that help customers hit their goals and run a stronger business.

  • Build relationships that last and grow the partnership as their business grows.

  • Proactively share what you hear with Product, Sales, and Support to shape what we build next.

What you'll bring

  • 3+ years in B2B account management, customer success, or consultative sales with a revenue target.

  • Strong commercial judgment and a history of growing accounts, not just managing them. You know how to find where a customer can get more value and develop a plan to turn it into new business.

  • You make complex problems simple and communicate them clearly.

  • You're self-motivated, adaptable, and curious, and you do your best work when things move fast.

  • No storage or insurance background needed. We'll teach you the industry.

Why SafeLease?

The tech: Our prospects convert fast because we’re solving real problems and delivering serious value to commercial real estate owners.

The team: We’re a team of seasoned pros and sharp operators who know how to move fast and build smart. High standards, low ego.

The stability: We’re well-funded, growing fast, and we make sure our team shares in that success with competitive pay and equity.

The employee experience: We also offer unlimited PTO, full health benefits, flexible work setups, and the kind of culture where people want to show up to do their best work.


If you don't have all the qualifications listed, don't worry! We understand everyone's career path is unique and still encourage you to apply if you feel this role is aligned with your career trajectory.

Employment at SafeLease is contingent upon a satisfactory verification of a general and criminal background check.

Crowell & Moring LLP is an international law firm with offices in the United States, Europe, MENA, and Asia that represents clients in litigation and arbitration, regulatory and policy, intellectual property, and transactional and corporate matters. The firm is internationally recognized for representing Fortune 500 companies in high-stakes litigation and government-facing matters, as well as its ongoing commitment to pro bono service and diversity, equity, and inclusion. At Crowell & Moring, exceptional client service begins with exceptional people. We are committed to delivering responsive, high-quality, and professional service to our clients and to one another, while continuously elevating standards of excellence across every aspect of our work.

Job Summary

The Director of eDiscovery and Data Solutions works closely with eDiscovery leadership including the leader(s) of the eDiscovery and Information Management practice to manage firmwide -technology-enabled eDiscovery services. Serving as a senior adviser to firm leadership and the eDiscovery and Information Management practice, the Director combines firm business goals and client priorities into a clear service, technology, and investment roadmap for eDiscovery matters. The role is accountable for the performance, growth, governance, and financial sustainability of the eDiscovery and Data Solutions (“EDDS”) function, while identifying broader opportunities to use data, analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence to improve matter delivery and defensibility of process.

The Director leads the eDiscovery and Data Solutions team, shapes strategic vendor and platform decisions, and partners across Practice Management, Innovation, Information Technology, Information Security, the GC’s Office, Finance, and other business functions to develop scalable solutions. Success is measured by client value, quality and defensibility, adoption, operational and financial performance, risk management, and the team’s contribution to the firm’s strategic priorities.

Job Responsibilities

  • Set and execute the firmwide strategy for eDiscovery and Data Solutions, with a multi-year roadmap aligned to firm, practice, client, and matter priorities.
  • Serve as a senior technical adviser to eDiscovery leadership and the eDiscovery and Information Management practice on discovery technology strategy, security and management, cost, and the effective use of data and technology in the context of litigation.
  • Position the function as a differentiated legal technology service by identifying opportunities to strengthen client value, improve matter outcomes, support pitches and client conversations, and develop repeatable service offerings.
  • Own the service portfolio and operating model for eDiscovery data solutions, including governance, demand planning, delivery standards, resource strategy, service levels, and continuous improvement.
  • Lead the development of scalable data, analytics, automation, AI-enabled, and technical workflow solutions that improve how legal teams manage, analyze, and use matter-related information.
  • Establish clear business cases, priorities, success measures, and benefits-realization plans for technology and service investments; report progress, risks, outcomes, and required decisions to senior stakeholders.
  • Direct the evaluation, selection, implementation, adoption, performance, validation, and lifecycle management of eDiscovery platforms and approved data solutions.
  • Build strong partnerships with Practice Management, Innovation, Information Technology, Information Security, the GC’s Office, Finance and other functions to align strategy, resources, dependencies, and delivery.
  • Develop and maintain trusted relationships with key clients, legal teams, and practice leaders; anticipate evolving needs and translate them into commercially sound and scalable solutions.
  • Where the firm is engaged to provide eDiscovery technology solutions via EDDS provide executive oversight of complex, high-risk, or strategically significant matters, ensuring defensible approaches, effective escalation, and alignment with client expectations.
  • Own both team- and matter-level financial performance, including budgeting, pricing input, investment planning, capacity, cost trends, recovery, and material variances.
  • Lead vendor and commercial strategy, including sourcing, negotiation (in conjunction with the firm’s Vendor Management Office), performance management, innovation commitments, concentration risk, service quality, and value for money.
  • Monitor legal, regulatory, client, and market developments and advise leadership on their strategic implications for services, technology management, security risk, and investment.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing, globally connected team through organization design, talent and succession planning, performance management, capability development, and inclusive leadership.
  • Drive adoption and consistent practice through stakeholder engagement, targeted communications, training, and practical change management.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Deep expertise in eDiscovery technology and related support strategy, legal and regulatory requirements in the context of eDiscovery, service delivery, and technology across the discovery lifecycle.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including the ability to develop business cases, evaluate investments, manage budgets, assess pricing and recovery, and balance value, risk, and cost.
  • Demonstrated ability to create and execute multi-year strategies, service roadmaps, operating models, and transformation initiatives in a complex professional-services environment.
  • Advanced knowledge of eDiscovery technologies, services, platforms, data analytics, technology-assisted review, automation, machine learning, generative AI, workflow technologies, forensic collection, and information security practices.
  • Ability to transform client, legal, and business needs into scalable services and technology solutions with clear outcomes, governance, ownership, and performance measures.
  • Strong executive presence and judgment, with the credibility to advise senior leaders, practice leaders, clients, and matter teams on complex and sensitive issues.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional change, align stakeholders, resolve competing priorities, and influence decisions without relying solely on formal authority.
  • Demonstrated success leading, managing, and developing high-performing, multidisciplinary teams across offices and geographies, including organization design and succession planning.
  • Strong client relationship, consulting, and business-development skills, with the ability to shape opportunities and articulate a compelling value proposition.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and negotiation skills, including the ability to make complex eDiscovery, technical, and commercial issues clear to nontechnical audiences.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment while maintaining strategic focus, disciplined execution, and appropriate oversight of operational risk.
