jobs.description:
Field Sales Representative

Location: Leicester, covering Leicester or surrounding areas (fully field-based)

£50,000–£90,000 OTE (£30,000–£54,000 base salary + uncapped commission, based on experience) + £800 monthly car allowance and a comprehensive benefits package

Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services have made life harder for them, with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe, bringing together payments, business accounts and other business tools with simple technology and real human support. From card payments and business accounts to financing solutions, we help our Members spend less time worrying about their finances and more time doing what they love.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you’re ambitious, enjoy meeting new people and want to make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Mission

We’re looking for ambitious, driven people to join our growing Field Sales team and help bring Teya to more local businesses across the UK.

As a Field Sales Representative, you’ll take ownership of your own territory, getting out into your local community, meeting business owners face-to-face and showing them how Teya can help their businesses thrive.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being out in the field, building relationships and winning new business. You’ll have the freedom to manage your territory, the support of a team that wants you to succeed, and the opportunity to build a rewarding career in sales.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own your territory: Proactively identify and engage local businesses through face-to-face prospecting, networking, referrals and other opportunities to generate new business.

  • Build meaningful relationships: Get to know business owners, understand their challenges and identify how Teya’s products and services can make their lives easier.

  • Win new Members: Use a consultative, value-led approach to demonstrate Teya’s solutions, build trust and turn conversations into long-term customer relationships.

  • Deliver results: Take ownership of your sales performance, maintain a healthy pipeline and consistently work towards your commercial targets.

  • See things through: Take responsibility for your Members’ experience from the first conversation through to onboarding, ensuring they’re set up successfully and ready to start using Teya.

  • Keep learning: Develop strong knowledge of our products, competitors and sales methodology through structured training, coaching and feedback.

  • Represent Teya: Be a trusted face of Teya in your local community, delivering the genuine care and hospitality that we want every Member to experience.

  • Help us improve: Share insights from the field to help us continuously improve our products, sales approach and Member experience.

Your Story

We believe great salespeople come from all kinds of backgrounds.

You might already be an experienced field sales professional with a strong track record of winning new business. Or you might be earlier in your career, with the ambition, drive and potential to become an exceptional salesperson.

What matters most to us is your mindset, your ability to connect with people and your willingness to learn and improve.

We’re looking for people who bring:

  • Ambition and drive: You’re motivated to succeed, enjoy working towards challenging goals and take pride in delivering great results.

  • A competitive mindset: You enjoy winning, hold yourself to high standards and are always looking for ways to improve.

  • Resilience and determination: You’re comfortable with rejection, stay positive when things get tough and don’t give up easily.

  • Strong people skills: You enjoy meeting new people, build rapport naturally and can have meaningful conversations with business owners from all walks of life.

  • Curiosity and commercial awareness: You ask good questions, listen carefully and want to understand what makes a business successful.

  • Coachability: You’re open to feedback, willing to challenge yourself and committed to developing your skills.

  • Ownership and self-discipline: You’re organised, proactive and comfortable managing your own time and priorities in a field-based role.

  • A genuine care for others: You understand that great sales isn’t just about closing a deal. It’s about doing what’s right for the customer and building trust that lasts.

Experience in field sales, business development, payments or financial services is an advantage, but not essential for every level. We care just as much about your potential as your experience.

You’ll also need:

  • Fluency in English.

  • A full UK driving licence and access to a car.

  • The right to work in the UK.

  • Willingness to work in a fully field-based role, travelling regularly throughout your territory.

The Perks

We believe great performance should be recognised and rewarded. Alongside the opportunity to build your career in a growing European fintech, you’ll receive:

  • £30,000–£54,000 base salary, depending on your experience and demonstrated capability.

  • Uncapped commission.

  • £800 per month car allowance (£9,600 annually), on top of your salary and commission.

  • 25 days of paid annual leave, plus UK bank holidays.

  • Bupa private healthcare and life insurance.

  • Employer pension contributions through our company pension scheme.

  • Free gym membership through Wellhub, alongside one-to-one therapy sessions, meditation and digital fitness and nutrition apps.

  • Structured onboarding, practical sales training, ongoing coaching and opportunities to grow your career at Teya.

What Happens Next?

Our recruitment process is designed to help us get to know you, understand your strengths and give you a genuine opportunity to show us what you can do.

Stage 1 - Introductory conversation (30 minutes)
A conversation with our Talent team to learn more about you, your motivation and what you’re looking for in your next role.

Stage 2 - Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)
An opportunity to explore your experience, how you approach challenges and what makes you successful.

Stage 3 - Final Assessment (60 minutes)
You’ll meet members of our Sales leadership team, present a short territory plan and take part in a practical sales role-play. We’ll share everything you need to prepare in advance.

We know interviews are a two-way process, and we’ll make sure you have plenty of opportunities to ask questions and get to know us along the way.

Teya is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including those without a traditional sales or commercial track record.

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

Position Title: Business Process & Systems Analyst

Position Location: Remote

JOB SUMMARY

The Business Process & Systems Analyst improves how work gets done across Smart Tech by simplifying processes, automating workflows, and optimizing business systems. This role partners across departments to develop practical, standardized solutions and enable employees to use them effectively.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Process & Workflow Design (35%)

  • Partner with departments to understand business needs, pain points, and opportunities for improvement
  • Document current-state processes and design efficient, standardized future-state workflows
  • Identify bottlenecks, manual work, duplicate efforts, and unclear ownership
  • Translate business needs into clear process, workflow, and system requirements
  • Develop process documentation and continuously evaluate workflows for improvement

Business Systems Ownership (25%)

  • Own and serve as the internal expert for Smartsheet, PowerBI and assigned business systems
  • Establish standards for system structure, permissions, templates, automation, and ownership
  • Partner with departments to select and implement the right system solutions for their needs

Automation (20%)

  • Automate workflows, approvals, notifications, data movement, and reporting to improve efficiency and consistency
  • Partner with IT on complex integrations and troubleshoot automations to ensure reliable, sustainable solutions

Enablement (20%)

  • Create and deliver training, coaching, and resources to help employees effectively use business systems and workflows
  • Create templates, standards, and user-friendly guidance that support consistent, independent use
  • Support process and system rollouts through training, testing, communication, and adoption

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

Preferred

jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Outpatient Surgery and Observations Facility Coding Specialist
jobs.excerpt: About Us:Our purpose is to help clients exceed their financial health goals.
jobs.description:
About Us:

Our purpose is to help clients exceed their financial health goals. Across the reimbursement cycle, our scalable solutions and clinical expertise help solve programmatic needs. Enabling our teams with leading technology allows analytics to guide our solutions and keeps us accountable achieving goals.

We build long-term careers by investing in YOU. We seek to create an environment that cultivates your professional development and personal growth, as we believe your success is our success.

JOB SUMMARY:

Coding Specialists are an important part of the Team at CorroHealth. The Coding Team Member will provide CPT, HCPCS and ICD-10-CM coding a minimum of 1-4 specialties. Will be Coding Professional Fee, Facility, or HCC. Professional Fee Specialties could include UR, Podiatry, Plastics, Pediatrics, OB, Pain Management, Ortho, Addiction, General Surgery, Internal Medicine, Urgent Care, Pulmonary, or ED. Facility Chart types could include OT, PT, Urgent Care, ED, or a variety of other specialties.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Note: The essential duties and responsibilities below are intended to describe the general duties and responsibilities of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. This position may perform all or most of the primary duties listed below. Specific tasks, responsibilities or competencies may be documented in the Team Member’s performance objectives as outlined by the Team Member’s immediate Leadership Team Member.

  • Team Member must be able to work from home and be independent in their coding skills.
  • Provide various components of coding services to support our clients.
  • Calculate Facility E/M levels by using an algorithm created by our company
  • Recognize critical care cases by patient acuity.
  • Code same day surgery and observations
  • Code surgical procedures typical of an ER setting to capture additional revenue when appropriate.
  • Apply ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes to the highest level of specificity available.
  • Accurately apply diagnosis and procedure codes utilizing ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT®, and HCPCS
  • Interpret coding guidelines for accurate code assignment
  • Identify the importance of documentation on code assignment and the subsequent reimbursement impact.
  • Align conduct with AHIMA's Standards of Ethical Coding and the Company’s Code of Ethics and Business Conduct and support the Company’s Ethics and Compliance Program.
  • Comply with all internal policies and procedures.
  • Actively participate in Company provided training and education.
  • All Coders must maintain at least one credential through either AAPC or AHIMA.
  • Ensure individual compliance with all privacy and security rules and regulations and commit to the protection of all Company confidential information, including but not limited to, Personal Health Information

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS:

  • All coders MUST be certified through either the AAPC (CPC or COC) or AHIMA (CCS or CCS-P).
  • Must have at least a minimum of 1 year of on the job experience.
  • Must have SDS, Outpatient surgery and Observations facility coding experience.
  • E&M, Injections/Infusions and ED experience is a plus.
  • Regular, predictable, and punctual attendance is required.
  • Must have working knowledge and experience with systems such as EMR, Billing, etc
  • Must have a phone, reliable internet connection and current coding materials such as CPT and ICD-10-CM coding references.
  • Will be required to maintain an ongoing productivity level and accuracy rate of 95% or higher
  • Will be required to maintain a quality score of 95% or higher
  • Must be proficient in Microsoft programs like Excel and Outlook. Examples include:
  • Excel you should be able to open and add to a spreadsheet, perform basic formulas like adding or multiplying.
  • Outlooks you should be able to manage emails and schedule and attend meetings.
  • Ability to communicate effectively and professionally both verbally and written.
  • Ability to coordinate, analyze, observe, make decisions, and meet deadlines
  • May be required to perform other duties as assigned by Leadership Team Member.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:
Note: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions as described. Regular eye-hand coordination and manual dexterity is required to operate office equipment. The ability to perform work at a computer terminal for 6-8 hours a day and function in an environment with constant interruptions is required. At times, Team Members are subject to sitting for prolonged periods. Infrequently, Team Member must be able to lift and move material weighing up to 20 lbs. Team Member may experience elevated levels of stress during periods of increased activity and with work entailing multiple deadlines.
A job description is only intended as a guideline and is only part of the Team Member’s function. The company has reviewed this job description to ensure that the essential functions and basic duties have been included. It is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all functions, responsibilities, skills and abilities. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate.

Job Title: Senior Regulatory Domain Expert - Falcon

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced regulatory operations professional to serve as our Senior Regulatory Domain Expert for Veeva Falcon. If you are a process-driven optimizer who is frustrated by the manual data-entry, repetitive checking, and data-chasing inherent in traditional Regulatory Information Management (RIM), this is your opportunity to help design a tech-forward solution. You will bring your deep knowledge of global submission lifecycles and health authority data standards to bear, advising our product and engineering teams as they build next-generation automation tools. Actively partnering with early adopter companies, you will serve as the definitive "Voice of the Customer" to replace legacy manual processes with intelligent digital labor.

What You'll Do

    • Product Advisory & Workflow Guidance: Guide product and engineering teams on the real-world operational nuances of global regulatory planning, dossier compilation, and the complexities of health authority data standards (e.g., IDMP, SPOR)
    • Output Verification & Quality Gatekeeping: Actively review, test, and provide expert feedback on platform outputs—verifying automated metadata tagging, health authority data mapping, and submission readiness tracking to ensure zero regulatory discrepancies
    • Stress-Test Scenario Curation: Build a comprehensive library of real-world regulatory scenarios, complex global submission sequences, and data edge cases to challenge and refine platform performance

Requirements

    • 7+ years of active experience in Regulatory Affairs or Regulatory Information Management (RIM) within a pharma, biotech, or CRO environment
    • Deep operational familiarity with global regulatory submission lifecycles (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA) and eCTD publishing standards
    • Strong, working knowledge of data maintenance requirements within mainstream RIM systems (e.g., Veeva Vault)
    • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a track record of translating complex regulatory requirements into actionable guidance for non-regulatory stakeholders
    • A passion for learning about agentic AI and an adaptive mindset regarding how automation can transform regulatory data compliance

Nice to Have

    • Prior experience contributing to system configurations, data migrations, or user-acceptance testing (UAT) for enterprise regulatory software deployments

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $120,000 - $180,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

Current-state analysis of the record-to-report processes with controllers and finance operations leads. Balance sheet auto-certification rules, controls, approvals and audit trail designed into the solution, so the automated close stands up to audit. Solution design ownership on at least one live Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance) implementation, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. 8 or more years in finance transformation, finance systems or record-to-report process design. jobs.description:
Principal AI Engineer
BuzzBoard · Remote (WFH) · Engineering / AIThe role
BuzzBoard builds AI products for the B2SMB market — helping agencies, media companies, and sellers understand small businesses and market to them at a level of personalization that wasn't previously economical. Our platform is built on frontier models end to end. Not AI features bolted onto a legacy product — the products are agent systems.
Our products span multi-agent marketing content generation, real-time AI voice intake, and pre- and post-sales intelligence for SMBs — Zylo, IRIS, Ignite, and Ember. They share a common internal pipeline for orchestration, retrieval, tool use, evaluation, and deployment.
This role owns the architecture underneath that pipeline. Not one feature — the shared layer every product depends on: how retrieval is built and measured, how agents reason and hold state and fail safely, which models run where and what happens when one degrades, how output quality is evaluated before it ships, and where the line sits between what a model decides and what deterministic code decides. You'll set that architecture, build the reusable patterns products inherit, guide the engineers implementing them, and own whether it holds up in production at volume.
It's a senior individual-contributor role. Two boundaries, stated plainly:
  • Not a research role. The deliverable is a shipped, reliable capability, not a paper or a demo.
  • Not a DevOps role. You need to be fluent in deployment and able to get a service into production, but full-time platform ownership sits elsewhere. Your center of gravity is AI system design.
If your GenAI experience is mostly notebooks and proofs of concept that never carried real traffic, this is not the role.
What you'll own
AI system architecture. Design the systems behind content generation, business intelligence, recommendations, and agentic workflows — including where the boundary sits between what a model decides and what deterministic code decides. Create reusable patterns, prompts, evaluation flows, and orchestration layers that hold up across products rather than being rebuilt per feature.
Agentic workflows. Lead the design of agents that reason, call tools and APIs, manage state, checkpoint, and hand tasks off cleanly. Build the guardrails that keep them grounded and predictable — the hard part is not making an agent act, it's making it fail safely and legibly when it's wrong.
Retrieval and model strategy. Design RAG pipelines end to end: chunking, embeddings, metadata, reranking, and retrieval evaluation that actually measures whether the right context arrived. Own model selection across ecosystems on the axes that matter — cost, latency, accuracy, reliability — and define the fallback and model-switching behavior for when a provider degrades.
Evaluation and quality. Stand up the evaluation frameworks that decide whether an AI output ships: output quality, edit ratio, hallucination rate, schema adherence, latency, failure rate, inference cost. Build regression testing so a prompt or model change can't silently break production. Turn “the output feels off” into a measured threshold.
Production readiness. Partner with engineering and platform teams so systems are deployable, observable, and maintainable. Package services (Python, FastAPI/Flask, Docker) when it's the fastest path, and diagnose the production failure modes specific to AI — rate limits, cost spikes, model failures, degraded output — rather than escalating them blind.
Technical leadership. Mentor GenAI engineers, review designs and prompts and workflows and evals, and translate product requirements into architecture with measurable acceptance criteria. Communicate the tradeoffs to engineers and to leadership in language each can act on.

What we're looking for
Required
  • 5+ years in engineering, AI, ML, or data-product work; 3+ years hands-on with GenAI / LLM systems
  • Production GenAI experience — non-negotiable. You have built or scaled systems that carried real traffic, and you can walk through one in detail: what broke, what it cost, what you changed.
  • Deep working knowledge of LLMs and SLMs: prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool and function calling
  • Hands-on with at least two major LLM ecosystems, and able to reason about the tradeoffs between them rather than defaulting to the one you know
  • RAG built for real: vector stores (Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, or equivalent), embeddings, semantic search, and retrieval quality you've actually measured
  • Hands-on with at least one agentic framework (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent) and the underlying concepts — memory, state, tool integration, failure handling — well enough to move across frameworks
  • Strong Python; comfortable with REST APIs, Docker, a cloud platform, and basic CI/CD
  • Demonstrated evaluation work: regression testing, hallucination checks, schema validation, output scoring — you can define metrics for quality, reliability, cost, and business impact
  • Track record guiding a small team or owning AI architecture end to end
  • Comfort creating structure in a fast-moving environment with shifting requirements

Lead and review external advisors

Own global tax compliance and reporting

Advise the business

  • Document tax processes and controls that meet audit standards

Why You’re a Great Fit

  • 8+ years of corporate tax experience, combining a Big 4 or national accounting firm with in-house work at a multinational company

  • Hands-on experience with US international tax (GILTI, Subpart F, foreign tax credits, Forms 5471 and 5472) and transfer pricing

  • Strong ASC 740 tax provision experience, including foreign entities

  • A track record of managing and reviewing outside tax advisors across several countries

  • Working knowledge of US federal and state tax, and the judgment to know when to bring in a specialist

  • Ability to explain tax issues clearly to non-tax colleagues and leadership

  • Comfort working independently as a team of one in a fast-paced company, across time zones

  • Helpful but not required: experience with consumer lending, banking or fintech, including tax treatment of interest, fees and credit losses; tax experience in Latin American or Asian markets; experience integrating acquired foreign companies; experience with NetSuite

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

The Tilt Way

About Us

Higharc is a VC-backed startup that is changing how new homes are designed and built. Join a founding team who’ve shipped products for Autodesk, Electronic Arts, Nike, and Apple. We have raised over $175M with support from top-notch venture capital firms and more than 18 strategic investors: industry leaders in construction, building products manufacturing, and distribution.

Higharc is seeking a hands-on Growth Lead to run the GTM experiment loop for our new self-serve business. This is a hybrid marketer and builder role: you’ll design tests against the self-serve funnel, build what’s needed to run them, interpret the results, and scale those that work.

What You’ll Do

Self-serve is a new business line at Higharc, and we’re placing bets in two parallel tracks, product and GTM. You’ll own the GTM experiment loop end to end. That means taking ideas from hypothesis to live test to a kill-or-scale decision fast.

You’ll build the landing pages, tooling, tracking, and automation each experiment needs, then judge the results with a sharp analytical eye. When something starts to feel magical, we shut down the weaker experiments and point more of the team at what’s working.

You’ll work closely with the Applications team and marketing, and both should see you as the fastest way to test an idea. The team works most often out of our Durham and NYC hubs.

Expect to:

  • Design and run rapid growth and PLG experiments across acquisition, activation, and conversion in the self-serve funnel

  • Build the landing pages, tooling, tracking, and automation needed to get each test live

  • Instrument the self-serve funnel well enough to see where people drop off and why

  • Interpret results and make fast kill-or-scale calls

  • Document and share experiment results so the team builds real signal over time

  • Move people and effort behind the experiments that work

  • Partner closely with the Applications team and marketing to turn ideas into live tests quickly and iteratively

About You

You’re part marketer, part builder, and your marketing instinct matters as much as your technical ability. You care more about speed and learning than polish, you’re fine throwing away work that didn’t pan out, and you can work with limited direction in a brand-new business line.

You own outcomes, stay steady when things are ambiguous, and can tell real signal from noise.

You have:

  • Experience shipping growth experiments end to end, ideally in a PLG or self-serve product

  • Hands-on technical skills: you’re comfortable writing code and working with analytics, automation, and AI tooling

  • Marketing instinct that carries as much weight as your technical ability

  • Strong analytical judgment and the honesty to call a failed test a failure

  • A preference for speed over polish

  • Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to work with limited direction

  • A strong sense of ownership over the work and its results

A major plus if you also bring:

  • Experience building for or selling to homebuilders, or working in construction or AEC software

Working at Higharc

Remote work and travel: Our company is entirely remote, and has been since we were founded in 2018. Remote work means more time with family, less time commuting, and the flexibility to blend work and life. We value in-person collaboration and asynchronous deep-work time, which is why we schedule regular team meet-ups in our hubs across the US and, depending on the role, prioritize hiring in those hubs. If your role requires frequent travel beyond pre-scheduled team meet ups, we will represent that to the best of our ability as early as possible in the interview process.

Compensation and benefits: Higharc offers competitive salaries with significant equity, in a fast-growing, well-funded company. We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with flexible PTO, and meaningful maternity/paternity leave to all U.S based employees that are full-time. You'll also have access to other big-company benefits such like short and long-term disability plans and a 401K. We also provide a stipend to create the ideal home office and support ongoing L&D.

Job Type: Contractor

Job Summary

We are seeking active food delivery app users to contribute to an AI training project focused on improving AI systems' understanding of user behavior, restaurant discovery, and food delivery experiences. In this role, you will provide realistic user scenarios, evaluate app search results and recommendations, and offer constructive feedback to improve AI performance.   1. Experience in beta testing, usability testing, or user research for mobile applications or digital platforms.
  2. Background or interest in user experience (UX), artificial intelligence (AI), or digital product feedback.
  3. Experience using multiple food delivery platforms across different markets.
  4. Strong analytical and structured reasoning skills, including the ability to formulate and answer complex queries about app interactions.

jobs.excerpt: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution.
jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We're taking Keet to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. Product sets the direction. We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up at global scale.

You lead the teams that build Keet's features: the API team, which adds feature-focused APIs to Keet's core, and the frontend team, which builds the React app on top, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product.

You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for distributed, local-first systems, so you can work fluently on top of a P2P engine without needing to build it yourself.

Responsabilities

Engineering

  • Run the API and frontend teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.

  • Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.

  • Own the technical design of features and the API surface between Keet's core and the app.

  • Make sure the API team works closely with our deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches the engine.

Product Partnership

  • Work alongside Keet's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.

  • Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.

  • Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially where P2P opens doors that centralized apps can't.

  • Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

Leadership

  • Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.

  • Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.

  • Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

Requirements

  • Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally in chat, calling, or social apps.

  • Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

  • Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. Offline-first and eventual consistency should feel natural. You don't need P2P protocol expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

  • Deep JavaScript and React.

  • Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

  • Bonus: experience with local-first apps, CRDTs or sync engines, offline-capable mobile or desktop apps, or open source.

An overview of the role

GitLab is seeking an experienced Principal Field Security Engineer to tackle complex customer security challenges at the intersection of technical architecture and business requirements. You'll work directly with customers and internal teams to provide technical guidance, create security content, and help customers understand how GitLab's security controls meet their compliance and risk management needs.

jobs.excerpt: At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.
jobs.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

About Us:

At CI&T, our rapid growth is fueled by the innovative solutions we create for our global clients. We are seeking a Master DataOps Engineer to own the operational backbone — environments, CI/CD, and monitoring — for a large-scale Finance data platform modernization at a major US mortgage lender, so the platform being built is reliable and cost-governed from day one, not bolted on at the end.

Responsibilities:

Environment Provisioning & Platform Readiness

  • Own end-to-end environment provisioning and platform readiness across the full data stack — from SQL Server CDC source through Snowflake landing, raw, and curated layers — ahead of and during the build, with a formal readiness checklist delivered before sensitive-data build begins.

  • Provision and maintain Snowflake environments (DEV → QA → UAT → Prod) with dedicated, right-sized warehouses per workload class — replication/ingestion, curated-layer transformation, and BI serving — each with auto-suspend, resource monitors, and cost attribution from day one.

  • Coordinate Azure infrastructure provisioning: Virtual Networks, NSGs, Private Endpoints, Azure Key Vault, self-hosted Azure DevOps agents, and VM infrastructure for the CDC replication tool — including firewall rules, TLS certificate requests, and DNS resolution for private Snowflake endpoints, all with documented lead times surfaced proactively.

  • Manage Snowflake RBAC provisioning: dedicated project-specific role hierarchy, clearly separated from broad IT, developer, analyst, and AI roles; positive and negative access tests executed before the environment is handed over to the build team.

  • Manage the full vendor and service account access lifecycle: named, individual, time-bound, least-privilege access for all delivery personnel; dedicated non-personal service accounts for replication, Snowflake, and BI integrations; credential storage and rotation via Azure Key Vault; revocation with documented evidence at engagement end.

CI/CD Pipeline Engineering

  • Build and operate the CI/CD pipeline for all data artifacts — transformation logic, metric definitions, replication configurations, Snowflake object DDL, and versioned SQL transformation models — using Azure DevOps Pipelines with YAML-based, version-controlled pipeline definitions.

  • Enforce a DEV → QA → UAT → Prod promotion path with branch policies, required reviewers, build validation on PRs, and written approval gates before any production deployment — no silent or automatic production changes.

  • Integrate automated regression, schema validation, row-count checks, and data quality assertions at every promotion stage — not only before go-live.

  • Externalize all environment-specific configuration from code; integrate Azure DevOps Variable Groups linked to Azure Key Vault so no credentials are stored as plaintext in pipeline definitions or repository files.

  • Integrate code scanning, dependency scanning, and IaC scanning (e.g., Checkov, Microsoft Defender for DevOps) into CI pipelines; remediate or formally document exceptions for all material findings before promotion to production.

  • Design, document, and rehearse rollback procedures for every promotion stage, including a full mock cutover and rollback rehearsal before the production readiness gate.

Monitoring, Alerting & Observability

  • Implement and own end-to-end pipeline monitoring using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics: replication health, CDC lag alerts, replication agent availability, Snowflake warehouse freshness against agreed SLA targets, schema-change and drift detection events at the landing zone, and semantic-definition change alerts.

  • Configure Azure Monitor Alert Rules routed via Action Groups to the client's approved ITSM tool (e.g., ServiceNow), with named alert owners, defined thresholds, and documented escalation paths — every alert fully operable by the client's DataOps team without vendor involvement post-handoff.

  • Enable and maintain Diagnostic Settings on all Azure resources (Key Vault, VMs, NSGs, Storage Accounts) feeding a centralized Log Analytics Workspace with appropriate retention, access control, and audit trails covering authentication, access grants, configuration changes, and deployments.

  • Implement Snowflake resource monitors and Azure Cost Management budget alerts for cost anomaly detection; produce periodic FinOps attribution reports by workload class.

Platform Cost Governance & FinOps

  • Own platform cost attribution and consumption monitoring across all Snowflake warehouses and Azure compute resources, with per-workload attribution established from day one using a consistent resource tagging strategy enforced via IaC.

  • Deliver a Snowflake and Azure cost model at architecture gate, including monitored budgets, right-sizing recommendations, and auto-suspend configurations — not estimated retrospectively.

  • Conduct periodic right-sizing reviews using Azure Advisor and Snowflake usage data; present findings in structured FinOps reviews with the client's Cloud Architecture team.

Infrastructure as Code

  • Manage all Azure infrastructure as code using Terraform (or Bicep where appropriate), including VNets, NSGs, Key Vault, VMs, storage accounts, Entra ID service principals, and RBAC role assignments — no manual portal configurations for anything that belongs in the production baseline.

  • Manage Snowflake object provisioning (databases, schemas, warehouses, roles, resource monitors) via the Snowflake Terraform provider, maintaining remote state in Azure Blob Storage with state locking.

  • Enforce configuration standards via Azure Policy guardrails (e.g., soft-delete on Key Vault, no public IPs on data resources, mandatory resource tagging) so IaC deployments are validated against policy before they reach production.

Architecture & Operational Documentation

  • Maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and other living delivery artifacts alongside the Lead Architect — including network and connectivity design, environment topology, CI/CD promotion model, and security access design — in client-controlled repositories from the first commit.

  • Write and validate operational runbooks covering: replication failure, recovery, and resynchronization; CDC lag breach response; deployment and rollback procedures; reconciliation-discrepancy triage; access request and revocation workflows; cost-anomaly response; and incident routing via client ITSM — each exercised with the client's DataOps team before final handoff acceptance.

Knowledge Transfer & Client Engagement

  • Drive progressive knowledge transfer from the architecture phase onward through paired working sessions, shadowed deployments, and runbook exercises — not a single end-of-project handoff.

  • Act as the named point of contact for platform operations across the delivery team and the client's DataOps, Cloud Architecture, Infrastructure/Network, and Information Security teams — translating technical platform concerns into clear client-facing communications in fluent English.

  • Quantify and track client infrastructure dependencies — Snowflake environments, Azure network paths, service accounts, replication tool licensing, and production change windows — with named need-by dates and schedule-impact statements, escalating proactively when readiness is at risk.

Requirements:

  • Solid, hands-on experience in DataOps or platform engineering roles supporting a production cloud data platform end-to-end — covering provisioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and operational handoff.

  • Strong CI/CD experience for data pipelines: Azure DevOps Pipelines (YAML), Git-based workflows with branch policies and approval gates, automated testing and regression gates, and multi-environment promotion paths.

  • Azure infrastructure fluency: Virtual Networks, NSGs, Private Link and Private Endpoints, Azure Key Vault (secrets, certificates, and rotation), Microsoft Entra ID (service principals, managed identities, PIM, and access reviews), Azure Monitor and Log Analytics, and Azure Cost Management.

  • Infrastructure as Code: hands-on Terraform experience including remote state management on Azure Blob Storage, the Snowflake Terraform provider, and IaC security scanning integrated into CI pipelines.

  • Snowflake platform experience: RBAC design, warehouse sizing and segregation, resource monitors, row-access policies, and dynamic data masking — experience across Enterprise or Business Critical editions preferred.

  • CDC replication pipeline monitoring and operations: experience monitoring and alerting on a CDC-based replication pipeline in production, including lag monitoring, restart and recovery procedures, and schema-drift detection at the landing layer.

  • Secrets management discipline: experience managing pipeline credentials via Azure Key Vault with no plaintext credentials in repositories or pipeline definitions, and documented rotation procedures.

  • Security-aware development practices: experience integrating code scanning, dependency scanning, and IaC scanning into CI pipelines; familiarity with least-privilege access design and audit logging requirements in regulated or sensitive-data environments.

  • Platform cost governance as a named responsibility: experience owning FinOps attribution, budget alerts, and right-sizing reviews — not as a shared or ambient concern.

  • Fluent English (B2+): this role is the named client-facing point of contact for all platform operations topics across delivery and client teams.

Nice to Have

  • Qlik Replicate: hands-on configuration of full-load and CDC replication — source and target endpoint setup, table scoping, schema-evolution handling, throttling and change-window management, latency monitoring, and restart and recovery procedures.

  • Azure SQL Server / SQL Server on Azure VM: familiarity with CDC prerequisites (SQL Server Agent, capture jobs, and service account permissions), connectivity requirements for private Azure environments, and coordination with DBA teams on change windows and backup schedules.

  • Microsoft Fabric / OneLake: operational experience with capacity management, landing-zone health, and monitoring in a Fabric environment.

  • Azure ExpressRoute and hybrid networking: experience designing or operating the connectivity layer between on-premises SQL Server instances and cloud-hosted data infrastructure.

  • Microsoft Entra ID Privileged Identity Management (PIM): experience implementing just-in-time access with approval workflows and audit trails for vendor and contractor access in a client environment.

  • Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central / SQL Server source systems: familiarity with Business Central table structures, company-prefixed naming conventions, and schema-drift risk from vendor-managed upgrades.

  • Power BI semantic model operations: familiarity with workspace publication, scheduled refresh configuration, and gateway management in a governed enterprise deployment.

  • Production runbook authorship and knowledge transfer facilitation: demonstrated experience writing runbooks that a client's operations team can execute without vendor support, and leading structured knowledge transfer with competency-evidence checkpoints.

  • Mortgage, lending, or financial-services environments: experience operating under strict change-control discipline with sensitive financial data and audit-trail requirements covering every access and deployment event.

  • dbt or dbt-style versioned SQL transformation frameworks: experience operating dbt in a CI/CD pipeline — running tests, managing model promotion, and debugging failed runs in a Snowflake environment.

jobs.description:
Join our expanding Product Growth team! We’re actively recruiting a Senior CRM Manager as we continue to scale at M-KOPA. Most senior growth hires get one channel and one pod for years. This role is built differently: you’ll own two of our core growth pods in your first year, then land where you’ve had the most impact. It’s a fast track to pod leadership, not a support seat.

The Impact 💚

You’ll drive the conversion growth that turns customers into long-term, high-value ones, creating financial inclusion for Africa’s traditionally excluded. We’ve already helped over 10 million customers access over $2 billion in credit 🌍

The Opportunity

🏗️ Real ownership from day one. You'll be the one accountable for delivery in Repeat Phones, not shadowing or supporting someone else's plan.

🎒 Two growth motions, one year. You'll take on Digital Lending mid-way through, working directly with one of our strongest performers to understand cash loans end to end, then carry that pod solo for a defined stretch. Few people get this breadth this early.

🧭 A defined path, not indefinite floating. You'll build real expertise in our two conversion pods first, then move into Lifecycle in the second half of next year, reporting to the Lifecycle CRM Lead once you're there. The destination is set. What you bring to it is up to you. 🌍 Work inside a proven CLV engine. M-KOPA has helped more than 10 million customers access over $2 billion in credit. You'll be executing inside systems that already work, not guessing at what might.

What You'll Do

Phase 1: Repeat Phones. Take ownership of reactivation and upgrade campaigns in CleverTap, working closely with the Growth Lead there to understand what's driving the pod's numbers and where the next opportunity is. You'll be trusted to make real calls here, not just execute a checklist.

Phase 2: Cross into Digital Lending. Work directly with the Digital Lending lead, one of our top performers, to understand cash loan growth end to end before taking it on yourself.

Phase 3: Own Digital Lending. Carry primary responsibility for Digital Lending for a defined period, with the Repeat Phones lead available if you need a second opinion.

Phase 4: Move into Lifecycle. In the second half of next year, join the Lifecycle pod full-time, reporting to the Lifecycle CRM Lead. You'll bring a year of hands-on conversion experience into a pod that's still being built, real currency for shaping what Lifecycle does next. Throughout all phases, you will:

  • Build and run multi-channel campaigns (SMS, WhatsApp, push, in-app) in CleverTap against pod goals

  • Track funnel performance and flag drop-off points to the pod lead you're supporting

  • Run structured experiments (creative, audience, incentive, or timing) with clear hypotheses

  • Turn what works into documented playbooks the next person can pick up

  • Keep data quality and campaign tracking clean enough that leadership can trust the numbers

Key Metrics You'll Influence

Repeat Phones: Reactivation rate, upgrade conversion %, unit economics per sale

Digital Lending: Approval → disbursement rate, digital loan volume, approval quality

Campaign ROI and payback period across both

Your Environment

💼 Tech Stack: CleverTap (primary), Looker Channels: WhatsApp, SMS, push, in-app messaging

Markets: Kenya, Nigeria, Uganda, Ghana

What You Need

  • 5+ years in growth, performance, or lifecycle marketing, ideally in fintech, telco, or e-commerce, with real ownership over what a campaign or a pod achieved, not just involvement in it.

  • Judgment as much as skill. You can walk into a pod, understand what's working and why, and make calls on where to push, not just follow a brief.

  • Genuine appetite for pod leadership. This is a deliberate path toward owning a pod outright, and the breadth here is designed to get you there faster than a single-channel role would.

  • Hands-on fluency in CRM platforms like CleverTap, Braze, or similar, and comfortable reading a funnel or cohort without translation.

  • Energized, not unsettled, by ambiguity. You'll work across two pods and land in a third decision point by mid-year. If that sounds like an opportunity rather than a risk, you'll thrive here.

  • Strong enough presence to build trust quickly with senior leads across two different pods.

Location & Benefits

  • 🌍 Fully remote role within UTC -1 to UTC +3 time zones

  • 🤝 Work with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa

  • 📚 Professional development programmes and coaching partnerships

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

  • 💚 Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

Our Impact 💚

Our technology has created measurable change:

  • Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected

  • Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use M-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000+ livelihoods created for agents

  • Green 🌱: 2.1 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided through clean energy products, with over 127,700 circular economy products provided

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at .

Important Notice

Music & Sound Annotation Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Job Description

We are seeking Music & Sound Annotation Experts to contribute to a project focused on advancing music and audio technology.

In this role, you will listen to short field recordings and accurately document audible details, including instruments, tempo, musical key, background sounds, and crowd reactions. You will use a structured web-based platform to complete annotations and, in later project phases, evaluate AI-generated descriptions against the actual audio recordings.

    • Relevant audio scene details.

  1. At least 3 years of hands-on experience in music or audio-related work.
  2. Strong analytical listening skills, with the ability to identify individual instruments in busy, noisy, real-world audio recordings—not just studio recordings.
  3. Ability to identify tempo within a few BPM and recognize musical keys. Relative pitch with a reference is acceptable.
  4. Comfort with detailed and repetitive annotation tasks using web-based platforms, including dropdowns, timestamps, and structured notes.

In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as a Senior Video Editing Quality Assurance Specialist (SME) to review and evaluate AI-generated and human-edited video content, ensuring professional post-production quality, technical accuracy, visual consistency, and adherence to project-specific guidelines.You will assess video outputs for editing quality, pacing, continuity, transitions, color grading, audio synchronization, storytelling, technical specifications, and overall production standards. This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world's largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your professional video editing expertise will directly help improve the world's premier AI models by making their video understanding, editing, and generation capabilities more accurate, consistent, and aligned with professional production standards.Portfolio requirementMandatory: As a part of selection process, applicants must ready to provide a working link to a professional video demo reel or portfolio that can be accessed by the SuperAnnotate team.The portfolio should demonstrate professional editing capabilities, preferably including commercial, broadcast, film, television, or advanced digital video projects.

Your profile

  • 5+ years of professional video editing experience in film, television, broadcast, advertising, commercial production, digital media, or related post-production environments.
  • English proficiency at C1–C2 level to understand complex project guidelines, communicate technical feedback, and provide detailed written evaluations in English.
  • Advanced proficiency in at least two non-linear editing (NLE) systems, with Adobe Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve strongly preferred. Experience with Avid Media Composer or Final Cut Pro is also valuable.

  • Experience with color correction, color grading, audio editing, synchronization, sound mixing, subtitles, captions, and motion graphics.
  • Ability to identify subtle editing defects, including jump cuts, continuity errors, dropped frames, audio drift, inconsistent color, compression artifacts, inappropriate transitions, and technical delivery issues.

jobs.excerpt: About SunStrong Management SunStrong Management is an independent asset manager for renewable energy infrastructure — roughly 6 GW under management, including more than 500,000 residential solar and storage systems and 900+ commercial and utility-scale assets across 50+ markets.
jobs.description:
About SunStrong Management

SunStrong Management is an independent asset manager for renewable energy infrastructure — roughly 6 GW under management, including more than 500,000 residential solar and storage systems and 900+ commercial and utility-scale assets across 50+ markets. We sit between asset owners and the day-to-day reality of keeping systems online: operations and maintenance, field service, customer care, billing and collections, and investor reporting.

We were built by solar-industry veterans who stepped in to keep systems producing when others stepped back. We are growing quickly — through portfolio acquisitions and organic expansion — and we run one operational standard at every scale. We make decisions with data, we measure what we manage, and we expect the systems we build to prove their value in the numbers.

The Opportunity

For most homeowners, the mobile app is SunStrong. It is where they pay a bill, ask a question, book a technician, and check whether the system on their roof is doing its job. Today that experience is fragmented. Many of the 500,000+ homeowners we serve came to us through the failure of the companies that installed and financed their systems, and they inherited those companies' apps along with their solar. Some of those apps still run, some run poorly, and none were designed to work together or to be part of one coherent customer experience.

We are hiring a Product Manager, Consumer and Mobile Applications to own the vision, roadmap, and execution for everything homeowners touch on their phones. You will decide how to absorb and gracefully evolve the legacy applications we have taken on — what to keep running, what to migrate, what to retire, and how to move customers without losing their trust — and you will build entirely new capability on top: customer care, bill payment, field service requests, and independent monitoring of a homeowner's own generation assets, free of any single OEM's portal.

This role reports to the VP of Product Management and works directly with Customer Care, Servicing and Collections, Field Service Operations, Fleet Telemetry, Engineering, Legal and Compliance, and the design team. The goal is plain: make SunStrong the industry leader in elegant self-service for homeowners, measured by adoption, resolution without a phone call, and on-time payment.

What You'll Do

Set the vision and roadmap
  • Own the product vision, strategy, and multi-quarter roadmap for SunStrong's homeowner-facing mobile and web applications, and defend the sequencing to executive stakeholders and operating teams.
  • Define the end-to-end homeowner experience across care, payment, service, and monitoring, so that the product feels like one SunStrong rather than a collection of inherited parts.
Absorb and evolve the legacy applications
  • Inventory the inherited consumer apps from bankrupt providers — what each does, who still uses it, what it costs to run, and what risk it carries — and decide which to sustain, migrate, consolidate, or retire.
  • Plan and lead customer migrations that preserve trust: account and credential continuity, payment-method and autopay transfers, communication plans, store listing and release management, and clear sunset dates.
  • Evaluate build, buy, and partner options for the target platform, and document the recommendation, its basis, and the operating cost of each path.
Build the next generation of homeowner self-service
  • Deliver elegant self-service for customer care, including account management, case creation and status, knowledge and guided troubleshooting, and handoff to an agent when the app cannot resolve the issue.
  • Deliver bill pay and billing transparency: invoices, payment methods, autopay, payment plans, and delinquency communications that are clear, compliant, and respectful of the customer.
  • Deliver field service requests end to end: request, scheduling, technician tracking, and resolution, integrated with the Field Service and Salesforce teams.
  • Define independent monitoring for homeowners' own generation and storage assets, working with Fleet Telemetry so that production, system health, and alerts are accurate and are not tied to any single OEM portal.
Lead with data
  • Define and own the metrics this product is accountable for: monthly active users, legacy-to-SunStrong migration rate, self-service resolution and call-deflection rate, on-time payment and autopay adoption, field-service request completion, app store rating, crash-free sessions, and cost to serve.
  • Instrument features before launch, run experiments, and report on realized value after release rather than only on delivery.
  • Run continuous discovery with homeowners, customer care agents, and field technicians, and bring evidence rather than opinion to prioritization debates.
Operate across the organization
  • Serve as the connective tissue between Customer Care, Servicing and Collections, Field Service Operations, Fleet Telemetry, Engineering, Design, Legal and Compliance, and external vendors.
  • Ensure the products meet the obligations attached to consumer servicing: PCI-DSS for payment handling, consumer privacy and consent, accessibility, FDCPA and UDAAP considerations in collections communications, and app store policy requirements.
  • Write requirements engineers can build from on the first pass, own launch readiness including data migration, testing, support training, and adoption, and communicate trade-offs clearly to audiences from customer care agents to the executive team.
What Success Looks Like

First 30 days — You have inventoried every inherited and current consumer application, quantified usage, cost, and risk for each, and talked with homeowners and care agents about where the experience breaks. The VP of Product Management and operating leaders are aligned behind a prioritized problem inventory and a proposed disposition (sustain, migrate, or retire) for each legacy app.

First 90 days — A published, funded 12-month roadmap and target-state experience; a build, buy, or partner decision made and approved; the first legacy-app migration underway with a defined sunset date; and one new self-service capability in production with measured movement on a named baseline metric.

12 months — A majority of homeowners who use an app are on the unified SunStrong experience; legacy apps with a retirement plan are retired or on a dated path to it; and bill pay, care, and field service requests are available in-app. Call deflection, on-time payment, and app store ratings have improved against the baselines, and the first independent monitoring release is in homeowners' hands.

Required Qualifications
  • 6+ years in product management, owning consumer-facing software products end to end — discovery through launch and iteration.
  • 3+ years owning native mobile applications (iOS and Android) in production, including app store release management, versioning, and the day-to-day realities of supporting a live consumer user base.
  • Demonstrated experience with transactional consumer flows such as account management, payments or billing, and customer support, where accuracy and trust matter as much as polish.
  • Experience migrating, consolidating, or sunsetting applications or platforms — moving real users from an old product to a new one without losing them.
  • Strong analytical skills: SQL fluency, product analytics, and experimentation, with the habit of defining success metrics before building.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to move between engineering detail and executive summary without losing either audience.
  • A track record of leading cross-functional initiatives to completion and earning followership without formal authority.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in solar, distributed energy, utilities, telecom, or another business with a large installed base and a field service component.
  • Experience building monitoring or device-data experiences for consumers, including production dashboards, alerting, and connected-device or IoT applications.
  • Experience in consumer financial services or fintech subject to payments and collections regulation (PCI-DSS, FDCPA, UDAAP, state requirements).
  • Experience integrating customer-facing apps with Salesforce Field Service and Service Cloud, billing, ERP, or payments platforms.
  • Experience integrating products and customers following an acquisition or portfolio transition.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG), design systems, and applying AI to customer self-service, such as guided troubleshooting and agent handoff.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, computer science, design, or a related field; advanced degree welcome but not required.
Location: San Francisco, CA · Houston, TX · or Remote (U.S.)

About XPUP

Všechno začalo docela jednoduše: hledali jsme lidi s těmi správnými digitálními dovednostmi, nemohli jsme je najít, tak jsme si řekli – výborně, vyškolíme si je sami.

Z toho malého projektu v Tbilisi v roce 2018 vyrostla globální Edtech platforma s více než 30 000 absolventy.

Naše programy tvoří lidé z praxe. Vycházejí z toho, co firmy opravdu potřebují. A učíme v prostředí, kde se spolupracuje, ptá se a roste.

V roce 2023 jsme se dali dohromady sTetherem, abychom to, co děláme, posunuli dál – za hranice, k lidem po celém světě, kteří chtějí vzdělávání, které je skutečně posune.

Dnes připravujeme novou generaci digitálních profesionálů: marketéry, designéry, programátory, tvůrce. Lidi, kteří nechtějí jen práci, ale chtějí něco měnit. Držíme se hodnot, kterými opravdu žijeme: lidé jsou na prvním místě, zůstáváme zvědaví, děláme skvělou práci a bereme za ni odpovědnost. A teď to teprve začíná.

Lead máme. Zájem máme. Teď potřebujeme někoho, kdo to umí dotáhnout.

Hledáme zkušeného closera, který dokáže ty, co zvažují změnu, dovést k samotnému rozhodnutí investovat do sebe samých.

Tahle role není o „péči o zákazníka“. Je to role s jasnou orientací na výsledky revenue, konverze a počet zapsaných studentů. Jde tu o tah na branku, práci s rozhodováním a uzavírání obchodů.

Co budeš dělat

Budeš mluvit s lidmi, kteří už o změně přemýšlí – chtějí novou kariéru, lepší skillset, posun v životě.

Tvůj úkol?

  • Pomoci jim přestat váhat a udělat konkrétní krok – koupit si kurz

  • Povedeš celý proces od prvního callu až po zaplacení

  • Budeš pracovat s inboundem, outboundem i vlastní pipeline

  • Budeš řídit tempo, ne čekat

  • Poradíš si s námitkami (cena, čas, důvěra, konkurence) denodenně

  • Tady se nehraje na „ozvi se, až budeš ready“

  • Tady se rozhodnutí dělají teď a s tebou

Requirements

Co od tebe potřebujeme

  • Min. 3 roky v B2C sales, kde jsi nesl/a target

  • Zkušenost s prodejem vzdělávání nebo služeb, kde se zákazník rozmýšlí

  • Reálné výsledky – ne pocit, ale čísla

  • Schopnost jet samostatně a neztrácet tempo

  • Rozumíš tomu, jak přemýšlí český zákazník

  • Umíš prodat hodnotu, ne cenu

  • A když přijde námitka, víš, že to není konec, ale začátek práce

Tohle není pro tebe, pokud:

  • Čekáš, až se zákazník rozhodne sám

  • Potřebuješ skripty na každou větu

  • Prodáváš hlavně slevou

  • Máš zkušenosti spíš z B2B než z přímého prodeje lidem

Co za to

  • Remote spolupráce

  • Velká míra svobody

  • Přístup ke všem našim kurzům + benefity pro rodinu

  • Referral program

  • Paid Time Off

  • Tým, kde se maká – ale zároveň drží při sobě
