About Phase2 and this role

Our remote first employees join and stay at Phase2 to be a force. In pursuit of digital experience that advances the Phase2 is a technology partner that builds digital and AI products for organizations where the stakes are high and the margin for error is small. From healthcare to financial giants to global enterprises, industry leaders rely on us to deliver the digital experiences, products, and platforms that matter most. And build what's next. Today, we are putting AI into production, building on the same trusted foundations we've been engineering for 25 years.

We're hiring a Senior Account Director, In-Account Growth, to be that partner for a portfolio of existing and newly signed clients. You'll own the relationships, spot the next problem worth solving, shape the technical solution, and close the deal. This is a quota-carrying role with a $7M+ annual sales target.

This role reports to the SVP, Account Management.

How we work with clients

Every engagement is shaped around a specific client problem, and you own your accounts end to end. You sit with clients to understand what's getting in their way, then bring the technical depth to shape the answer: how the solution is architected, what data and cloud infrastructure it depends on, and what's feasible before it reaches a proposal. You scope it, price it, and stand behind it. After the signature you stay close through delivery, escalations, and renewals, keep the account healthy, and turn every win into the next opportunity. You own the sales strategy for your accounts, build the value story executives will fund, and bring the market insight that shows clients why now.

Core strengths for this role

AI fluency across product and tech. You know how AI systems are put together: the models, retrieval, orchestration, and the cloud infrastructure that makes them run. You can talk use cases fluently with a business leader, then go just as deep on context engineering and semantic data with their architects.

A working grasp of modern platforms and data. You know how DXPs, cloud, data platforms, and integrations fit together, and why modernization efforts stall. You can follow a solution architect's whiteboard and explain it to a CFO.

Experience-led thinking. You see how customer experience, content, and marketing technology drive business results, and you can connect a CMO's goals to a CTO's roadmap in the same account.

Consultative deal leadership. You diagnose before you prescribe. You shape custom engagements with our experts, price them around outcomes, and build the business case that gets executives to commit.

Proactive ideation. You don't wait for clients to come to you. You seek them out and build a flywheel of referrals and outreach inside each account, turning one team's win into an introduction to the next team, department, or business unit. You bring clients new ideas, a point of view on what they should do next, and a clear case for why it matters, often before they've recognized the need themselves.

Market and industry insight. You're the person who sees a new model or agent framework and immediately thinks about which client it could help. You know where AI is heading, you get excited about putting it to work in Phase2's emerging solution areas, and you share what you learn with our teams as readily as you bring it to clients as a point of view on why now. You also know our clients operate where the stakes are high and the margin for error is small, so you sell trust as confidently as innovation. AI built on Phase2's trust pillars, with trusted data, connected systems, and the right safeguards, is AI they can put into production and stand behind.

Trusted partnership. You build relationships that last beyond the deal, earning trust from client executives and from the Phase2 teams who deliver the work.

What you'll do

Grow your accounts

  • Build and close $7M+ in your first 12 months by growing your accounts: expanding into new departments, business units, and service lines, and bringing clients larger, more strategic programs that build on the work already in place
  • Know your clients' business well enough to see the next problem before they ask, and build the case for solving it
  • Run the full cycle yourself: discovery, qualification, solution shaping, proposal, negotiation, and close. You price around the outcomes and impact you deliver, not just the hours it takes
  • Keep your Salesforce pipeline accurate and your forecast something leadership can plan around

Shape the deal with the people who'll deliver it

  • Work side by side with solution architects, strategists, and delivery leads to scope work that is ambitious, realistic, and profitable
  • Price custom engagements, including outcome-based and roadmap-driven models, not just hours
  • Write and present proposals and SOWs that executives will fund and our teams can deliver
  • Handle procurement, legal, security reviews, and compliance questions common in healthcare and life sciences

Be the client's trusted advisor

  • Build relationships across the C-suite and the teams below them, in both marketing and technology
  • Turn AI, data, and platform capabilities into plain business outcomes: revenue, cost, risk, speed
  • Stay close to active engagements: lead regular account relationship calls, support the project team, and keep a steady read on client health, so you catch issues early and see the next opportunity first
  • Own escalations with confidence, bringing the client and our team together and constructively challenging both to reach the best possible outcome
  • Make sure client wins are visible inside Phase2, and help marketing turn them into case studies

Represent Phase2 in the market

  • Co-sell with platform and technology partners at the executive level
  • Speak at industry events, conferences, and panels as a recognized voice on AI and digital transformation, influencing the conversation and elevating Phase2's position in the market
  • Travel to client sites, Phase2 gatherings, and events as needed (typically up to 25%)

What you bring

  • 10+ years selling and growing accounts at a technical or product-focused agency, systems integrator, or technology consultancy. You've sold work that a team of people then delivered.
  • A proven track record of leading client portfolios worth $7M+ a year and growing them by expanding into new areas of the business
  • Experience scoping and pricing custom engagements with delivery teams, including SOWs, retainers, or outcome-based models
  • Real fluency in today's technology landscape: DXPs and CMS platforms, cloud, data platforms, integrations, and how enterprise AI systems are built and governed. You can translate technical solutions into clear business terms.
  • Comfort selling to both marketing and technology leaders, often in the same account
  • Experience influencing senior executives through insight, clear writing, and sound negotiation
  • You use AI as an accelerator in your own work, to sharpen account research, build stronger points of view, and move faster from idea to proposal, amplifying what you can deliver for every account

What will set you apart

  • You've sold AI, data, or platform modernization work that actually made it to production, and can tell us what made it stick
  • You've worked in regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences, pharma, or financial services, government, and know how HIPAA, FDA, privacy, and security reviews shape a deal
  • You have hands-on experience with Drupal, Optimizely, Adobe Experience Manager, Sitecore, or similar DXPs, or with Epic and EHR integration
  • You've navigated legacy systems, organizational resistance, and competing priorities to get a client to commit
  • You can create urgency: you can explain why a client needs to act now, not next fiscal year
  • You have a visible point of view on AI or digital transformation through speaking, writing, or panels
  • You've co-sold with platform or cloud partners

What success looks like

  • You hit or beat $7M+ in annual sales
  • Your pipeline is real: qualified, active, and forecastable
  • Clients treat you as a strategic partner who shapes their roadmap, not a vendor who answers RFPs
  • Leadership trusts you with the most complex, highest-stakes opportunities

Compensation

  • Base salary: $115,000–$160,000
  • On-target earnings (OTE): $165,000–$240,000
  • Commission: $50,000–$80,000 a year at 100% of quota, uncapped

Salary is based on experience, skills, certifications, and current market conditions.

What you'll get

  • Fully remote: work from anywhere with a remote-first team and a flexible culture
  • Comprehensive benefits: medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability, plus supplemental options through Aflac and Transamerica
  • Wellness program: rewards for participation
  • 401(k): 3% employer contribution, no match required, 100% vested after 90 days
  • Time off: 16 vacation days, 4 personal days, and 1 volunteer day to start, increasing with tenure
  • Paid parental leave: up to 12 weeks fully paid for birthing parents and up to 6 weeks fully paid bonding leave, based on tenure, including adoption and foster placement, with the option to extend through unpaid leave
  • Family-building support: fertility, adoption, and surrogacy benefits through Kindbody, plus virtual health coaching and care navigation
  • Home office stipend: $500 to set up your workspace

What the environment looks like

Physical demands

  • Frequently remain in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for long periods
  • Occasionally adjust or move light objects up to 20 pounds
  • Continuous communication on video calls, phone, email, and messaging platforms
  • Continuous repetitive movements of the wrists, hands, and fingers
  • Travel, sometimes frequent, is expected

Mental demands

  • Comprehension: understand directions, follow established procedures, and synthesize information from clients and colleagues; may recommend improvements to procedures
  • Organization: gather, classify, and store information from conversations, then recall, interpret, and explain it quickly
  • Reasoning and decision making: use logic to analyze information and prioritize
  • Communication: exchange ideas clearly with colleagues and clients
  • Resilience: adapt well under workplace stress

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is hiring a Senior Supply Planner to oversee the hardware supply planning process for the global market. The Senior Supply Planner will be responsible for developing and maintaining rolling 12-month production, shipment, and capacity plans; working with Demand Planning, Global Ops Engineering, Production Procurement, Order Operations and Finance; and calculating the implications on financial liabilities and inventory levels. This is a highly visible role that offers an opportunity to make business-critical decisions that will improve customer service levels while minimizing inventory costs.

This is a remote role open to candidates residing in the US except Alaska, Austin Metro, Boulder Metro, California, Chicago Metro, Connecticut, Dallas Metro, Denver Metro, Houston Metro, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Seattle Metro, and Washington, D.C.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development and countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Convert the demand plan into supply plans and targets by SKU, region, and DC, aligned to revenue and cost objectives.
  • Drive capacity planning with Global Ops Engineering: maintain rolling 12-month production and capacity plans and recommend tradeoffs when capacity or components are constrained.
  • Influence Clear to Build (CTB) for your portfolio: work with Production Procurement to confirm components and materials are available, and flag shortages early.
  • Publish supply targets to factories and VMI partners and track commits, ETDs, and landed supply against them.
  • Monitor weekly coverage across the full forward quarter to catch risk before it becomes shortage or excess, running simulations as needed to capture real-time supply chain changes.
  • Resolve risk with the right lever (rebalancing, transfers, air upgrades) alongside Order Operations and Production Procurement.
  • Partner with Demand Planning, NPI and Finance Analysis on demand changes, new product ramps, transitions and end-of-sale.
  • Plan VMI, ROP accessory, and refurbished supply while minimizing excess and obsolete material.
  • Report performance to targets and communicate supply risks to Operations leadership.
  • Evolve processes and tooling, using data and AI-assisted tools to remove manual work.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's operating principles as we scale globally.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, or Economics.
  • 6+ years (or 4+ with a Master's) of combined experience in consulting and supply chain planning, supply planning, material planning, or inventory management.
  • Experience building supply plans against factory capacity and component constraints, including capacity planning and Clear to Build (component and material availability).
  • Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to clearly lay out assumptions, risks and opportunities in logical models.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to synthesize information for a wide variety of stakeholders, from planners and factory contacts to executives.
  • Attention to detail while never losing sight of the big picture.
  • A proactive, positive approach to problem solving, and comfort with ambiguity, changing priorities and business volatility.
  • Working knowledge of ERP and planning systems (for example NetSuite and E2Open), Salesforce, and spreadsheet-based modeling.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • MBA or Master's degree in a related field.
  • Programming and data skills (SQL, Python) and experience with BI tools such as Databricks or Tableau.
  • Electronics or hardware manufacturing experience, ideally working with contract manufacturers or JDMs.
  • Experience with vendor-managed inventory, third-party logistics, or global multi-DC networks.
  • Experience with new product introductions, product transitions and end-of-life planning.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve planning workflows.

Annual Base Salary
$90,440—$121,600 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Release Manager to own how Tailscale ships our product, both internally and to customers. You’ll build and run our release coordination process and create the operational practices that coordinate product and engineering.

You’ll work closely with engineering leads, product managers, TPMs and support. At first you’ll focus on building release management from the ground up: setting the release cadence, defining roles, building tooling, and agreeing on norms with the teams involved in releases. Later, it will grow into creating processes around other parts of how product and engineering collaborate, like operational metrics.

You should understand how software gets shipped, including branching strategies, build pipelines, feature flags, and rollout mechanics. Your technical aptitude will allow you to design release processes that engineers trust and use.

Tailscale moves fast and your processes should help us maintain our speed. When a process works well, it is nearly invisible - it keeps the right people informed, stays out of engineers’ way, and gives the team a plan.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and continuously improve Tailscale’s release management process: including release cadence, readiness criteria, rollout coordination, and go/no-go decisions
  • Build and maintain the tooling, templates, runbooks, and documentation that make release processes repeatable and low-friction
  • Partner with engineering leads and product managers to surface risk early and drive resolution before it becomes a crisis
  • Define and track operational metrics that reflect the health of our release practices (e.g., release frequency, change failure rate)
  • Keep releases on schedule by facilitating cross-team planning rituals that keep engineering and product coordinated
  • Identify and drive systemic improvements to how we operate, using data and judgment to prioritize what actually matters

What We Are Looking For
  • 5+ years in engineering operations, release management, or a closely related role at a software company
  • Direct experience building or significantly improving release management processes
  • Technical fluency: you understand software development deeply enough to have credible conversations with engineers about build systems, deployment pipelines, branching strategies, and production operations
  • Strong instincts for what process is worth having and what’s just overhead, and optimizing process for trust and adoption
  • Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to build structure from scratch

Nice to Have

  • Experience with both client and server software release processes
  • Experience at a developer tools, infrastructure, or security-focused SaaS company
  • Familiarity with DORA metrics and how to use them to drive meaningful improvement
  • Experience with feature flag systems, progressive rollouts, or canary deployments as release tools
  • Experience scaling operational practices through periods of rapid team or product growth
  • Hands-on experience with Tailscale at work or home

jobs.description:
Applied AI Engineer - Direct Acquisition

Hybrid in London, UK

We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to join the Direct Acquisition team.

You'll design and build AI agents that run whole business processes, from planning the work to learning from the results. What you find will steer how far iwoca takes agents across the business.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Direct Acquisition includes iwoca's Marketing, Sales, Brand and Acquisition Tech teams. Together, they reach UK businesses of all shapes and sizes through paid and organic marketing channels and direct sales.

A new team in Direct Acquisition builds agents that automate and improve acquisition processes. That's its only focus, and it works closely with Acquisition Tech. It's small – a product owner and you – and everyone builds. You'll report to the Head of Direct Acquisition, who sets the commercial direction.

The role

As the Applied AI Engineer, you'll build the agents and the systems around them. Most of the work is system design and backend engineering.

You'll start with direct mail. The first goal is an agent that plans each monthly round, uses iwoca's existing predictive models to build the mailing file, and learns from the results as they come in. The pattern is simple to say and hard to get right: the agent orchestrates, deterministic code does the work, and a human in the loop approves the file before it goes to print. You'll work with the people who run each process to understand the edge cases, and with Core Systems and Compliance on access and controls.

The agents don't exist yet, and much is still open: which processes the team takes on, and what the architecture looks like. You'll own those design decisions and write most of the code yourself, much of it with AI coding tools. Some of this won't work, and finding out why is one of the main outputs of the role.

  • Architecture. You'll design what agents need to run reliably: memory that persists between runs, task management, access to tools, permissions, and a record of every decision and why. You'll build each piece so the next process can reuse it.

  • Guardrails. You'll decide where the agent uses judgement and where code enforces rules the agent can't change, like suppressions, compliance checks and budget limits.

  • Delivery. You'll own each agent end to end: connect it to iwoca's predictive models, data pipelines and channel tools, and run it alongside the current process until it has shown it works.

  • Measurement. You'll track how often agents need a person, where they fail, what they cost, and what they're worth.

The requirements

We're looking for the depth of someone who has solved hard problems, and the pace of someone who moves fast in areas that are new to them.

Essential:

  • System ownership. You've owned a complex system end to end, from design to running it in production, and lived with the consequences of your architecture choices.

  • Design judgement. You've made architecture decisions other people built on, and you can explain the trade-offs and what you'd change. When an idea won't work, you say so and offer a better one.

  • Pace. You've got things live quickly in unfamiliar areas and they kept working once people relied on them.

We expect to pay from £80,000 to £120,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. Position: Strategy & Operations Associate, GTM

Department: Commercial Operations

Reports to: EVP, Commercial Operations

You'll be the right hand to our EVP of Commercial Operations, owning the cross-functional programs that move our GTM (go-to-market) forward and running the rhythm that keeps marketing, SDR, sales, and revenue leadership aligned. You'll sit in the weekly revenue leadership meeting from day one, receive a quarterly mandate, and be expected to figure out the path: frame the problem, align the people who need to act (none of whom report to you), and carry the work through to adoption.

This is a strategy-and-operations role, not an analyst seat. You'll use AI tools like Claude to move faster and learn our systems (Salesforce, HubSpot) along the way. We're hiring you for judgment, structure, and follow-through.

Why this role:

  • Direct exposure to executive decision-making. You report to an EVP and sit in the weekly revenue leadership meeting from day one. You will see how a venture-backed, Series-C company makes GTM decisions, and you will shape them.
  • Real ownership, fast. Several of our strongest GTM team members came from management consulting and program management backgrounds. They own cross-functional programs within their first quarter. This role is built the same way.
  • Mission that matters. Interplay trains the skilled-trades workforce (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, facilities, data centers) with immersive simulation and AI. The labor gap we are solving is one of the defining workforce problems of the decade.
  • A modern stack, built for automation. Salesforce, HubSpot, Omni, Gong, and Claude, with a mandate to automate manual work rather than absorb it.
  • Growth path. This role is designed to grow into broader strategy and operations leadership as you demonstrate ownership.

What you'll own:

  • The commercial operating rhythm. Run the weekly revenue leadership meeting as chief of staff to the EVP: set the agenda, build pre-reads and a weekly view of how we're tracking against target, capture decisions and actions, assign owners, and drive follow-through to completion.
  • Cross-functional GTM programs. Lead strategic initiatives from planning through execution and measurement, including our ROI program and skill-leveling initiatives. Set the plan, align owners across teams, track progress, and make sure programs deliver the intended result, not just a deliverable.
  • Account strategy and targeting. Drive strategic account sequencing and targeting so marketing and SDR teams work the right accounts in the right order. Partner with the EVP of Revenue and SDR leader on territory design, account assignments, top-account planning, and target-list development by segment.
  • Remove the bottlenecks. Spot where revenue velocity stalls between marketing and sales, design the cross-functional fix, and drive it through to operational adoption.
  • Process improvement and automation. Use AI and automation to remove manual work and improve how our GTM teams run.

Who you are:

  • An operator. You have driven initiatives to completion and adoption, and you can walk through one end to end, including how you got people who did not report to you to change what they do.
  • A structured thinker and clear communicator. You frame problems before solving them, write crisply, and are credible in front of executives and sellers alike.
  • Clear on what to measure. You frame problems clearly and know which signals matter.
  • A builder with AI. You use Claude or similar tools daily as a working instrument for analysis, drafting, and automation, and you can show something you built.
  • Self-directed against a mandate. Given a quarterly objective and a messy starting point, you sequence the work, prioritize well in a resource-conscious environment, and keep multiple live workstreams moving.
  • Quick to learn systems. You're willing to get hands-on in Salesforce and HubSpot, and you pick up new tools quickly.

Requirements:

  • 2-3+ years in consulting, strategy and operations, program management, chief of staff, or business operations (GTM/RevOps experience welcome, not required). B2B SaaS exposure is a plus.
  • A track record of driving cross-functional initiatives to adoption, especially where you had to influence without authority, with an example you can walk through end to end.
  • Executive-ready communication: turning ambiguity into clear recommendations, written plans, and pre-reads.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools (Claude especially) for analysis, drafting, and automation, with something you've built to show.
  • Comfort learning new systems; you'll become a hands-on Salesforce and HubSpot user within your first 90 days. Prior admin or power-user experience is a plus.

Nice to have:

  • Startup or high-growth experience, including operating through a period of organizational change
  • Board or leadership reporting experience
  • Program or roadmap design, including territory design, account planning, or target-list development
  • ROI or value-engineering program experience
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, or BI tools

Pay: $100k-$110k annual salary

Final compensation will reflect the candidate's experience and demonstrated impact.

What to expect from our interview process

We know your time is valuable, so here's a general sense of what to expect. Steps can vary a bit by role:

  • Recruiter intro call
  • Wonderlic Select Hiring Assessment
  • Hiring manager conversation
  • Team/Peer panel interview

Interviews are conducted remotely unless a step calls for something different. Following an offer of employment, all roles require a background check and a drug and alcohol screening. See the Compliance and Onboarding section below for details.

Some positions may require other verifications, such as, driver eligibility and record, credentials or education. All new hires will be required to complete the I-9 Form and E-verify process upon employment.

Benefits & Perks - Why you’ll love working with us:

  • Learning & growth – Annual learning reimbursement.
  • Family-friendly policies – Support for work-life balance.

  • Comprehensive benefits – Medical, vision, dental, and 401(k) match.
  • Equity – Private Company Equity Options
  • Wellness – Mental and physical health resources and social events.

Join us and grow with a team that values you!

About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

About the Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

What You Will Need

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

With a comprehensive lineup of Vehicle Protection plans, Sonsio offers industry-leading programs that cover Tire Road Hazard Protection, Appearance, Parts & Labor Warranties, Mechanical Advisory, and other critical consumer services. These benefits provide vehicle owners with affordable and valuable coverages to keep their vehicles on the road safely, and also maximize the resale value by keeping the appearance of their vehicles like-new.

Sonsio Vehicle Protection is committed to innovation and excellent customer service. Since our inception in 1984, Sonsio has been a leader in the automotive industry—serving more than 74,000 dealerships, F&I service providers, manufacturers, insurance companies, parts suppliers, retail chains, and many independent retailers across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.

We understand the challenges and complexities that our partners face when it comes to offering vehicle protection plans. There is no one-size-fits-all. Every business we help is different and has their own set of challenges. That’s why, when you partner with Sonsio, we work with you to provide a custom solution designed to improve customer acquisition and retention and increase profitability.

And when it comes to managing claims, you don’t have the time or resources to worry about the headaches. Sonsio provides end-to-end support and decades of expertise to give customers the highest quality services with a world-class customer experience.

Base Pay Range:

$74,000 – $82,000

The Sales Operations Specialist serves as the sales operations partner for the Foundation sales organization, owning the dealer and agent onboarding, amendment, escalation, and contract follow-up processes. The role exercises independent judgment to prioritize competing requests across 14 field sales associates, determine resolution paths, and make day-to-day decisions within established authority levels, escalating only matters of significant financial or relationship impact. The position serves as the primary liaison between the Foundation sales team and internal departments including PMO, F&I Administration, Claims, Accounting, and Risk, and ensures timely resolution of dealer, agent, claims, and accounting-related matters.

As Sales Operations Specialist, your essential job responsibilities will include the following:

Dealer and Agent Submissions, Amendments, and Onboarding

  • Own the dealer and agent submission process, with sign-off authority to determine when an agreement is complete and ready for submission. Evaluate submissions for completeness and alignment with agreement, pricing, and state form requirements; return incomplete submissions for correction or escalate issues, and forward signed-off submissions to PMO for setup, owning each submission through completion of setup.
  • Evaluate amendment requests against program guidelines, sign off on routine amendments as complete and forward them to PMO for processing, and forward non-standard amendments to sales leadership with an assessment of business impact.
  • Review pricing, commission, and markup change requests determined by agents and dealers for completeness and consistency with executed agreements and rate cards, resolve discrepancies with the requesting party, and submit to PMO; partner with PMO on dealer, agency, and menu adjustments and technical issues.
  • Request new PCRS credentials, including accounting and F&I credential status at the dealer level and agency credentials.
  • Manage dealer and agent onboarding from executed agreement through implementation and launch.
  • Deliver PCRS training and present onboarding and training materials via PowerPoint.
  • Conduct remote training sessions for last-minute dealer and agent requests that conflict with immediate out-of-state travel, as a bridge until the ADM or BDM can travel to the location.
  • Serve as Foundation's primary liaison with PMO and coordinate Foundation workbook activities with the Risk team and sales leadership.
  • Coordinate and distribute requested rate cards for agents.
  • Provide kick-off documentation and executed agreements to agents and field sales partners in preparation for implementation.
  • Maintain accurate activity records within Salesforce directly on the agent and dealer accounts.
  • Own the active dealer and agent account list, updating account status and terminating lost dealers and agents so records in Salesforce and PCRS remain accurate.
  • Contribute toward achievement of quarterly goals and objectives.

Territory and Alignment Administration

  • Own Foundation dealer, district, and regional alignment administration, implementing change requests from the VP and Director of Sales.
  • Maintain accurate dealer and territory assignments within Salesforce per process guidelines.
  • Coordinate annual regional alignment updates to support budget planning and reporting requirements.
  • Partner with Sales, Accounting, Finance, and Business Systems teams to ensure data integrity and reporting accuracy.
  • Evaluate and implement process improvements related to dealer and territory assignment management.

Claims Escalations and Sales Support

  • Serve as the primary liaison for dealer and agent claims escalations. The role works directly with agents on administrative matters. The ADM/BDM field team remains the dealer's first point of contact and may direct dealer escalations to this role as needed.
  • Coordinate escalation requests received directly or through ADM/BDM field representatives.
  • Assess dealer and agent claims escalations, determine priority and resolution approach, and resolve escalations independently within established guidelines, partnering with the Claims team on the outcome; escalate to the Director of Sales only when the matter has significant financial or relationship impact.
  • Provide regular communication updates to agents and field sales personnel regarding escalation status.
  • Track claims escalation activity within Salesforce through closure.
  • Determine dealer and agent eligibility for Claims portal access and provide credentials upon request.
  • Analyze recurring escalation, onboarding, and contract issues; recommend and implement process improvements with PMO and internal departments to reduce rework and improve dealer and agent retention.
  • Act as the primary internal support contact for field sales escalations.
  • Coordinate communication and workflow between field sales and internal departments.
  • Support field sales with reporting, product information, customer meeting preparation, and training activities.
  • Independently prioritize concurrent requests from field sales associates based on business impact and urgency, within priorities set by sales leadership.
  • Analyze sales, contract, and activity metrics in Power BI and Salesforce and provide recommendations to sales leadership that inform agent follow-up, territory priorities, and resource allocation.
  • Monitor and track customer service and sales issues through resolution.
  • Maintain working knowledge of all SVP and white-labeled programs to support field sales inquiries and dealer installations.

Accounting Support and Contract Management

  • Determine follow-up priority and approach for past-due accounts identified by Accounting, based on aging, account value, and relationship risk.
  • Review and clarify aged accounts receivable balances with Accounting, including 30, 60, and 90-day aging categories, based on status updates provided by Accounting.
  • When Accounting identifies a past-due account, coordinate communications with agents and field sales representatives.
  • Report follow-up outcomes back to the Accounting department.
  • Accounting owns accounts receivable; this role supports communication and follow-through.
  • Escalate unresolved account issues to the Director of Sales.
  • Support PCRS remittance inquiries and month-end close activities.
  • Run and distribute pending contract reports from PCRS.
  • Communicate pending contract status to appropriate field sales representatives, agents, and dealers.
  • Determine corrective action for pending and inactivated contracts and drive resolution with agents, dealers, and field sales to protect month-end results.
  • Provide contract status updates and reporting to sales leadership.
  • Support month-end close requirements through timely contract administration and follow-through.

Other Duties as Assigned

Skills Required

  • Salesforce
  • PCRS
  • Power BI
  • PowerPoint
  • Bynder
  • Microsoft Office Suite
  • Data analysis and reporting
  • Presentation and training delivery
  • Customer service and relationship management
  • Project coordination
  • Written and verbal communication
  • Organization and time management
  • Problem-solving and critical thinking

Job Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in sales support, sales operations, or account administration.
  • Bachelor's degree is preferred or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience supporting a field sales organization in a fast-paced environment.
  • Knowledge of automotive finance, lending, F&I, or service business.
  • Understanding dealer and agency agreements, pricing models, commissions, and state form requirements.
  • Experience in using Salesforce or comparable CRM platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise sound independent judgment on matters affecting customer relationships, revenue, and contract compliance.
  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Ability to build effective working relationships across departments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within the automotive, F&I, warranty, or dealer services industries.
  • Advanced knowledge of Salesforce reporting and CRM administration.
  • Experience using Power BI and business intelligence tools.
  • Previous experience supporting remote field sales teams.
  • Experience delivering product or system training

Physical Job Requirements

  • Continuous viewing from and inputting data to a computer screen
  • Sitting for long periods of time
  • Travel as needed (up to 10%)

Drug Policy

Sonsio is a drug-free environment. All applicants being considered for employment must pass a pre-employment drug screening before beginning work.

jobs.description:
We’re building the go-to-market team for Base44, an AI-powered software development platform recently acquired by Wix. As a front-line Sales Manager for our SMB segment, you’ll lead a high-velocity team of Account Executives, bringing a transformative product to small and mid-sized businesses. This is a high-impact role for a coach-first sales leader who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment. You won’t just follow a playbook, you’ll help write it, working closely with Base44 leadership to turn technical innovation into tangible business value for our customers. We are seeking candidates located in or near the Salt Lake City, Utah, or San Diego, California area.

In your day-to-day, you will:

  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of SMB Account Executives, including hiring, onboarding, and ramping new reps

  • Run a coaching-first operating cadence: weekly 1:1s, call coaching, deal reviews, pipeline reviews, and QBRs

  • Coach reps to balance outbound with inbound and product-led opportunities, so pipeline creation is never inbound-only

  • Coach reps on discovery and tailored demos that connect Base44 to a customer’s real workflow and business problem

  • Help reps manage the buying process by aligning decision-makers, working through technical and legal questions, and owning commercial terms through close

  • Stay close to key deals and jump in as a player-coach where it moves the outcome

  • Partner with Account Management on handoff and expansion

  • Shape the foundational SMB sales motion, including messaging, outreach strategies, and customer segmentation to support future scale

  • Accurately forecast, manage pipeline coverage, and hold the team to CRM best practices

  • Read pipeline and performance data to spot patterns, diagnose what is driving results, and decide what to change

  • Bring AI into how your team works, from prep and outreach to call review and coaching, and share what works across the org

  • Act as a feedback loop between the market and the product team to influence roadmap and positioning

  • 6+ years of B2B sales experience in a technology company, including 2+ years directly managing quota-carrying AEs, with a track record of team attainment and improved win rates

  • Strong personal track record of exceeding quota in SMB environments with shorter sales cycles and high-volume deal flow

  • A proven coach who can break down a deal, give direct feedback, and visibly improve rep performance

  • A strong problem solver who thinks creatively and independently, and can point to a significant problem you solved for your company

  • Hands-on use of AI with your team, with real examples of how it changed the way your team sells or operates

  • High emotional intelligence: you build trust, give candid feedback with care, and lead through ambiguity and change

  • Strong analytical skills: you are comfortable reading a data set, pulling out the insights, and turning them into action

  • Experience with PLG or “land and expand” motions, leveraging ICs to drive organizational adoption

  • Familiarity with AI, ML, or developer-centric SaaS, and comfort discussing technical workflows with stakeholders

  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and comfortable with the ambiguity of a “startup within a giant” environment

  • Located in or near the Salt Lake City, Utah, or San Diego, California area

Software used to take months and a team of engineers. At Base44, it takes a conversation. Our AI platform turns plain language into working custom software, and we’re changing who gets to build. As part of Wix, we have the backing of a global leader. Inside it, we move like a startup: fast, scrappy, and obsessed with simple solutions to hard problems. If you want to shape a category as it takes off, this is your seat.

Compensation:

The approximate base compensation is $110,000 - 130,000/yr for San Diego, California. In addition to the base pay, this role includes variable compensation earned and company RSUs as part of the compensation package.

Final offer may vary and will be determined by various factors including location the role is expected to be performed, shift, candidate profile, and ideal qualifications.

jobs.description:
Команда Projector Institute розшукує кураторів —експертів та експерток, готових будувати якісну та персоналізовану освіту, допомагати студентам знайти своє покликання і розвитися.

Якщо ти бачиш себе у ролі куратора/кина одному з наших курсів, то сміливо можеш залишати заявку! Навіть якщо такого напрямку курсів немає, але ти все рівно хочеш бути частинкою Проджектора, то ми також відкриті до нових запусків!

Бути куратором у Projector — це:
— разом розвивати вільну освіту;
— бути частиною професійного ком’юніті;
— навчати українців, які змінюватимуть світ;
— дізнаватись про найкращі практики роботи зі студентами;
— долучатися до створення навчальних програм.

Що ми бачимо перед собою, коли уявляємо ідеального куратора/ку:
— маєш круті практичні кейси, які можеш перетворити на лайфхаки і поділитися з студентами;
— можеш легко пояснити складні речі зрозумілими словами;
— любиш людей!

Куратори у Projector — це практики, які працюють пліч-о-пліч зі студентами. Якщо коротко, то загалом будуть 3 основні задачі:
1. Перевірка та фідбек на домашні завдання студентів;
2. Проведення інтерактивного онлайн вебінару для студентів 1 раз на тиждень (тривалість 1.5-2 години);
3. Комунікація зі студентами по питанням та обговоренню лекцій чи домашок, мотивація та підтримка студентів;Також куратор може:
— давати додаткові завдання/матеріали своїй групі;
— долучатись до оновлень та покращень на курсі, пропонувати і записувати додаткові лекції до програми;
— запрошувати гостьових лекторів та супроводжувати їх;

jobs.description:
The AI Solutions Engineer is the hands-on builder of the AI Hub Center of Excellence. Where the AI Engineering & Enablement Lead sets architecture and governance, this role turns that direction into working, production-grade agents and AI workflows that ride on EVERSANA's enterprise AI stack (GCP, Vertex AI, Claude, Gemini Enterprise).

This engineer productionizes enterprise AI tooling for Patient Services use cases, builds the reusable patterns other teams depend on, and integrates AI into the Salesforce, MuleSoft, and Java touchpoints of our SDLC. It is a deep technical role for someone who wants to build real AI systems in a regulated healthcare environment, not just experiment.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Agent & Workflow Development

  • Design and build AI agents on Vertex AI Agent Builder, the Claude API, and Gemini Enterprise.
  • Productionize enterprise AI tooling for priority Patient Services use cases: intake automation, missing-information workflow, adverse-event detection, workload queue intelligence, QNCR automation, and chat-with-claims.
  • Build and maintain RAG pipelines, vector stores, embeddings, and retrieval workflows against Patient Services data.
  • Implement MCP server integrations and agent tool/function definitions that expose enterprise systems to agents safely.

Integration & SDLC

  • Integrate AI capabilities into Salesforce Health Cloud (Apex, LWC), MuleSoft (DataWeave), and Java SDLC touchpoints.
  • Build reusable prompt templates and agent patterns that the broader engineering team can adopt.
  • Contribute to the shared prompt/pattern library with quality-reviewed, version-controlled components.

Lifecycle & Quality

  • Own the agent lifecycle end to end: build, deploy, monitor, evaluate, and retire.
  • Establish evaluation harnesses so agents are tested against defined quality bars before production.
  • Review AI-generated code produced by Salesforce, MuleSoft, and Java developers, ensuring it meets ACTICS quality standards.
  • Monitor deployed agents for drift, cost, latency, and accuracy; remediate as needed.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • 5+ years in software engineering, with hands-on experience building production systems.
  • Advanced Python; competence in JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Direct experience with a cloud AI platform (Vertex AI strongly preferred) and its SDK.
  • Demonstrated prompt engineering and LLM application development with Claude, Gemini, or equivalent models.
  • Practical experience with RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval design.
  • Familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks (CrewAI, LangChain, LangGraph, or Vertex Agent Builder).
  • Experience integrating with REST/GraphQL APIs; Salesforce and/or MuleSoft integration experience a strong plus.
  • Comfortable working on a follow-the-sun model with an onshore lead.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and agent tooling standards.
  • Background in healthcare or life-sciences technology; awareness of PHI/HIPAA constraints.
  • Salesforce (Apex/LWC) or Java development experience.
  • Experience with BigQuery, PostgreSQL, or comparable data platforms.

Tools & Stack

  • AI: Vertex AI Agent Builder, Claude API, Gemini Enterprise API.
  • Orchestration: CrewAI, LangChain, LangGraph.
  • Dev productivity: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot.
  • Data & cloud: GCP, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, vector stores.

First-Year Success Measures

  • Intake Automation MVP and at least two additional AI workflow MVPs built and shipped to one or more programs.
  • Reusable agent patterns and prompt library established and adopted by other engineers.
  • Agent evaluation and monitoring practices operational for every production agent.

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.
Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.
Take Action I am empowered and empower others to act now.
Grow Talent I own my development and invest in the development of others.
Win Together I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.
Communication Matters I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.
Embrace Diversity I create an environment of awareness and respect.
Always Innovate I am bold and creative in everything I do.

Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Follow us on LinkedIn | Twitter

At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!

Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.

Description et livrables de la prestation

Une refonte complète de la plateforme QIS IT (Quantitative Index Strategies) est engagée couvrant deux axes :

  • Plateforme Live : calcul et publication d'indices custom en temps réel, interface web Angular, architecture microservices, engine de calcul développé par les Quants
  • Plateforme Backtesting : simulation historique de stratégies quantitatives sur données haute fréquence (tick, TWAP, VWAP, etc) hébergées sur une infrastructure entièrement cloud.

Le consultant interviendra au sein d'une organisation agile (sprints de 3 semaines), en collaboration étroite avec les équipes FO / Structuration & Quant et Infrastructure.

Dans ce cadre, le consultant interviendra sur plusieurs sujets tels que :

Missions principales :

1) Pilotage de projet & management d'équipe

  • Piloter la roadmap technique et fonctionnelle de la refonte en lien avec les parties prenantes (FO, Structuration, Quants, Product Owners,)
  • Animer et coordonner l'équipe de développement (cérémonies agiles, priorisation du backlog, suivi d'avancement)
  • Gérer les risques, les dépendances et les arbitrages techniques
  • Assurer le reporting auprès du management et la communication transverse.

2) Développement & intégration de la Calculation Engine

  • Superviser et contribuer à l'intégration de la calculation engine développée par les Quants (indices custom, règles de sélection, pondération, rebalancement, corporate actions)
  • Piloter la refonte du front-end React et l'exposition des services via API REST / OpenAPI
  • Assurer l'intégration des modules dans l'écosystème applicatif existant (Lien avec le système de booking, risk systems, portails clients, réconciliation avec les providers externes, etc)
  • Garantir la documentation des flux, dépendances et interfaces

3) Plateforme de Backtesting sur le cloud

  • Piloter le développement de la plateforme de backtesting de stratégies quantitatives, reposant sur une infrastructure entièrement cloud AWS :

Stockage des séries historiques tick, TWAP, VWAP sur S3 ( Selon les sources disponibles)
Traitement distribué via EMR/Spark ou Lambda selon les granularités de données
Accès et requêtage optimisés via Athena ou Redshift

  • Superviser l'implémentation du moteur de simulation
  • Assurer le versioning des stratégies, la traçabilité.

4) Architecture & modernisation

  • Décomposer les applications monolithiques en microservices autonomes
  • Piloter l'APIsation des services : API REST, documentation Swagger/OpenAPI, gestion des versions, sécurité OAuth2/JWT
  • Piloter la migration progressive vers AWS (EKS, S3, RDS/Aurora, MSK) avec une approche Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)

Tech Lead C# PricingServices

Cette mission nécessite :

  • Une expérience significative en C#.
  • Une bonne compréhension des problématiques liées au multithreading
  • Connaissance des middlewares de calcul

Profil recherché :

Expérience : 8 ans+ en développement logiciel, dont 3 ans+ en pilotage de projet/équipe en environnement financier simulaire

Technique :

C # / Python (microservices), React, AWS (S3, EMR, Athena, Redshift, EKS, MSK), Kafka, Redis, Docker/Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD

Fonctionnel :

Connaissance des indices quantitatifs / QIS (règles de construction, rebalancement, corporate actions)
Maîtrise des données de marché haute fréquence (tick, TWAP, VWAP) et des architectures AWS data lake pour le stockage et le traitement de larges historiques financiers
Expérience avec les sources de données de marché : TRTH/LSEG, AlgoSeek, Bloomberg ou équivalent

Compréhension des enjeux de backtesting

DIRECTOR, CONSULTING

Kotter Consulting | Job Description

About Kotter

Kotter helps organizations turn strategy into results. Through our consulting and training offerings, we help leaders mobilize people, lead change, and achieve meaningful business outcomes.

The Opportunity

We are living in a world that is more disrupted and more uncertain than ever before. Just like all industries, consulting is being impacted by the mega-disruptors around us: AI, economic uncertainty, geopolitical and demographic shifts, etc. This also kicks the door wide open for Kotter’s work - helping organizations successfully execute their current transformation efforts while simultaneously building greater adaptability to navigate this ongoing disruption.

As a Director in consulting you will have a leading role in helping propel the firm forward. This role will balance client delivery, business development, and internal initiatives, requiring someone who is comfortable regularly and seamlessly context switching. The position requires deep strategic and business acumen, high standards, relentless commitment to client outcomes, and a spirit of true collaboration.

This is a Remote, U.S.-based position, requiring up to 70% travel.

Responsibilities

Client Delivery & Engagement Leadership

Lead complex and high-stakes client work, translating the scope of work into high-impact delivery. At times, you may juggle multiple client engagements at once, ranging from short-duration accounts (e.g. a leadership off-site) to multi-year accounts.

Own executive level relationships. Ability to serve as a strategic thought partner to senior most stakeholders, including the economic buyer. This includes the ability to effectively challenge senior leaders, raise engagement risks early, and develop effective mitigation strategies.

Manage scope and realization of client outcomes. Translate the scope of work into a full execution plan and strategy, with a clear line of sight toward and strategy for measuring and tracking value creation aligned to the client’s most pressing needs/desired outcomes.

Identify and lead strategic pivots, as needed. As the primary owner of delivering against the agreed upon scope, identify when execution is either off track or needs to pivot due to real-time emerging client needs. Own recalibration and updating solution design, as needed. This includes utilizing a broad business understanding to know what levers are most important for client success.

Create a thriving team environment. Own engagement and/or account team dynamics, including ways of working, clarity around roles and responsibilities, and identifying opportunities to develop other team members.

Manage account/engagement economics. Own the tracking and management of pricing, margin, and any necessary scope changes.

Front of room facilitation. Ability to effectively lead high-impact, engaging client sessions, adapting facilitation style to the audience (e.g. level of seniority, industry, culture, etc.). Manage difficult dynamics in the room, including mitigating tension between participants, flexing the agenda on the fly, and navigating unexpected distractions/challenges.

Business Development

A deep commitment and ability to grow the firm, to help us achieve our vision of “Millions Leading, Billions Benefiting.”

Account expansion and extension. Ability to spot new opportunities within current accounts to extend the engagement and/or expand into other areas of the business. Effectively build relationships with multiple economic buyers and develop solutions that meet their needs.

Net new client growth. Moving a pursuit from initial conversation through to closing the sale, from both inbound leads and Kotter-supported outbound networking. Bringing others into the pursuit process as appropriate.

Solution design and proposal creation. Turning prospect needs into a comprehensive solution design that meets their objectives, timeline, and budget.

Effectively capturing this solution design into a proposal that moves the deal down the funnel.

Pricing and deal structure. Ability to accurately price a proposal, taking into account the solution design, team structure, and target margin.

Disciplined pipeline management. Rigorous management of deals (and associated details) in internal systems.

Practice & Firm Leadership

As a leader in the firm, you will be expected to support the evolution of our IP, solutions, and people.

Mastery and evolution of Kotter IP. Ability to deeply understand and support evolving the principles that underpin Kotter’s evolving research, and translate that into business development conversations and client delivery.

Solution and product development. Own the evolution of how we operationalize our work with clients, rather than relying on “copy & paste” playbooks. Support the packaging of new solutions, partnering with Marketing and Business Development teams to bring these new solutions to market.

Internal process improvement. Identify and lead opportunities to improve outcomes from our internal process and increase efficiency, balancing the use of technology and focusing on supporting necessary behavior change to optimize new processes.

People leadership. Dedication to creating a learning environment, both up and down the reporting chain, and specifically on projects, to develop more junior colleagues in formal and informal ways, including serving as a direct manager to Consultants and Senior Consultants.

What We Are Looking For

Deployment flexibility. Someone who is able to easily work across different types of clients/industries, types of engagements, and various team configurations.

Adaptability. Ability to adjust your approach to client needs, client and internal team personalities, and changing circumstances.

Spinning multiple plates. Seamlessly manage client delivery with business development (including extension/expansion of current engagements and driving net-new sales) and internal initiatives.

A builder. Someone who is excited to help shape the future of the firm and is not reliant on stale, old school, or rigid ways of thinking about change management. Willing to jump in, shape solutions, and be an active participant in solutioning.

Growth mindset. Takes responsibility for own development and supports the development of colleagues. Demonstrates curiosity, constructively challenges ideas, learns from experience, delivers feedback without hesitation, and acts on feedback received.

Takes initiative. Proactively identifies opportunities to improve client service, the firm, or assigned work. Willing to take action without waiting for direction and follows through on commitments.

Team player. Dependable, collaborative, and willing to contribute where needed - acknowledging that in a small firm, everyone needs to be willing to play every position on the field at times.

Tolerant of ambiguity. Ability to manage uncertainty without compromising performance or team cohesion.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years in consulting or internal change, transformation, strategy, or organizational development roles.
  • Confident in the use of Google Suite, Microsoft Applications, CRM tools (HubSpot a plus), and AI tools (Gemini a plus)
  • Bachelor’s Degree Advanced degree a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication strategies to match the client context and culture.
  • Proven experience in Business Development and Account Expansion required
  • Exceptional client delivery and client relationship management skills, with experience in high-stakes engagements, both short- and long-term, with the ability to handle multiple engagements at once
  • Demonstrated people leadership and firm leadership skills required
  • Product development or IP development experience a plus
  • Must be willing to travel up to 70% of the
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills, with the ability to quickly build trust with colleagues, prospects, and clients.
  • Applicants must reside in the United States and be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

Reports To

Managing Director, Head of Consulting

Location

Remote (US). Up to 70% travel may be required for client delivery, team meetings, or company events.

Compensation and Benefits

Salary Range: $210,000+ USD (plus opportunity for profit sharing)

Compensation will be based on experience and qualifications. Kotter offers a comprehensive benefits package, including health coverage, 401(k), unlimited paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

Accessibility Commitment

ADA and Physical Requirements | Accessibility Commitment

Kotter is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in all aspects of employment.

Physical requirements:

  • Ability to communicate effectively in person, over video, and via digital platforms
  • The ability to operate standard office equipment (computer, phone, video conferencing tools).
  • Occasional lifting of materials (e.g. presentation equipment, flipchart stands, ) or session room furniture (e.g. moving tables/chairs to shift a room set up) up to 20 pounds
  • Travel (up to 70%) for client meetings, workshops, and events, which may involve extended periods of sitting, standing, or presenting.

jobs.description:
Tech Lead - New Customers Team

Hybrid in London, UK

We’re looking for a Tech Lead

You'll lead the engineering behind how new businesses become iwoca customers – the application they fill in, the checks they go through, and the offer they get.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The New Customers team owns everything from a business's first application to a funded loan: the application flow, the logic that routes each application, the documents we ask customers for, and the models that set loan amounts and pricing. Its measure of success is the customer lifetime value it adds between sign-up and first loan.

The team sets its own goals and direction. It brings together engineers, data scientists, and product and strategy people. It partners closely with credit risk on the trade-offs behind every lending decision. Knowledge sharing is central to how the team works, supported by regular forums to share findings, and dedicated research and development time.

You'll lead two engineers and report to the head of engineering for iwoca's customer journey, from first application to repeat lending.

The role

As the Tech Lead, you'll spend most of your time building. The team is moving its offer logic out of a legacy monolith into a new service. It's the biggest change in a decade to the system behind iwoca's lending decisions. The next phase is yours to lead.

  • Autonomy and ownership. You'll shape what the team builds, decide how to build it, and own what goes live. You'll set its engineering roadmap, including what to pull out of the monolith, what to rewrite, and in what order.

  • Technical complexity. You'll design the team's part of the new service, which turns models and rules into a lending decision and optimises each offer across amount, duration, fee, and interest rate. You'll keep it reliable in production, easy to change as the models evolve, and able to show how it reached each decision.

  • Experimentation and learning. You'll build the systems that let data scientists test new models on live applications. Some experiments run for years, until each loan reaches the end of its term. You'll see the long-term results of the team's lending decisions.

  • Influence. You'll get colleagues across iwoca behind technical work that competes with new features for time.

  • Leadership and growth. You'll line-manage and coach the team's engineers, setting context and helping them own projects end to end. As the team grows, you'll decide the skills and make-up it needs, and hire the engineers to match.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Technical leadership. You've led a team of engineers for at least two years, including line management, while still remaining hands on.

  • Backend engineering. You have deep expertise in at least one object-oriented language. You've designed, built, and run customer-facing backend systems in production.

  • Commercial or product thinking. You take a business goal, get to the root of what's needed and why, and turn it into a technical plan. You can explain a trade-off in terms of what it means for customers and the business.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to deliver engineering work you couldn't have done alone. You help your team do the same. You judge where it's useful. You check its output before it reaches production.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Lending or payments experience. You've worked in lending, payments, or another domain where engineering decisions carry financial risk.

  • Experimentation. You've built systems that run controlled experiments, especially long-running ones.

  • Legacy migration. You've moved business-critical logic out of a complex legacy monolith and kept everything that depends on it working.

  • Working with data scientists. You've worked with data scientists from prototype to production, and know their work well enough to challenge it.

  • Python stack. You've worked with Python, Django, and PostgreSQL.

  • Frontend. You've built frontend features as well as backend services.

The salary

We expect to pay from £100,000 to £130,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Compensation Range: £100K - £130K
