jobs.description:
The Lead Information Security Auditor (GRC) is a senior cybersecurity and risk management leader responsible for establishing, maintaining, and continuously improving the organization's cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance program across product development, manufacturing, operational technology (OT), and enterprise IT environments.


This REMOTE role ensures the organization effectively manages cyber risk, complies with applicable regulatory and industry requirements, and maintains governance processes that protect intellectual property, patient safety, operational resilience, and business objectives. The position serves as a key liaison between cybersecurity, business leadership, quality and regulatory affairs, legal, audit, and external regulators to ensure security requirements are embedded throughout the organization's operations and product lifecycle.

This role plays a critical part in enabling secure innovation, supporting regulatory readiness, managing enterprise cyber risk, and providing executive visibility into cybersecurity posture and compliance performance.


Key Responsibilities:


Cybersecurity Governance

  • Lead the development, implementation, and maintenance of cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, and governance frameworks.
  • Establish governance processes that align cybersecurity initiatives with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain cybersecurity framework alignment with NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOX, GDPR, NIS2, and applicable industry regulations.
  • Develop and present cybersecurity metrics, KPIs, KRIs, and risk dashboards to executive leadership.
  • Facilitate cybersecurity steering committees and governance forums with senior stakeholders.
  • Track remediation activities and ensure accountability for risk mitigation activities.

Enterprise Risk Management

  • Lead enterprise-wide cybersecurity risk assessment and risk management programs.
  • Establish and maintain a cyber risk register covering enterprise IT, manufacturing systems, cloud services, and connected medical devices.
  • Evaluate risks related to patient safety, operational resilience, intellectual property protection, regulatory exposure, and business continuity.
  • Perform risk assessments for new technologies, business initiatives, mergers, acquisitions, and strategic projects.
  • Develop risk treatment plans and monitor mitigation efforts through completion.
  • Translate technical security risks into business impact statements for executive leadership.

Regulatory Compliance & Audit Management

  • Lead cybersecurity compliance efforts supporting SOX, ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, NIS2, and applicable healthcare and manufacturing requirements.
  • Coordinate internal audits, external audits, regulatory inspections, and customer security assessments.
  • Manage evidence collection, control validation, and remediation tracking activities.
  • Conduct control maturity assessments and gap analyses against regulatory and industry frameworks.
  • Partner with Internal Audit, Legal, Compliance, and Regulatory Affairs to ensure ongoing compliance readiness.
  • Oversee audit findings and corrective action plans through closure.

Third-Party Risk Management

  • Lead cybersecurity due diligence and risk assessments for vendors, suppliers, manufacturing partners, and service providers.
  • Establish third-party security requirements and contractual security obligations.
  • Evaluate supplier security posture and monitor compliance with organizational requirements.
  • Assess third-party risks impacting manufacturing operations, product development, cloud services, and intellectual property.
  • Drive remediation and risk acceptance processes for identified supplier risks.

Product Security Governance

  • Partner with Engineering, Product Development, Quality, and Regulatory Affairs teams to ensure cybersecurity requirements are incorporated throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Oversee cybersecurity risk assessments for medical and surgical devices.
  • Support secure development governance processes and cybersecurity documentation requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable device cybersecurity guidance and regulatory expectations.
  • Facilitate coordinated vulnerability disclosure governance and vulnerability management oversight.

Security Awareness & Compliance Culture

  • Lead enterprise cybersecurity awareness, education, and compliance initiatives.
  • Promote a culture of security accountability and risk ownership throughout the organization.
  • Develop targeted awareness programs for executives, manufacturing personnel, engineers, and business teams.
  • Support phishing awareness, policy compliance, and security training programs.
  • Measure and report on program effectiveness and compliance trends.

Business Continuity & Resilience Governance

  • Partner with business continuity and disaster recovery stakeholders to ensure cyber resilience requirements are addressed.
  • Support business impact analyses and resilience planning activities.
  • Participate in tabletop exercises and cyber crisis management planning.
  • Evaluate recovery capabilities and resilience controls for critical business processes and manufacturing operations.
  • Monitor remediation actions resulting from exercises and resilience assessments.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Provide leadership and direction for cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance initiatives.
  • Mentor cybersecurity professionals on risk management, compliance frameworks, and governance best practices.
  • Serve as the primary cybersecurity liaison for Audit, Compliance, Legal, Quality, and Regulatory Affairs functions.
  • Present risk and compliance updates to executive leadership, committees, and external stakeholders.
  • Support strategic cybersecurity planning and roadmap development.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Business, Engineering, Risk Management, or related field
  • 7+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information security governance, risk management, compliance, audit, or related disciplines.
  • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) certification

Preferred Experience

  • Experience developing and managing cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance programs.
  • Experience conducting risk assessments and managing enterprise risk registers.
  • Experience supporting internal audits, external audits, and regulatory examinations.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and regulatory requirements.
  • Experience in healthcare, medical device manufacturing, life sciences, or regulated industries.
  • Deep knowledge of NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOX, GDPR, NIS2, and third-party risk management practices.
  • Experience managing enterprise GRC platforms such as ServiceNow GRC, Archer, OneTrust, or AuditBoard.
  • Experience developing executive risk reporting, metrics, and board-level presentations.
  • Familiarity with medical device cybersecurity regulations and product security risk management.
  • Professional certifications preferred:
    • CISSP
    • CRISC
    • CISM
    • CGRC (formerly CAP)
    • ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor

About Pilotbase:

Pilotbase is a connected system that brings together flight schools, pilots, and industry partners into a single, data-driven network. This next phase of growth is focused on expanding within our existing customer base, reaching pilots directly, and creating new revenue streams across the ecosystem.

Job Overview:

As the Senior Security Operations Engineer, you will own the hands-on security functions of the team implementing controls, closing findings, running detection and response, and producing the evidence our compliance programs depend on. The Security Manager sets the standards, you make them real, and show that they hold. You will work across endpoints, cloud, identity, applications and vendor security, ranging from alert triage through to control design by researching options and proposing designs or tooling.

Responsibilities:

The primary function is accountability for security outcomes in your domains being achieved and demonstrable. Where a control is claimed, you implement it, operate it, enforce its SLA, and evidence it. This role implements, operates, remediates and evidences. It also offers guidance and suggestions on proposing standards, policies, compliance frameworks and security tooling. As the team and the company scale, this role will grow to include additional related responsibilities.

Remediation and Closure

● Owns closure of security findings end to end: triage, prioritisation against the standard, driving the remediation cycle against existing findings with platform owners, and verifying closure. Closure, not detection, is the deliverable.

● Manages, reviews and drives outcomes against penetration tests, vulnerability and posture scans, audit gaps, access reviews, and CVEs across the estate.

● Security is an overlay onto other domains, so where security does not own the platform you own the finding and its closure while holding the platform owner (IT, DevOps, Engineering, etc) to executing the fix.

Functional Security

● Endpoint security direction and Tier 1 asset hardening.

● Vulnerability and application security scanning, and enforcement of its SLA.

● Cloud security posture management: stand up, then SLA enforcement.

● Data loss prevention: prevention and monitoring controls.

● Access control: least privilege, dual control, and other access validations.

● Network Security implementation at the cloud edge (alongside DevOps).

Detection and Response

● Operates managed detection and response end to end, including day to day interactions with the provider.

● First responder for security events, carrying triage through to closure.

● External phishing investigation and prevention.

● Selection, implementation, and operation of a SIEM (when approved).

Audit Evidence and Control Operation

● Produces and packages audit evidence for compliance frameworks (SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS v4, etc) where automated collection cannot reach it.

● Runs the recurring access review cycles; mitigates, remediates, or otherwise drives corrections.

● Builds the controls that close audit gaps, and returns the evidence that shows they operate.

Tooling, Design and Automation

● Researches, vets and recommends security tooling; owns day to day use once approved.●

● Drafts solution designs for new controls; implements on approval.

● Supports security architecture reviews for new services and integrations.

● Builds and maintains automation to remove recurring manual work from role scope.

Also Supports

● Technical contact for the QSA, ASV and external auditor, including the quarterly external scan cycle.

● Security questionnaires (CAIQ, HECVAT, etc) answered from the evidence library, and upkeep of that library.

● Review of vendor security assessments.

● Security awareness training, including Internal phishing simulation campaigns and content recommended for approval.

Qualifications:

REQUIRED:

Experience: 5+ years full time in an in-house security role, with hands-on ownership of controls in one or more of the domains above, and a track record of driving findings to verified closure.

Technical Skills:

○ Identity and access including least privilege, privileged access, conditional access, and running access reviews.

○ Detection and response using an EDR, a SIEM or a managed provider, from triage through containment.

○ Vulnerability management measured by closure rather than detection.

○ Audit evidence production for SOC 2, ISO 27001, HITRUST, PCI or equivalent, as a deliverable rather than background knowledge.

○ Endpoint management and hardening across macOS and Windows.

○ Scripting in PowerShell, Python or Bash, with API integration.

○ AI tooling Fluent use of major platforms as a daily driver.

OPTIONAL

  • Cloud security posture management in Azure or AWS.
  • Data loss prevention deployed and monitored (beyond policy writing).
  • Network security implementation: segmentation, firewalls, VLANs and VPNs.
  • Direct work with a PCI-DSS QSA, ASV or external auditor (as the technical contact).
  • Comfortable presenting to all levels of the company (executives to junior colleagues)

Certifications: CISSP, CISM, GIAC (GSEC, GCIH, GCIA), CompTIA Security+ or CySA+, Microsoft SC-200 or AZ-500, AWS Certified Security Specialty.

jobs.excerpt: Clinical Business Development Director, SNF Location: Remote, US.
jobs.description:
Clinical Business Development Director, SNF
Location: Remote, US.

About Teton

Teton is building the AI platform for care, so overstretched care teams can stay one step ahead of their residents' needs. A single optical sensor in each room runs computer vision on the device itself, building an anonymized digital twin of what's happening. No video is stored. Teton catches falls, tracks sleep and mobility, automates rounding and documentation, and forecasts staffing needs.

Founded in Copenhagen in 2020, Teton is now scaling across the United States. We're backed by Plural, Bertelsmann Investments, Antler Elevate and others, after a $20M Series A in September 2025. Operators using Teton report 50–70% fewer falls and fewer temp and night-shift hours.

The role

As Clinical Business Development Director for Skilled Nursing, you'll lead Teton's growth with US skilled nursing operators as a clinician who has lived the work. You'll open doors, build pipeline and close multi-facility deals, working alongside the REITs and asset owners who back many of these chains.

You'll speak peer to peer with directors of nursing, administrators, and chief nursing and clinical officers, as well as with regional operations leaders, CEOs and CFOs. You've run a unit or a building, so you can show how Teton changes night shifts, fall response, rounding and documentation. You can also show how that turns into better star ratings and survey results, fewer falls with injury, lower agency spend and lower liability.

You'll be Teton's clinical voice in the market. You'll shape how pilots are designed and measured, answer clinical, resident-rights and workflow questions with authority, and bring frontline insight back to Product. You'll work closely with our Solutions Architects, Deployment and Customer Success teams to turn pilots into portfolio-wide rollouts.

What you'll do

  • Lead with clinical credibility. Engage DONs, administrators, CNOs and clinical leaders as a peer. Translate Teton into the realities they manage every day: falls, night rounds, behaviors and documentation burden.

  • Build and own the pipeline. Prospect and qualify skilled nursing operators of every size, from regional chains to national portfolios. Use your clinical network, outbound outreach, events and referrals.

  • Close multi-facility deals. Run complex sales from first meeting to signed contract, navigating clinical, operations, finance, IT and compliance stakeholders.

  • Make the clinical and financial case. Show value in operator terms: falls with injury, Five-Star quality measures, survey risk such as F689 (accidents and supervision), readmissions, agency spend and insurance. Partner with Solutions Architects on ROI models.

  • Design pilots clinicians trust. Help choose units, set clinical baselines and success criteria, lead executive readouts, and expand from one unit to whole buildings to the full portfolio.

  • Answer the clinical and resident-rights questions. Speak with authority about resident dignity and consent, alarm fatigue, care-plan integration, and how Teton fits nursing workflows and the survey process.

  • Work the asset-owner channel. Build relationships with REITs, senior housing investors and lenders, so they back and help roll out Teton across their operators.

  • Negotiate commercial terms. Shape pricing, contract structure and multi-site expansion terms that work for thin-margin, Medicaid-heavy operators.

  • Be visible in the clinical and industry community. Represent Teton at AHCA/NCAL, AAPACN, state associations, LeadingAge and investor conferences. Build Teton's reputation in post-acute care.

  • Bring the clinical voice inside Teton. Share frontline and market insight with leadership, Product and Marketing on workflows, features, messaging, competitors and pricing.

  • Forecast accurately. Keep CRM hygiene tight and report pipeline and forecasts with discipline.

What you bring

  • A clinical background in skilled nursing or post-acute care, with an active or past RN license or a nursing home administrator license (LNHA/NHA). We strongly prefer candidates who have served as a DON, ADON, administrator, or regional clinical or operations leader.

  • 5+ years in business development, sales or account leadership, selling technology or services to skilled nursing or post-acute operators. Ideally, this follows a career on the operator side.

  • A track record of closing or driving multi-facility contracts, and of consistently hitting targets.

  • An established network among SNF clinical and operator leaders, including DONs, CNOs, administrators and regional VPs. Relationships with REITs or senior housing investors are a strong plus.

  • Deep, first-hand understanding of SNF clinical operations and economics: MDS and PDPM, Five-Star ratings, the state survey process and F-tags, falls management, staffing models and agency costs.

  • Skill at running complex, consultative sales with clinical, operational, financial and IT buyers. You can be as credible with a night-shift CNA as with a CEO.

  • Comfort selling new technology, including AI and sensors, and turning it into clear clinical and operational outcomes.

  • A builder's mindset: self-directed, resourceful and comfortable creating process at a growing company.

  • Willingness to travel to customer sites and industry events, roughly 40–60% of the time.

Nice to have

  • Clinical leadership at a multi-facility operator, such as regional nurse consultant, VP of clinical services or chief nursing officer.

  • Certifications such as RAC-CT, DNS-CT or IPCO.

  • Experience leading falls-prevention, QAPI or other quality improvement programs with measurable results.

  • Experience selling fall-prevention, remote monitoring, computer vision or other clinical technology, or EHR-adjacent products in post-acute care.

  • A history of building a territory or market from scratch at an early-stage company.

  • Experience with group purchasing organizations (GPOs), state associations or channel partnerships in long-term care.

  • Familiarity with value-based care arrangements, including institutional special needs plans (I-SNPs) and SNF value-based purchasing.

Details and benefits

  • Location: Remote, US.

  • Reports to: VP of Sales

  • Compensation & Benefits: a competitive salary and participation in our warrant program, a 401(k) plan, health insurance and paid time off. You'll work with state-of-the-art AI in a pioneering field, on a team that cares about learning.

Teton is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds, and especially encourage people who have worked inside care settings to apply.

jobs.title: Technical Co-founder - AI Workforce for Law Firms
jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityAI is changing the economics of legal practice.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

AI is changing the economics of legal practice. Work that once took hours can increasingly be done in minutes, creating both enormous leverage for lawyers and new pressure to win and serve more clients efficiently.

Yet solo practitioners and small law firms still face many of the same constraints: missed calls, slow follow-up, intake handled between client matters, inconsistent marketing, and administrative work competing with billable time. Building larger intake, administrative, and marketing teams is expensive and increasingly unnecessary.

BloomLex is building a different model: a managed AI workforce that helps small law firms grow without growing their team.

The customer thesis has been validated through live pilots, and multiple deployments are moving into production evaluation. The next phase is proving in-production reliability, delivery economics, repeatability, and scalability. The companies that successfully deploy trusted AI workers into professional-service verticals over the next 18 months have an opportunity to define entirely new categories. We intend to be one of them.

The Venture

BloomLex is building an AI workforce for solo practitioners and small law firms, helping them win and serve more clients without adding headcount.

We call the broader shift the Rise of the Solo: AI gives an individual lawyer or a small firm access to capabilities that historically required a much larger organization.

Unlike self-serve software, BloomLex is fully managed. We configure, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve the AI workforce for each firm. Our customers evaluate us on outcomes — calls answered, prospective clients captured, consultations booked, demand generated, follow-up completed, and time saved — not on how much software they configure themselves.

Our Bloomlex workforce starts with two teammates:

Ava — AI Front Desk. Ava answers calls 24/7, handles structured intake, screens and routes inquiries, books consultations, performs outbound callbacks and follow-up, and integrates those interactions into the firm's workflow.

Claire — AI Marketing Assistant. Claire helps firms generate and nurture demand through content, digital marketing, campaign management and optimization, lead nurturing, and ongoing marketing execution.

Together, Ava and Claire address both sides of growth: Claire helps create demand; Ava helps ensure that demand is captured and converted.

They are also the beginning, not the end, of the platform. Our roadmap expands the AI workforce across the operational side of the practice — including custom workflows and additional specialized AI roles — all delivered through the same managed model and coordinated around the lawyer.

The Partnership

The CEO co-founder is in place. The customer thesis is validated, design partners are engaged, live pilots are running, and the initial product architecture exists. What remains is to bring on the technical co-founder — a partner who will own product and engineering with the same conviction, urgency, and ownership as the CEO.

This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with decision collaboration on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.

You will inherit working products and live deployments, but you will not inherit sacred architecture. Your job is to determine what should survive, what should be rebuilt, and what needs to exist for BloomLex to scale from pilots to thousands of firms.

Role & Responsibilities

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will be a hands-on builder first and the architect of the technical organization that follows.

  • Product & Architecture — Own the technical architecture across Ava, Claire, and the broader BloomLex AI workforce. Make the build-versus-buy decisions that determine where BloomLex creates durable technical advantage.

  • Voice AI & Reliability — Harden Ava's real-time voice, telephony, intake, scheduling, routing, and workflow systems for production reliability. Establish observability, evaluation, escalation, and audit-trail standards appropriate for a trust-sensitive environment.

  • Agentic Workflows — Build reliable AI systems capable of executing multi-step operational and marketing workflows across voice, email, SMS, web, calendars, CRM and practice-management systems, with appropriate human oversight.

  • Managed AI Delivery Layer — Build the internal infrastructure that allows BloomLex to configure, deploy, monitor, evaluate, and continuously improve AI workers across hundreds and eventually thousands of firms without scaling engineering or implementation headcount linearly.

  • AI Quality & Economics — Own the trade-offs among model capability, latency, reliability, privacy, and inference cost. Build an architecture capable of delivering strong gross margins within the initial ~$499/month product model as usage scales.

  • Data, Security & Trust — Establish the security, privacy, tenancy, permissions, data-retention, and audit architecture required to earn the trust of law firms and their clients.

  • Customer & Market — Work directly with lawyers and design partners, translating real-world workflows and failure modes into product decisions. Represent BloomLex with customers, partners, and investors as the technical voice of the company.

  • Roadmap — Help convert pilots into repeatable commercial deployments, expand the AI workforce beyond Ava and Claire, deepen integrations into law-firm workflows, and establish a path toward custom and self-hosted models where economics, performance, privacy, or legal requirements justify them.

  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding engineering team and establish a culture of speed, accountability, technical rigour, and customer obsession.

Co-Founder Profile

We are looking for a technical founder, not simply an engineering manager.

You have:

  • Shipped LLM-powered, agentic, voice, or automation systems into production environments where incorrect outputs and system failures carried meaningful consequences

  • Full-stack confidence across applied LLMs, conversational and real-time voice AI, APIs and integrations, workflow orchestration, observability, data architecture, and secure multi-tenant SaaS

  • Strong instincts around AI evaluation, reliability engineering, edge-case management, hallucination mitigation, human-in-the-loop design, and production monitoring

  • Well-formed convictions about the trade-offs among AI quality, latency, reliability, privacy, and cost

  • Experience building platforms that combine software with managed or service-heavy delivery, with the discipline to automate delivery rather than scale headcount linearly

  • The ability and willingness to work directly with customers and turn messy real-world workflows into reliable products

  • The mindset of a principal and owner — including the willingness to say “this won't scale,” “this isn't ready,” or “we need to rebuild this” when the integrity of the product requires it

  • The desire to remain deeply hands-on while building the team around you

Strongly preferred:

  • Prior founder or early-stage technical leadership experience

  • Experience with production voice AI, telephony, agentic workflows, or AI evaluation infrastructure

  • Background in legal tech, healthcare, financial services, or another trust-sensitive vertical

  • Experience with security, privacy, and compliance requirements involving sensitive customer data

  • Experience deploying or self-hosting open-source/custom models where privacy, latency, control, or economics require it

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

职位概况

我们正在寻找一位位于佛山或周边地区的兼职合同制家具采购与物流代理，协助一个定制住宅项目完成家具、家居材料及相关物流的实地采购工作。你将根据设计师和业主家庭的需求，走访佛山及周边家具市场、展厅、工厂、仓库和供应商，收集报价、照片、视频和规格信息，并协助推进下单、付款、验货、包装、运输和交付安排。

工作内容

  • 走访佛山及周边城市的家具市场、展厅、工厂、仓库和供应商。

  • 根据设计需求、预算、尺寸、材质和时间要求寻找合适家具选项。

  • 在合适情况下协助谈价和确认条款，帮助筛选可靠供应商。

  • 协调下单、付款、验货、包装、本地运输、出口或国内物流以及交付时间。

  • 用英文和中文与业主家庭、设计师、供应商和物流方清晰沟通。

  • 用简单共享表格或文档跟踪价格、联系人、决策和下一步事项。

任职要求

  • 常驻佛山，或能够经常前往佛山家具市场和供应商处。

  • 中文沟通能力强；具备用于更新、总结和电话沟通的英文能力。

  • 有家具采购、室内设计采购、出口物流、买手或采购代理等实地采购经验。

  • 对质量、材质、饰面、尺寸和实际交付细节有判断力。

  • 能够独立走访供应商，快速推进，并提供有条理的更新。

  • 做事可靠透明，能谨慎处理报价、付款、时间线和供应商沟通。

加分项

  • 在佛山、乐从、顺德或周边家具产业带有现成供应商资源。

  • 有定制家具、住宅装修项目或国际运输经验。

  • 能够检查样品、饰面、软包、木材、石材、金属、灯具或相关家居材料。

申请问题

  • 请简要说明你与家具采购、供应商协调或物流相关的经验。

  • 请说明你通常能前往佛山家具市场或供应商处的频率。

  • 如有相关项目照片、供应商案例、采购表格或作品集，请附上链接。

Role Overview

We are looking for a part-time contract furniture sourcing and logistics agent based in Foshan or nearby. This is a one-time project for a custom family home after the design is complete. You will help source furniture and related home materials, visit suppliers in person, collect quotes and specifications, and coordinate the practical details from selection through ordering, inspection, packing, transport, and delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Visit furniture markets, showrooms, factories, warehouses, and suppliers in Foshan and nearby cities.

  • Strong spoken and written Chinese; working English for updates, summaries, and calls.

  • Experience in furniture sourcing, interior design procurement, export logistics, buying agency work, or similar hands-on sourcing work.

  • Good eye for quality, materials, finishes, dimensions, and practical delivery details.

  • Comfortable moving quickly, visiting suppliers independently, and sending organized updates.

  • Reliable, transparent, and careful with pricing, payments, timelines, and vendor communication.

Helpful but not required

  • Existing supplier contacts in Foshan, Lecong, Shunde, or nearby furniture hubs.

  • Experience with custom furniture, home renovation projects, or international shipping.

  • Ability to inspect samples, finishes, upholstery, wood, stone, metalwork, lighting, or related home materials.

Application questions

  • Please apply with a short note about your relevant sourcing, furniture, supplier coordination, or logistics experience.

About Tala

Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority. We combine proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. To date, Tala has distributed more than $9 billion in capital to more than 14 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia, building the definitive contextual dataset on thin-file borrowers in emerging markets. Tala is now converting that foundation into shared infrastructure that partners, capital providers, and ecosystems can build on.

The company has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies twice, CNBC Disruptor 50 for five years, and Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for ten years running.
Given the global nature of our team, we operate on a remote-first approach with office hubs in Santa Monica, CA (HQ); Nairobi, Kenya; Mexico City, Mexico; Manila, the Philippines; and Bangalore, India.
Most Talazens join us because they connect with our mission. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Tala, we’d love to hear from you!

The Role

We’re seeking an innovative Creative Strategist who will develop impactful creatives to drive global customer growth. Your key goals will be to scale performance marketing spend with high efficiency and shape Tala’s positioning in the FinTech category. You will own creative strategy and production across Mexico and LATAM (Guatemala, Dominican Republic), collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver on paid user acquisition, ASO and partner marketing goals. This role requires a strong understanding of performance marketing, ASO and partner marketing creative metrics, a passion for working with creatives, and strong project management skills.

What You'll Do

  • Creative Strategy & Ideation: Own the LATAM creative roadmap based on performance, business priorities and testing needs. Research and pitch new concepts, and work with artists to refine paid media, ASO and partner creative to maximize success rate. Analyze market trends, competitor strategies and consumer insights to identify opportunities across paid, organic and partner channels.

  • Testing & Performance Reporting: Work with Growth Marketers on testing schedules and campaign structures. Review test and ad performance weekly in Omni and decide what to continue, iterate, refresh or replace. Turn creative metrics into actionable insights and share them with vendors and artists.

  • Creative Production & Contractor Management: Develop the concept, copy, scripts and visual direction for each test, and write detailed Jira briefs for internal artists and contractors. Own the production timeline: assign briefs based on format and contractor availability, manage deadlines and feedback rounds, and review deliveries through final approval. Prepare final assets for launch, set naming conventions and handoff to Growth Marketers.

  • Budget Management: At month end, review contractor invoices, keep the Budget Tracker accurate and follow through on payment with Accounting.

  • Cultural Adaption: Adapt winning concepts across LATAM geos, ensuring creatives resonate culturally and carry the correct market-specific legal requirements.

  • Cross-Functional & Partner Alignment: Stay close to Brand (campaigns, events), Product (launches and updates) and Customer Research (new insights). Join partner meetings and develop growth and creative initiatives that help partners activate Tala and grow their programs.

jobs.description:
Description:

The Senior Key Accounts Manager - Regional Payers is a senior individual contributor responsible for the business-to-business relationships, strategic account planning, and measurable business performance of an assigned regional payer portfolio. The Senior Key Accounts Manager will be accountable for gaining, protecting, and improving profitable formulary and medical policy access; influencing downstream adoption and accurate implementation of parent-account access; identifying and advancing financially sound regional contracting opportunities; quantifying business impact; leading approved pull-through; and bringing actionable payer intelligence into portfolio and launch decisions. This role requires cross-functional leadership with Pricing and Contracting, Finance, Legal, Medical Affairs and MSLs, Brand, Patient Services, Field Reimbursement, Sales, Trade, Analytics, Government Affairs, and other internal stakeholders.

Essential Functions:

Opportunity Advancement and Business Outcomes:

  • Secure, maintain, and improve profitable formulary placement and written medical policy coverage across pharmacy and medical benefits.
  • Identify and advance financially sound regional contracting and strategic partnership opportunities in alignment with the applicable Key Account Manager and approved parent-account strategy.
  • Build and present business cases using volume, claims, reimbursement, formulary, competitive, rebate, discount, and financial data; clearly articulate forecast impact, access risk, expected return, and recommended action to senior leadership.
  • Support or lead approved regional contract discussions and manage opportunities through approval, signature, implementation, and performance monitoring.
  • Measures of success: advance at least one priority opportunity each quarter and deliver two to three documented access or business wins annually.
  • Current portfolio measures include advancing at least two systemic access issues across the Specialty portfolio; targeting two measurable coverage or implementation improvements through priority BCBS and other regional plans and selected large IDN specialty centers or health-system accounts; and qualifying three Biosciences or Pipeline opportunities, including Medicaid coverage opportunities, with at least one advanced annually.

Account Focus and Coverage Intelligence:

  • Serve as the primary account owner and day-to-day Amneal contact for assigned East or West regional health plans and downstream payer accounts.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans aligned with Amneal portfolio objectives and the applicable parent-account strategy.
  • Build multi-level relationships across pharmacy, medical, contracting, industry relations, utilization management, and other relevant customer functions.
  • Maintain current knowledge of each account's decision-making structure, lines of business, PBM and rebate aggregator relationships, benefit design, utilization management, coverage criteria, and implementation processes.
  • Maintain a cross-portfolio coverage, barrier, and opportunity tracker for priority Blues, regional plans, IDNs, health systems, and Medicaid plans.
  • Measures of success: Every priority account has current coverage status, a defined business issue or opportunity, an accountable owner, a next step, and timing.

Strategic Engagement and Pull-Through:

  • Lead approved regional payer, Blue, IDN, health-system, or state engagement when tied to a defined access issue, contracting opportunity, implementation need, or broader business priority.
  • Develop, implement, and measure PRC-approved pull-through strategies based on formulary and medical policy access.
  • Work with Sales, Field Reimbursement, Patient Services, Brand, Medical Affairs, Trade, and other matrix partners to resolve barriers and maximize the value of access wins.
  • Communicate account-specific coverage changes, affordability issues, and local business impact through approved training, business reviews, regional calls, and other appropriate forums.
  • Measures of success: priority engagements have a clear objective, next step, and documented outcome; meeting volume alone is not a performance measure.

Field, Launch, and Portfolio Insight:

  • Quarterback regional account initiatives and coordinate appropriate engagement by Key Account Manager and cross-functional partners.
  • Bring customer insights, emerging payer trends, regional access opportunities, and competitive intelligence into parent-account planning, brand strategy, contracting decisions, and portfolio planning.
  • Support launches by ensuring regional payer plans, implementation requirements, and field communication are incorporated into launch readiness.
  • Maintain knowledge of payer economics, relevant laws and policy changes, competitor activity, and patient affordability dynamics.
  • For pre-launch activities across the Pipeline, gather compliant regional intelligence on testing and confirmed diagnosis, PA and coverage criteria, competitors, benefit pathway, and review timing; map the top five priority regional plans and conduct payer discussions when they inform a broader launch decision.
  • Measures of success: provide quarterly regional coverage and payer updates with a clear field, brand, contracting, or launch action.

Sobre el rol

Estamos buscando un/a Data Engineer Semi-Senior con experiencia práctica en Neo4j, Cypher y modelado de datos en grafos para sumarse a un proyecto innovador de LegalTech enfocado en transformar la manera en que se organiza, conecta y consulta información legal, tributaria, contable y regulatoria.

Buscamos una persona con una base sólida en ingeniería de datos, experiencia real trabajando con Neo4j y motivación por seguir desarrollándose en Knowledge Graphs, búsqueda semántica y GraphRAG.

  • Modelado de grafos: Diseñar, implementar y mantener modelos de datos en Neo4j, representando entidades, relaciones, jerarquías y estructuras complejas de información.

  • Desarrollo con Cypher: Crear y optimizar consultas complejas para recuperación de información, navegación de relaciones y procesamiento de datos en grafos.
  • Implementación de Knowledge Graphs: Transformar taxonomías, ontologías y modelos conceptuales definidos por Data Science en estructuras productivas dentro de Neo4j.

  • Integración con Backend: Desarrollar integraciones mediante Python o Node.js para conectar los datos del grafo con aplicaciones, APIs y servicios internos.
  • Calidad de datos: Implementar validaciones, controles automatizados y buenas prácticas para garantizar la integridad y confiabilidad de la información.
  • Trabajo interdisciplinario: Colaborar con especialistas en Data Science, Inteligencia Artificial y desarrollo de software para evolucionar la arquitectura de datos.

¿Qué buscamos?

  • Experiencia: Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia profesional en Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering o posiciones similares.
  • Neo4j: Experiencia práctica diseñando, implementando y manteniendo soluciones basadas en bases de datos de grafos.

  • Modelado de datos: Conocimiento de modelos Property Graph, nodos, relaciones, labels, propiedades y buenas prácticas de diseño.
  • ETL/ELT: Experiencia desarrollando pipelines de ingesta, transformación e integración de datos.
  • Programación: Manejo de Python o Node.js para procesamiento de datos, automatización o integración con servicios.
  • Optimización: Conocimiento de índices, constraints, optimización de consultas y performance de bases de datos.
  • Arquitectura de datos: Capacidad para transformar requerimientos funcionales y técnicos en modelos de datos escalables y mantenibles.
  • Fundamentos de IA: Familiaridad con embeddings, búsqueda semántica, bases vectoriales o conceptos de RAG.
  • Autonomía y colaboración: Capacidad analítica, resolución de problemas, documentación técnica y buena comunicación con equipos interdisciplinarios.

Será un plus

  • Experiencia con Knowledge Graphs, GraphRAG o arquitecturas de recuperación híbrida.
  • Conocimiento de Neo4j APOC, Graph Data Science (GDS) o Neo4j Vector Index.
  • Familiaridad con tecnologías semánticas como RDF, OWL, SKOS o SHACL.
  • Experiencia integrando Neo4j con LangChain, LlamaIndex u otros frameworks de IA.

Why work here

HDVI is building the industry-defining commercial auto insurance company for the next 100 years. The $50 billion commercial auto industry hasn’t seen real innovation for decades and is broken in a number of ways, creating a significant opportunity for HDVI.

HDVI has a senior management team with experience building innovative insurance and logistics companies from zero to $1B+ enterprises and deep expertise in trucking insurance.

The HDVI Team is values-driven, data-driven, ambitious, and collaboratively minded, with a diverse background of experiences and skills in the insurance and logistics industries. We like challenges and building solutions that improve the quality of life for our customers. We offer generous benefits, including health, dental, vision, 401k match, flexible work environment, and unlimited PTO.

About the Role

As a Senior Liability Adjuster, you will work closely with HDVI’s Claims and Fleet Services Teams. The ideal candidate will have extensive knowledge of handling all aspects of Commercial Trucking claims inclusive of but not limited to Third Party Bodily Injury, Third Party Auto Property Damage, First Party Auto Property Damage, Cargo, Truckers General Liability and First Party Medical. You will be responsible for influencing and providing claim resolution and tactical guidance to both internal and external customers in order to achieve world class claims outcomes.

What You'll Do

  • Independently investigate, evaluate, negotiate, and resolve complex commercial auto liability claims, including bodily injury, attorney-represented, litigated, high-severity, and large-loss exposures from assignment through final resolution.

  • Manage high-exposure and large-loss claims proactively, identifying adverse development and severity indicators early, escalating claims in accordance with established protocols, and developing comprehensive action plans addressing investigative needs, litigation considerations, reserves, settlement opportunities, resolution strategies, and next steps.
  • Evaluate complex bodily injury damages and establish appropriate reserves, including analysis of medical records, treatment, causation, permanency, future medical exposure, wage loss, and other damages while establishing, evaluating, and adjusting loss and expense reserves based on expected ultimate claim exposure and evolving claim circumstances.
  • Negotiate complex settlements and drive effective claim resolution, working with claimants, plaintiff attorneys, insurers, and other involved parties within established authority while identifying and pursuing subrogation, contribution, indemnification, and other recovery opportunities.
  • Manage litigated claims and defense counsel strategy, including legal budgets, discovery, depositions, expert selection, mediation, settlement conferences, and trial preparation, while coordinating the appropriate use of Rapid Response, SIU, accident reconstruction, independent medical evaluations, investigators, experts, and other specialized resources.
  • Participate in large-loss reviews, severity roundtables, reserve reviews, mediations, and claim strategy discussions, providing Claims leadership with well-supported recommendations regarding exposure, reserves, litigation strategy, settlement opportunities, and overall claim direction.
  • Serve as a senior technical resource, mentor, and escalation point, providing less-experienced adjusters with guidance on investigations, liability analysis, reserving, negotiations, litigation strategy, and Claims Best Practices while assisting Claims leadership with complex file reviews, training, quality initiatives, process improvement, and identification of emerging claim trends.
  • Maintain proactive communication, comprehensive documentation, and regulatory compliance, working effectively with insureds, claimants, attorneys, brokers, defense counsel, vendors, and internal business partners while ensuring claim files meet Claims Best Practices, regulatory requirements, service expectations, and established authority levels.
  • Effectively manage a complex claim inventory with a high degree of independent judgment, ownership, and accountability, meeting expectations for quality, productivity, customer service, cycle time, reserve accuracy, financial stewardship, and claim outcomes while maintaining a strong internal and external customer focus.

What You Have

  • 5+ years of commercial auto liability claims experience, including significant experience independently handling bodily injury, attorney-represented, litigated, complex, large-loss, and high-severity claims from investigation through resolution.
  • College education or an equivalent combination of education and relevant claims experience preferred, along with an active Adjuster’s License and the ability to obtain and maintain all required state licenses.
  • Advanced knowledge of commercial auto claims, including coverage analysis, liability investigation, negligence principles, damages evaluation, reserving, settlement negotiation, litigation management, commercial trucking operations, motor carrier exposures, and applicable state and federal regulations.
  • Demonstrated experience managing large-loss and high-exposure claims, including developing comprehensive claim strategies, evaluating exposure, establishing and adjusting reserves, preparing settlement recommendations, participating in mediations and settlement conferences, and managing claims through litigation.
  • Strong bodily injury evaluation capabilities, including analysis of medical records, treatment, causation, permanency, future medical exposure, wage loss, and other damages necessary to accurately assess claim value and potential adverse development.
  • Strong litigation, negotiation, and vendor-management experience, including negotiating directly with plaintiff attorneys and managing defense counsel, experts, investigators, accident reconstruction professionals, and other specialized resources throughout litigation, mediation, settlement, and claim resolution.
  • Experience handling complex commercial trucking exposures, including large deductibles, Independent Owner-Operators (IOOs), and other commercial trucking arrangements, with the ability to utilize telematics, dash-camera footage, GPS/ELD information, crash data, and other evidence to support coverage, liability, causation, and severity assessments.
  • Strong reserving, analytical, critical-thinking, problem-solving, and independent decision-making skills, with demonstrated ability to recognize adverse development, adjust reserves as claim exposure evolves, and make sound decisions in complex or ambiguous claim situations.
  • Demonstrated senior-level communication, organization, and leadership capabilities, including managing multiple complex claims, competing priorities, and critical deadlines; clearly communicating claim evaluations, strategies, and recommendations to leadership and business partners; and serving as a technical resource and mentor to less-experienced claims professionals.
  • Strong internal and external customer focus and technology proficiency, with a commitment to responsive, professional, fair, and consistent claim handling; proficiency with Google Workspace, Adobe Acrobat, and claims management technology, with Snapsheet or similar platform experience preferred.

Benefits

About the Role

At Jerry, we are redefining and radically improving how people manage car ownership, one of their most expensive and time-consuming assets. Backed by artificial intelligence and machine learning, Jerry simplifies and automates car ownership while providing personalized services tailored to all car owners' needs. We are the #1 rated and most downloaded app in our category with a 4.7-star rating in the App Store and more than 5 million customers — and we're just getting started.

We're looking for a Creative Director (Video) with a strong visual eye and a genuine curiosity about performance creative. Someone who cares deeply about craft, moves fast, and is excited by how AI and new media are reshaping what great advertising looks like. You'll work closely with senior creative leads to concept, produce, and iterate video ads across TikTok, Meta, YouTube, and CTV — learning and contributing at every stage of the process.

Why you will (or won't) like working here:

Large canvas: You won't inherit a set-in-stone playbook. You'll have real creative input and contribute meaningfully to our brand foundation early in your career.

Hands-on from day one: This isn't a support role. You'll be concepting, editing, and iterating — using AI tools and your own creative instincts to ship work that performs.

Car ownership is not "sexy": Insurance, maintenance, and safety are only topics people think about when they have a bill to pay or a flat tire to change. Can you build enthusiasm and trust around a "dry" topic? That's the creative challenge here.

What You'll Do

  • Concept and produce video creative across paid social, CTV, and emerging channels — working end-to-end from brief to delivery under the guidance of senior creative leads.

  • Lead a small and nimble team

  • Bring a sharp visual eye to every asset: elevating composition, pacing, and storytelling to raise Jerry's brand while keeping performance top of mind.

  • Stay on top of platform trends, formats, and cultural shifts to ensure Jerry's creative stays fresh and effective.

  • Develop hooks, angles, and visual frameworks rooted in what drives real performance — not just what looks good.

  • Edit video directly: fluent in editing tools and comfortable cutting, iterating, and polishing ads at speed.

  • Leverage AI tools (for ideation, scripting, editing, asset generation, etc.) to accelerate workflows and expand creative range.

  • Collaborate closely with media, growth, and senior creative teammates to turn performance signals into stronger creative work.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years in video creative, art direction, or production — at a performance agency, in-house growth team, or content studio.

  • A growing track record contributing to video creative for paid channels (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, CTV, etc.).

  • Strong visual instincts — you have an eye for design, composition, pacing, and brand quality.

  • Video editing fluency — you can cut and iterate ads yourself, making them feel polished without heavy direction.

  • Performance creative curiosity — you understand (or are actively learning) what makes people stop scrolling: hooks, pacing, CTAs.

  • Collaborative and eager mindset — comfortable in fast-paced environments and open to feedback from creative and analytics teams alike.

  • AI fluency — you experiment with generative tools to speed up production and expand what's creatively possible.

  • Bonus: exposure to both performance and brand creative contexts. You're building a point of view on how craft and conversion can coexist.

Why This Role Matters

Jerry's creative team has proven performance chops — and we're ready to level up. This role is an opportunity to grow fast inside a creative engine that blends craft, data, AI, and media strategy. jobs.description:
Bei egg schaffen wir Erlebnisse. Echte Erlebnisse.

Die Art von Erlebnissen, die Kreativität, kluges Denken, Liebe zum Detail und hin und wieder auch eine gute Portion Humor erfordern, wenn sich fünf Minuten vor dem Go-live plötzlich alles ändert.

Wir arbeiten über Ländergrenzen, Kulturen und Kunden hinweg. Deshalb geht es bei uns oft schnell, und kein Tag gleicht dem anderen. Genau das mögen wir. Es bedeutet aber auch, dass wir Menschen brauchen, die auch unter Druck einen kühlen Kopf bewahren, mehrere Bälle gleichzeitig in der Luft behalten können, Verantwortung übernehmen und Wert auf Kundenzufriedenheit legen.

Keine großen Egos. Keine Fehler verstecken. Keine stillen Hühner in diesem Nest.

Und damit zu dir

Du bleibst ruhig, wenn es chaotisch wird, denkst klar, wenn sich Prioritäten verschieben, und übernimmst Verantwortung, ohne dass alles bis ins letzte Detail vorgegeben sein muss (denn das ist es selten). Du legst Wert auf Ergebnisse, Qualität und kontinuierliche Verbesserung. Du liebst Prozesse. Außerdem bist du neugierig auf intelligentere Arbeitsweisen – einschließlich KI, Automatisierung und moderner Tools, die Arbeit einfacher und wirkungsvoller machen.

Und vor allem: Du bringst Dinge zu Ende. Richtig. Keine halbgaren Eier.

Deine Aufgaben

In dieser Rolle arbeitest du zu 100 % für einen unserer wichtigsten Pharmakunden.

  • Du unterstützt die erfolgreiche Umsetzung von Projekten und Veranstaltungen – von der Planung bis zum Abschluss.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Kund:innen, internen Teams und Lieferanten zusammen und sorgst für eine reibungslose Projektabwicklung.

  • Du koordinierst Timelines, Budgets, Ressourcen und Projektaktivitäten und stellst sicher, dass Deadlines eingehalten werden.

  • Du unterstützt bei der Einhaltung von Kundenstandards, Prozessen sowie regulatorischen Anforderungen im Gesundheitsbereich.

  • Du erkennst potenzielle Herausforderungen frühzeitig, bringst Lösungen ein und eskalierst Themen bei Bedarf.

  • Du trägst aktiv zum Wissensaustausch und zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Prozessen und Arbeitsweisen bei.

Das bringst du mit

(Und wir meinen das wirklich ernst: Kandidat:innen, die die folgenden Kriterien nicht erfüllen, können leider nicht berücksichtigt werden.)

Erfahrung & Fähigkeiten

  • Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Event-Projektmanagement innerhalb einer Eventagentur, idealerweise mit Kunden aus der Pharma- und/oder Gesundheitsbranche.

  • Gute Kenntnisse von Projektmanagement-Methoden sowie Erfahrung in der Koordination mehrerer Projekte gleichzeitig.

  • Verständnis für regulatorische Anforderungen und Compliance-Vorgaben im Gesundheitswesen oder die Bereitschaft, sich schnell in diese Themen einzuarbeiten.

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Teams, Kund:innen und verschiedenen Stakeholdern.

  • Gute Kenntnisse von Teilnehmermanagement-Tools, idealerweise Cvent, sowie ausgeprägte organisatorische Fähigkeiten.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Bonuspunkte gibt's, wenn du außerdem ...

  • Bereits kleinere Projekte eigenständig geleitet hast.

  • Erfahrung in der Pharma-, Healthcare- oder Life-Science-Branche mitbringst.

  • Interesse an KI, Automatisierung und neuen Technologien hast, die Projektarbeit effizienter machen.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Flexible Arbeitsmodelle (je nach Standort remote oder hybrid)

  • Attraktives Gehalt plus leistungsabhängigen Bonus

  • Homeoffice-/Technologie-Zuschuss und eine Pluxee Benefits Karte

  • Smarte, hilfsbereite Kolleg:innen, die wirklich gerne zusammenarbeiten

  • Internationale Karrieremöglichkeiten und ein globales Offsite-Event an großartigen Orten

  • Dort wo wir Büros haben, kostenlosen Kaffee, haustierfreundliche Büros und eine Unternehmenskultur, die sich genauso um Menschen wie um Leistung kümmert

(Ja, der Kaffee ist wirklich gut. Wir sind schließlich keine Monster.)

Der Bewerbungsprozess

  • Online-Bewerbung

    (Du hast nach rechts gewischt.)

  • Erstes Kennenlerngespräch

    (Wir haben auch nach rechts gewischt – schauen wir, ob die Chemie stimmt.)

  • Erstes Interview

    (Wir mögen dich! Jetzt wird es Zeit, ein wenig tiefer einzusteigen.)

  • Zweites Interview

    (Okay, wir mögen dich wirklich sehr. Lust, die Familie kennenzulernen? Keine Sorge, die meisten Eier benehmen sich ganz ordentlich.)

  • Angebot

    (Wir sind verliebt. Hoffentlich du auch.)

Der wichtigste Teil

Bei egggeht Feedback in alle Richtungen: nach oben, nach unten und zur Seite. Wir glauben daran, dass Verantwortung und Freundlichkeit perfekt zusammenpassen.

Fehler sind hier erlaubt – solange wir dazu stehen, daraus lernen und sie nicht wiederholen.

Wir sind stolz auf ein Team aus Menschen mit unterschiedlichsten Lebenswegen, Hintergründen und Perspektiven. Wir sind überzeugt, dass genau das unsere Arbeit besser, unser Denken schärfer und unsere Ergebnisse stärker macht.

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen aller Geschlechter, einschließlich trans- und nicht-binärer Personen, sowie von Menschen aus BIPOC-Communities, LGBTQ2S+-Communities und von Menschen mit sichtbaren oder nicht sichtbaren Behinderungen.

Außerdem sind wir ein ESG-orientiertes Unternehmen und setzen uns dafür ein, positive Auswirkungen zu erzielen – weit über die Grenzen unseres eigenen Unternehmens hinaus.tive impact beyond our own walls.

jobs.description:
Life Underwriting Auditor

Please note, this is a remote role based in one of the 23 States Ladder is currently hiring in - AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, IA, KS, MA, MD, MN, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, TX, VA, WA, WI with the exception of the following cities: SF Bay Area, New York City, and Seattle.

About Ladder

We saw a problem within the life insurance industry: getting covered took too long, involved too much paperwork, and required too many in-person meetings with sales agents. Having lost his father at a young age, our CEO, Jamie, was determined to make it easier for people to get the coverage they needed to provide for their families. So, we got to work. We developed a method of real-time underwriting leveraging AI and, in doing so, reduced the months-long process of applying for life insurance to minutes. Our digital experience is quick (instant decisions!), loved by users (check out our Trustpilot or Google reviews) and prolific ($74 billion+ in coverage provided).

Please note, Ladder is not currently sponsoring or transferring OPT or H1-B visas.

What You’ll Do

We believe life insurance innovation must happen in the context of sound underwriting decisions. As our Life Underwriting Auditor, you will bridge the gap between automated data workflows and traditional underwriting, ensuring our real-time decisions stay accurate and high quality as our models evolve. You will partner with engineering, data science, actuarial, compliance, and customer experience teams.

  • Conduct underwriting audits and case reviews to ensure accuracy, quality, and adherence to guidelines.
  • Review all data to assess mortality and risk probability. Determine rating class, terms, and conditions based on established rules, rates, and guidelines.
  • Analyze medical, personal, and financial data from both traditional and innovative data sources to make final, case-by-case decisions on individual applications, with a delegation of authority of up to $8 million.
  • Perform complex case reviews and review accelerated underwriting decisions, including cases flagged by automated engines and rule knockouts.
  • Evaluate automated underwriting engine outputs, data inputs, and predictive models. Update audit reviews as these models evolve, and recognize gaps in rules that lead to actionable updates.
  • Work with many cross-functional teams and stakeholders, clearly communicating audit findings and recommendations.
  • Contribute to internal and cross-functional projects.

Who You Are

  • A bridge-builder who is comfortable in both automated data workflows and traditional underwriting.
  • A data-driven, structured thinker who turns audit findings into actionable insights.
  • Adaptable and curious about machine learning, and comfortable as models and rules change.
  • A strong communicator and negotiator who builds trust with many teams and stakeholders.
  • An innovator. Someone who is passionate about insurance, and wants to help create a new paradigm to make insurance more accessible and affordable for the next generation of buyers
  • An optimist, committed to continuous learning, iteration, and user-centered everything.

Experience Required

  • 10+ years of life insurance underwriting experience at a leading carrier or reinsurer.
  • A delegation of authority of up to $8 million.
  • Experience conducting different types of underwriting audits and case reviews. This experience should include post-issue audits.
  • Experience with complex case reviews and accelerated underwriting.
  • Familiarity with automated underwriting engines, data inputs, predictive models, and an understanding of rule knockouts.
  • Analytical and technical skills for data analysis.
  • Proven ability to manage high volumes, fluctuating queues, and turnaround times.
  • Experience working with many cross-functional teams and stakeholders, and contributing to internal and cross-functional projects.
  • Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills.

What We Offer

Ladder is highly collaborative and fun. To support you in your role, we offer fantastic perks and benefits that reflect our mission of care and support, including:

Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage | We offer competitive healthcare, dental and vision plans for you and your family.

Flexible paid time off | Take the time that you need to rest and recharge, including our week-long winter holiday closure.

Stock options | We offer competitive stock option packages to participate in the success of building Ladder.

A rewarding 401k match program | We'll match up to 4% of your contributions as you save for your retirement goals.

Ladder Fit Program | Your health matters. That’s why Ladder provides a monthly stipend for wellness-related expenses.

Paid parental leave |We think it's crucial that new parents have time to adjust to their new lives without worrying about work, so we provide all parents inclusive of birthing, adoption, or fostering ten weeks of paid baby bonding.

Work-from-home flexibility and support | We recognize that everyone's homelife is different and support remote work. Upon joining, we provide a one-time remote office stipend for all team members and then a monthly stipend to cover WFH costs such as the internet.

Fun company-wide events | We genuinely enjoy spending time together. That’s why we plan fun virtual events to let loose and laugh.

Base pay for this role is determined by the location where the work will be performed and is aligned with the two compensation tiers, as indicated below. Base pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and business needs. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for equity and benefits as shared above.

Tier 2 & Tier 3 (All other locations that Ladder hires with eh exception of San Francisco and New York)
$100,800- $125,700

Email to apply. Ladder is building a diverse team of talented and enthusiastic people. We are an equal opportunity workplace. At Ladder, differences are celebrated and supported to benefit our people, product, and community. Let us know why you're interested in this position and what unique contributions you can make to the Ladder team. We look forward to hearing from you.

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often don't apply for roles if they don't meet all the criteria – unlike majority candidates meeting significantly fewer requirements. We strongly encourage you to apply if you’re interested: we'd love to know how you can elevate our team with your unique experience!

Role Title: Quantitative Rates Researcher

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

We are seeking experienced Quantitative Rates Researchers to evaluate AI-generated research and trading strategies for fixed-income markets. Candidates will assess methodological soundness, backtesting accuracy, and real-world trading applicability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review AI-generated quantitative research and rates trading strategies.
  • Identify issues such as lookahead bias, overfitting, data snooping, and unrealistic transaction cost assumptions.
  • Evaluate backtesting frameworks, including carry/roll-down analytics and contract roll conventions.
  • Assess signal construction, factor modeling, statistical rigor, and alpha research.
  • Provide detailed feedback on model assumptions, implementation, and research quality.
  • Collaborate with project teams to improve research evaluation processes.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience in quantitative research, analysis, or consulting focused on fixed-income or rates markets.
  • Hands-on experience building and backtesting systematic rates strategies.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python (pandas, NumPy, SciPy) or R.
  • Strong knowledge of yield curve modeling, carry/roll-down, relative value trading, SOFR/Eurodollar instruments, and Treasury futures.
  • Understanding of transaction costs, liquidity constraints, and model validation.
  • Excellent analytical, written, and collaborative communication skills.

Preferred: Experience reviewing quantitative models and ensuring compliance with best practices in quantitative finance.

jobs.excerpt: Du bist kein Verkäufer.  Du bist der Grund, warum Kunden unterschreiben.
jobs.description:
Du bist kein Verkäufer. Du bist der Grund, warum Kunden unterschreiben.

Vielleicht hast du schon die großen Deals abgeschlossen, in denen zwölf Stakeholder mitreden, drei Wettbewerber mitbieten und der Einkauf bis zur letzten Minute verhandelt. Vielleicht bist du gerade auf dem Weg dorthin und suchst die Bühne, die zu deinem Ehrgeiz passt. In beiden Fällen gilt: Du hörst nicht beim Auftrag auf, sondern baust daraus Kundenbeziehungen, die über Jahre wachsen.

Dann solltest du mit uns reden.

Xantaro plant, baut und betreibt die Netze, auf denen Deutschland kommuniziert. Unsere Kunden sind die größten Carrier, Service Provider und Industrieunternehmen in Deutschland und Europa. Wir suchen Senior Account Manager, die Kunden übernehmen, ausbauen und neue gewinnen.

Xantaro Hochleistungsnetze für Carrier, Service Provider und Enterprise - Mehr Infos auf

nicos Managed SASE, SD-WAN und Firewall für den Mittelstand, mit eigenem 24/7-SOC - Mehr Infos auf

NetDescribe Echtzeit-Monitoring, NOC- und SOC-Services, OT-Security - Mehr Infos auf

deine mission

■ Du verantwortest deine Accounts wie ein eigenes Unternehmen. Mit eigenen Kunden, eigenen Zielen und dem Freiraum, deine Strategie selbst zu bestimmen.

■ Du verkaufst die ganze Gruppe. Du erkennst, wo Netz, Security, Monitoring und Backup beim Kunden zusammengehören und holst die passenden Spezialisten aus der Gruppe an den Tisch.

■ Du baust Beziehungen, die tragen. Vom Fachbereich bis zu CTOs, Technikvorständen und Einkaufsleitern: Du wirst der Ansprechpartner, wenn es um die Zukunft ihrer Netzinfrastruktur geht.

■ Du bringst Deals über die Ziellinie. Projekte, langfristige Rahmen- und Serviceverträge, von der ersten Qualifizierung bis zur Unterschrift.

■ Du denkst in Account-Plänen statt in Quartalen. Du identifizierst Potenziale bei Bestands- und Neukunden, entwickelst strategische Account- und Action-Pläne und setzt sie konsequent um.

■ Du verkaufst Lösungen statt Boxen. Gemeinsam mit Pre-Sales, Sales Support und unseren Maintenance Services schnürst du Pakete aus Technologie, Professional und Managed Services, etwa auf Basis von Juniper und weiteren führenden Herstellern.

■ Du verhandelst auf Augenhöhe. Angebote, Verträge, Präsentationen beim Kunden: Du führst und gewinnst.

was dich auszeichnet

■ Erfahrung, die zum Level passt: Als Senior Account Manager bringst du mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit, idealerweise mit erklärungsbedürftigen IT- oder Netzwerklösungen und nachweisbare Abschlüsse bei strategischen Kunden mit großen Projektwerten.

■ Stallgeruch: Erfahrung im Carrier- und Service-Provider-Umfeld, im Enterprise- und Mittelstandsgeschäft oder im Vertrieb komplexer IT- und Netzwerklösungen.

■ Ein Netzwerk, das trägt: Als Senior bringst du belastbare Kontakte zu Entscheidern bei Kunden und Herstellern mit.

■ Methodik statt Bauchgefühl: Solution Selling, Buying-Center- und Stakeholder-Analyse, strategische Accountplanung. Erfahrung mit MEDDICC, Challenger oder ähnlichen Methoden ist ein Plus.

■ Technisches Verständnis: Du musst kein Netzwerk konfigurieren können, aber du verstehst, warum dein Kunde eines braucht, und sprichst die Sprache seiner Techniker.

■ Closer-Mentalität: Du bleibst ruhig, wenn es eng wird, behandelst Einwände souverän und bringst Deals über die Ziellinie.

■ Unternehmerisches Denken: Du handelst wie ein Owner, nicht wie ein Angestellter.

■ Sprache: verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch.

■ Ausbildung: Studium oder Ausbildung (Ingenieurwesen, Elektrotechnik, Informatik, BWL o. Ä.). Am Ende zählt aber, was du erreicht hast.

was wir dir bieten

■ Echte Bühne: Accounts bei den größten Kommunikationsunternehmen Deutschlands und Europas. Du arbeitest an Projekten, die Infrastruktur für Millionen Menschen bauen.

■ Eine Gruppe, die liefert: Spezialisten mit starkem Pre-Sales, Bid-Management, Sales Support und eigenen Services, bis hin zum 24/7-SOC. Du verkaufst, was wir auch umsetzen können.

■ Leistung, die sich auszahlt: attraktives Fixgehalt plus leistungsorientierte variable Vergütung.

■ Firmenwagen oder Car Allowance, ganz nach deiner Wahl.

■ Deutschlandweit flexibel: mobiles Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten und Büros in Köln, Münster, Frankfurt, München und Hamburg. Du organisierst dich selbst.

■ 30 Tage Urlaub, Dienstrad, Sportangebot, Corporate Benefits und vieles mehr.

■ Kurze Wege: flache Hierarchien, direkter Draht zu Head of Sales und Geschäftsführung, schnelle Entscheidungen.

■ Weiterentwicklung: gezielte Trainings, Hersteller-Zertifizierungen und ein klarer Entwicklungspfad vom Account Manager zum Senior. Und auch Senior ist bei uns keine Endstation.
