jobs.excerpt: At Red Hat, we connect an innovative community of customers, partners, and contributors to deliver an open source stack of trusted, high-performing solutions.
jobs.description:
At Red Hat, we connect an innovative community of customers, partners, and contributors to deliver an open source stack of trusted, high-performing solutions. We offer cloud, Linux, middleware, storage, and virtualization technologies, together with award-winning global customer support, consulting, and implementation services. Red Hat is a rapidly growing company supporting more than 90% of Fortune 500 companies.


Job Summary:

The Red Hat Consulting team is looking for a Senior Container Infrastructure Consultant to join us. In this role, you will learn to design and guide implementations of Red Hat OpenShift infrastructure projects to include container and virtualization technologies. You won't be expected to know everything on day one, but your ability to learn new technology quickly will be essential. This is a remote based job that can be located anywhere in the U.S. within close proximity to an airport. Successful applicants must reside in a state where Red Hat is registered to do business.


What you will do:

  • Implement automated, containerized solutions with a focus on infrastructure concerns including networking, storage, virtualization, security, logging, monitoring, and high availability and system resilience
  • Learn new technologies quickly, including container orchestration, container registries, container build strategies, cloud storage, and software-defined networks
  • Travel frequently to work alongside leading financial services, retail, telecommunication, and institutional customers
  • After joining Red Hat, you will go through an intensive training program on Kubernetes, and OpenShift technologies and related DevOps and GitOps topics.

What you will bring:

  • Associates or Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or a technical discipline
  • Experience leading successful modern cloud platform enterprise-level projects
  • Bare-Metal Infrastructure: Deep Linux (RHEL) and automated hardware provisioning (BIOS/UEFI, RAID, BMC/Redfish, Kickstart/Cobbler).
  • Advanced Networking: L2/L3 concepts, DHCP/DNS, Load Balancing, CNI (OVN-K, Calico, SR-IOV), and network security/firewall policies.
  • Kubernetes/OpenShift: Cluster architecture, lifecycle management (IPI/UPI, Kubeadm), bare-metal deployment patterns (Metal3, Ironic), Day-2 operations, Operators, and GitOps.
  • Storage: Distributed/local storage, RAID/NVMe, performance tuning, and data management/DR (Velero, OADP, Ceph/ODF).
  • Automation & IaC: Strong proficiency in Ansible and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Helm). Scripting (Bash, Python, Go).
  • Security & Compliance: Linux/Kubernetes hardening (RBAC, SCC, network policies, TLS/PKI), and compliance standards (NIST, CIS).
  • Observability: Logging/monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) and advanced platform/network troubleshooting (etcd, kernel, tcpdump).
  • Knowledge of common AddOns or third party tools. (Aria/vRealize Suite, SRM, Backup software, Performance tools)
  • Broad and deep technical experience with VMware:
    • VMWare ESXi software, including vCenter, VM lifecycle operations using VMware tools
    • Logging and Alerting functions for SRE operations available from VMware and how they integrate with non-VMware enterprise systems, such as Splunk
    • Expert level with VMware VM foundational technologies for networks ([S/DV]Switches/NSX)
    • Expert level with VMware VM foundational technologies for storage (Datastores, vSAN, vVols)
  • Additional technologies a plus: OpenStack, Red Hat Virtualization, Microsoft Hyper-V, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Microsoft Azure
  • Experience across one or more vertical industry areas
  • Ability to lead design workshops, create clear documentation, and provide knowledge transfer for Day-0/1/2 planning.
  • Demonstrated track record of working in a strategic advisory role to senior IT and business executives
  • Applied knowledge and experience working in agile, scrum, and DevOps teams
  • Excellent written, verbal communication and presentation skills
  • Willingness to travel to customer locations about 20-30 weeks per year on average throughout North America

​Here's how your skill set will evolve and what you'll learn during your first year in the role:


At 2 months, be prepared to join a project team by acquiring the following:

  • Understanding of how to build production-ready container and virtualization platforms, integrated with existing enterprise systems
  • Knowledge of how to deploy source code into running, scalable containers and virtual machines in automated fashion at enterprise scale
  • Practical experience with our offerings

Within 6 months, be ready to implement a routine container platform project by attaining the following:

  • Successful, collaborative delivery of customer requirements using Red Hat OpenShift
  • Knowledge of how a customer use case can be developed into a project plan and how those requirements align with Red Hat’s technologies
  • Understanding of how Red Hat’s technologies can transform IT practices at large organizations

Within 12 months, begin to demonstrate technical leadership in container platforms by accomplishing the following:

  • Successfully implementing complex, large-scale container platform solutions in challenging customer environments
  • Helping other consultants implement large-scale IT solution paired with container technologies
  • Contributing lessons learned, best practices, and how-tos to our internal and external communities of practice
  • Applying new technologies, frameworks, or methodologies to container platforms
The salary range for this position is $118,600.00 - $195,680.00. Actual offer will be based on your qualifications.

Pay Transparency

Red Hat determines compensation based on several factors including but not limited to job location, experience, applicable skills and training, external market value, and internal pay equity. Annual salary is one component of Red Hat’s compensation package. This position may also be eligible for bonus, commission, and/or equity. For positions with Remote-US locations, the actual salary range for the position may differ based on location but will be commensurate with job duties and relevant work experience.

About Red Hat

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterpriseopen source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

Benefits
● Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
● Flexible Spending Account - healthcare and dependent care
● Health Savings Account - high deductible medical plan
● Retirement 401(k) with employer match

● Paid time off and holidays

● Paid parental leave plans for all new parents
● Leave benefits including disability, paid family medical leave, and paid military leave
● Additional benefits including employee stock purchase plan, family planning reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, transportation expense account, employee assistance program, and more!

Note: These benefits are only applicable to full time, permanent associates at Red Hat located in the United States.

Inclusion at Red Hat
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.


Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.

Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email . General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

jobs.description:
Field Sales Representative

Location: Birmingham, covering Birmingham or surrounding areas such as Bromsgrove or Redditch (fully field-based)

£50,000–£90,000 OTE (£30,000–£54,000 base salary + uncapped commission, based on experience) + £800 monthly car allowance and a comprehensive benefits package

Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services have made life harder for them, with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe, bringing together payments, business accounts and other business tools with simple technology and real human support. From card payments and business accounts to financing solutions, we help our Members spend less time worrying about their finances and more time doing what they love.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you’re ambitious, enjoy meeting new people and want to make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Mission

We’re looking for ambitious, driven people to join our growing Field Sales team and help bring Teya to more local businesses across the UK.

As a Field Sales Representative, you’ll take ownership of your own territory, getting out into your local community, meeting business owners face-to-face and showing them how Teya can help their businesses thrive.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being out in the field, building relationships and winning new business. You’ll have the freedom to manage your territory, the support of a team that wants you to succeed, and the opportunity to build a rewarding career in sales.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own your territory: Proactively identify and engage local businesses through face-to-face prospecting, networking, referrals and other opportunities to generate new business.

  • Build meaningful relationships: Get to know business owners, understand their challenges and identify how Teya’s products and services can make their lives easier.

  • Win new Members: Use a consultative, value-led approach to demonstrate Teya’s solutions, build trust and turn conversations into long-term customer relationships.

  • Deliver results: Take ownership of your sales performance, maintain a healthy pipeline and consistently work towards your commercial targets.

  • See things through: Take responsibility for your Members’ experience from the first conversation through to onboarding, ensuring they’re set up successfully and ready to start using Teya.

  • Keep learning: Develop strong knowledge of our products, competitors and sales methodology through structured training, coaching and feedback.

  • Represent Teya: Be a trusted face of Teya in your local community, delivering the genuine care and hospitality that we want every Member to experience.

  • Help us improve: Share insights from the field to help us continuously improve our products, sales approach and Member experience.

Your Story

We believe great salespeople come from all kinds of backgrounds.

You might already be an experienced field sales professional with a strong track record of winning new business. Or you might be earlier in your career, with the ambition, drive and potential to become an exceptional salesperson.

What matters most to us is your mindset, your ability to connect with people and your willingness to learn and improve.

We’re looking for people who bring:

  • Ambition and drive: You’re motivated to succeed, enjoy working towards challenging goals and take pride in delivering great results.

  • A competitive mindset: You enjoy winning, hold yourself to high standards and are always looking for ways to improve.

  • Resilience and determination: You’re comfortable with rejection, stay positive when things get tough and don’t give up easily.

  • Strong people skills: You enjoy meeting new people, build rapport naturally and can have meaningful conversations with business owners from all walks of life.

  • Curiosity and commercial awareness: You ask good questions, listen carefully and want to understand what makes a business successful.

  • Coachability: You’re open to feedback, willing to challenge yourself and committed to developing your skills.

  • Ownership and self-discipline: You’re organised, proactive and comfortable managing your own time and priorities in a field-based role.

  • A genuine care for others: You understand that great sales isn’t just about closing a deal. It’s about doing what’s right for the customer and building trust that lasts.

Experience in field sales, business development, payments or financial services is an advantage, but not essential for every level. We care just as much about your potential as your experience.

You’ll also need:

  • Fluency in English.

  • A full UK driving licence and access to a car.

  • The right to work in the UK.

  • Willingness to work in a fully field-based role, travelling regularly throughout your territory.

The Perks

We believe great performance should be recognised and rewarded. Alongside the opportunity to build your career in a growing European fintech, you’ll receive:

  • £30,000–£54,000 base salary, depending on your experience and demonstrated capability.

  • Uncapped commission.

  • £800 per month car allowance (£9,600 annually), on top of your salary and commission.

  • 25 days of paid annual leave, plus UK bank holidays.

  • Bupa private healthcare and life insurance.

  • Employer pension contributions through our company pension scheme.

  • Free gym membership through Wellhub, alongside one-to-one therapy sessions, meditation and digital fitness and nutrition apps.

  • Structured onboarding, practical sales training, ongoing coaching and opportunities to grow your career at Teya.

What Happens Next?

Our recruitment process is designed to help us get to know you, understand your strengths and give you a genuine opportunity to show us what you can do.

Stage 1 - Introductory conversation (30 minutes)
A conversation with our Talent team to learn more about you, your motivation and what you’re looking for in your next role.

Stage 2 - Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)
An opportunity to explore your experience, how you approach challenges and what makes you successful.

Stage 3 - Final Assessment (60 minutes)
You’ll meet members of our Sales leadership team, present a short territory plan and take part in a practical sales role-play. We’ll share everything you need to prepare in advance.

We know interviews are a two-way process, and we’ll make sure you have plenty of opportunities to ask questions and get to know us along the way.

Teya is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including those without a traditional sales or commercial track record.

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Ireland. Day rate: EUR 450 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineering team can build. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the record-to-report processes with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design across close, reconciliation, journals and intercompany, written up as the solution design. Decisions on what standard Redwood capability covers and where an extension is justified. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems. Balance sheet auto-certification rules, controls, approvals and audit trail designed into the solution, so the automated close stands up to audit. Guidance to the engineers through build, and review of what they deliver against the design. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users. A roadmap for the next waves of automation once the first processes are live.

What you bring

Solution design ownership on at least one live Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance) implementation, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. 8 or more years in finance transformation, finance systems or record-to-report process design. A working understanding of SAP FI/CO, or the Oracle equivalent, and how close and reconciliation data flows between the ERP and the automation layer. Experience running workshops with finance users and turning what they say into a design that can be built and tested. The standing to work with senior finance stakeholders and hold a design position when it is challenged.

Useful but not essential:

Hands-on build experience on Redwood, so you know what your design asks of the engineers. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A finance qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar). Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

This is a talent pool for future US-based opportunities. We are not actively hiring for this position at this time.

About the Role

The Lead, Retention combines strategic account ownership, hands-on CRM expertise, and team leadership to help direct-to-consumer brands grow customer lifetime value. In this role, you would own retention strategy and client relationships across a portfolio of e-commerce accounts, translating business goals and customer insights into email, SMS, subscription, and loyalty programs that drive measurable revenue and repeat purchase.

Working with the Director of Retention and partnering closely with Performance Marketing, Creative, and Strategy teams, you would lead the roadmap from customer acquisition through first purchase, repeat purchase, subscription retention, and win-back.

This role is designed for an experienced strategist and operator who can lead senior client conversations, connect lifecycle performance to commercial outcomes, and guide specialists through complex execution without losing touch with the work.

What You’ll Do

  • Own retention strategy, client relationships, and performance roadmaps for a portfolio of DTC accounts, serving as a senior strategic partner rather than simply managing campaign delivery.

  • Translate client objectives into clear KPI frameworks, retention revenue forecasts, and prioritized plans. Explain performance, identify gaps, and recommend actions to improve results.

  • Build lifecycle strategies spanning lead capture, welcome and first-purchase journeys, post-purchase engagement, repeat purchase, subscription activation and retention, loyalty, and win-back.

  • Develop email and SMS campaign calendars, segmentation plans, automation roadmaps, and testing priorities grounded in customer behavior and business goals.

  • Lead client conversations, presenting results and recommendations clearly, managing expectations, and bringing a confident point of view to complex strategic decisions.

  • Coordinate specialists and designers across accounts, delegate effectively, and review briefs, creative, segmentation, and campaign builds to maintain a high standard of delivery.

  • Stay close to execution: build or troubleshoot automation logic, lead-capture forms, and app integrations when needed, and ensure campaigns and flows are thoroughly quality-assured before launch.

  • Turn cohort analysis, repeat purchase behavior, subscription performance, and lifetime value insights into practical opportunities for client growth.

  • Mentor team members on retention strategy, analysis, execution, and quality control, helping them develop stronger judgment and greater ownership.

  • Partner with Performance Marketing, Creative, and Strategy teams so acquisition investment, messaging, and lifecycle programming reinforce one another.

  • Identify opportunities to deepen client programs through personalization, loyalty, subscription journeys, and stronger cross-channel coordination.

You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You

  • You have a strong track record of developing and scaling retention programs for DTC or e-commerce brands, with meaningful ownership of client relationships and performance outcomes.

  • You combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You can build a compelling roadmap, guide a team through delivery, and get into the platform when a complex problem needs solving.

  • You have deep experience with Klaviyo or a comparable email service provider, including segmentation, event-triggered journeys, lifecycle automation, and personalization, alongside working knowledge of Shopify and its ecosystem.

  • You understand how to build effective SMS programs, including audience segmentation, cadence, and compliance considerations, using platforms such as Attentive, Postscript, or Klaviyo.

  • You have developed loyalty or rewards strategies that improve repeat purchase and lifetime value, and understand how email and SMS support subscription sign-ups, retention, cancellation prevention, and win-back.

  • You are fluent in retention measurement, including cohort analysis, repeat purchase rate, customer lifetime value, and LTV:CAC. You can connect channel results to revenue and explain what should happen next.

  • You are comfortable setting commercial targets and building the forecasts and reporting needed to track progress against them.

  • You have demonstrated leadership through direct management or strong cross-functional team leadership, with the ability to coach others, prioritize workloads, and raise the quality of delivery.

  • You can manage multiple accounts and workstreams in a fast-paced environment without losing sight of strategic priorities or execution details.

  • You communicate clearly with clients and colleagues at every level, translating complex data and technical concepts into focused recommendations.

  • You stay curious about emerging tools, customer behavior, and best practices in DTC and lifecycle marketing.

What It’s Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + US holidays: Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

  • Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.

  • Health & Wellness: Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage.

  • Finances, growth, and retirement: Darkroom offers a robust 401(k) program with company match and profit-sharing opportunities to help you save and grow as the company grows.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

About the Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

What You Will Need

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

jobs.excerpt: Job PurposeSenior Transformation Office Portfolio Leader is responsible for governing the technology projects portfolio of change across agreed Mashreq’s groups.
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

Senior Transformation Office Portfolio Leader is responsible for governing the technology projects portfolio of change across agreed Mashreq’s groups.

  • Own and govern the technology change portfolio for one or more assigned Mashreq Groups, acting as the senior Transformation Office partner to Group leadership across investment planning, delivery governance, portfolio performance, value realization and forward forecasting.
  • Provide an accurate, decision-oriented view of the portfolio from demand and budget formulation through initiation, execution, closure and benefits realization, maintaining a single source of truth and ensuring adherence to Mashreq project Methods.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to Group Heads and senior stakeholders, proactively identifying portfolio risks, dependencies, delivery constraints and value leakage; drive resolution and escalate material concerns through the appropriate governance forums.
  • Provide Project Quality Assurance across the assigned portfolio and strengthen project-management capability by assuring PM competence and Method compliance, coaching and training project managers, and directly leading selected critical projects where required.
  • Works with the respective Owners within Groups to ensure that all transformation initiatives are aligned with Mashreq's strategic goals and objectives, by providing active support and coordination during the budgeting, initiation and planning cycles,
  • Fosters close collaboration with senior leadership to ensure buy-in support, and effective decision-making throughout the transformation journeys.
  • Agrees, establishes and applies prioritization criteria to the transformation initiatives to support the execution of the overall bank strategy and growth aspirations, leveraging on synergies where possible, ensuring a balanced focus on achieving short-term improvements while building long-term value for sustainable growth,
  • Acts as Initiation Lead, either directly or by identifying resources to hold this role, and coordinate the activities related to initiation, planning, estimations, articulations of the benefits and business case to be included in the request for budgets in the form of the Executive Summary.
  • Review Executive Summaries, make best effort to check for completeness of the estimates and be one of the mandatory signatories,
  • Monitors and reports on the transformation initiatives roadmap at the Mashreq and Group levels, and escalates concerns as necessary,
  • Ensures transparency and access to accurate information by maintaining the single source of truth on the transformation initiatives,
  • Defines and implements a communication strategy to regularly disseminate and communicate progress updates and outcomes of transformation initiatives to the right stakeholders, ensuring transparency,
  • Works with key stakeholders to optimize allocation of resources, including talent, technology, and finances, for efficient utilization toward delivery excellence.
  • Leads projects managers in the management of projects within the Portfolio. Assures that the execution of projects is done in accordance with Mashreq’s Methods.
  • Provides training and knowledge transfer as required on TO approved ways of working.
  • Contributes to the development of Mashreq’s Delivery Methods.
  • Work towards continuously improving Mashreq’s delivery capabilities thus maximizing the opportunities for business value creation from transformation initiatives.

Key Result Areas: --

A. Portfolio Strategy, Demand & Investment Planning

  • Partner with assigned Groups to translate strategic priorities and change demand into an integrated technology portfolio and multi-year roadmap.
  • Lead/support annual and in-year budget formulation for CAPEX and OPEX projects, challenging scope, estimates, sequencing, dependencies, resource needs, benefits and delivery readiness.
  • Coordinate initiation, planning, estimations, benefits articulation and business-case / Executive Summary preparation; review submissions for completeness, quality and decision readiness and provide required Transformation Office sign-off.
  • Apply agreed prioritization criteria and advise Group leadership on investment trade-offs, capacity constraints, synergies and sequencing.

B. Portfolio Execution, Control & Reporting

  • Maintain an accurate portfolio inventory and single source of truth, clearly distinguishing projects not yet initiated, initiated/in planning, in execution, live/delivered, on hold and closed.
  • Track projects against approved scope, schedule, cost, milestones, resourcing, risks, dependencies and benefits baselines; identify variance and require credible recovery actions.
  • Produce concise, evidence-based Group portfolio reporting highlighting performance, exceptions, decisions required and forward outlook.
  • Provide timely and accurate inputs into bank-wide Technology Projects reporting, ensuring consistent definitions, data quality and traceability across Groups.

  • Forecast portfolio performance, delivery milestones, financial utilization, emerging risks and likely year-end outcomes; identify potential slippage, under-utilization or value leakage early.

    C. Delivery Assurance & Mashreq Methods

  • Act as Project Quality Assurance lead for assigned Groups, performing structured health checks against Mashreq project Methods, governance standards, mandatory artefacts and control gates.
  • Assess whether project plans and baselines are credible, governance is operating effectively, RAID items and dependencies are actively managed, and executive decisions are captured and actioned.
  • Escalate material non-compliance, delivery risk and control weakness, and track agreed remediation to closure.
  • Assure that onboarded Project Managers understand and apply Mashreq Methods; provide coaching, training and targeted knowledge transfer.
  • Where specifically required, act directly as Project Manager / recovery lead for selected critical or complex initiatives without diluting independent assurance across the wider portfolio.

  • Contribute lessons learned and practical enhancements to Mashreq delivery Methods and Transformation Office standards.

    D. Issue Resolution, Stakeholder Leadership & Advisory

  • Work with Group Heads, project sponsors, business/technology owners and Project Managers to remove delivery blockers and resolve cross-project or cross-functional issues.
  • Serve as trusted advisor on change demand, portfolio composition, prioritization, execution choices, dependencies, delivery risk and value creation.
  • Create fact-based escalation paths for issues requiring senior leadership intervention, with clear options, impact and recommended action.

  • Build effective working relationships across Technology, Business, Functions, Finance, Procurement, Technology GRC, ISG, ORM, Internal Audit, Compliance and other relevant functions.

    E. Benefits & Value Realization

  • Work with accountable business owners to define measurable financial and non-financial benefits, establish baselines, ownership and realization timelines.
  • Ensure approved benefits are recorded, tracked and periodically validated through the delivery lifecycle and after go-live where applicable.
  • Challenge gaps between investment cases, delivered capabilities, adoption and realized outcomes; escalate material benefit shortfalls and agree corrective actions.

F. Project Manager Leadership & Capability

  • Provide functional leadership to Project Managers supporting assigned portfolios, setting expectations for delivery discipline, transparency and escalation.
  • Assess PM onboarding/readiness, coach performance and reinforce consistent application of Mashreq Methods and reporting standards.
  • Support assignment of appropriately skilled Project Managers to initiatives based on complexity, risk and criticality, and identify capability or capacity gaps

Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • 15+ years of relevant professional experience, with substantial experience in banking / financial services technology transformation, portfolio, program and project delivery.
  • Demonstrated ownership/governance of large, complex portfolios comprising 100+ projects and aggregate investment of AED 100m+ (or equivalent).
  • Strong command of CAPEX/OPEX portfolio planning, budgeting, financial forecasting, investment prioritization and delivery-performance management.
  • Deep practical experience in portfolio/program/project governance, baseline management, RAID and dependency management, executive reporting, quality assurance and recovery of challenged initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of benefits management and value realization, including definition of measurable outcomes, ownership, baselining and tracking.
  • Proven ability to advise and influence Group Heads / C-level stakeholders, constructively challenge senior leaders and drive decisions across organizational boundaries.
  • Experience leading, coaching and assuring Project Managers and building consistent adherence to enterprise delivery methods.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to convert complex portfolio data into forward-looking executive insight and actionable recommendations.
  • Master’s degree preferred (Bachelor’s degree required) in technology, business, engineering, finance or a related discipline.
  • Recognized project/program/portfolio management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, MSP or equivalent) preferred; equivalent demonstrable experience may be considered.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.excerpt: About the companyTurning marketing into a market-domination weapon, we created a new category - the marketplace for future customers.
jobs.description:
About the company

Turning marketing into a market-domination weapon, we created a new category - the marketplace for future customers. Businesses shop for leads as they shop for products in e-commerce: you see everything about a lead before you buy - full transparency, control, and predictable outcomes. We're the #1 lead marketplace in the USA, and we're accelerating.

Role overview

We are looking for a Product Manager to ensure we always build the most valuable things for our marketplace — measured in money, not opinion. You will own the outward half of the product: users, market, and the "what and why." Working closely with a Product Owner who owns delivery ("how and when"), your job is to make sure not a single sprint is spent on something that does not move LTV, margin, or retention.

Requirements

3+ years in B2B SaaS or marketplaces, with clear examples of metrics you moved and can prove.

Strong understanding of unit economics, including LTV, CAC, payback, and contribution margin.

Hands-on user research experience with real synthesis work behind it.

Ability to tie product ideas to measurable upside before development starts.

Experience pulling and working with your own data using SQL, Amplitude, BigQuery, or similar tools.

English C1+; your users are American real estate investors, and communication needs to be sharp and clear.

AI-first by default — if you are not using AI to 3x your output already, you will be behind our engineers.

High ownership and strong decision-making in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

What You'll Be Doing

Talk to users constantly: buyers, power accounts, and churned users — and turn conversations into decisions, not decks.

Own platform improvement broadly across onboarding, buying experience, lead quality, retention, and monetization. Find the weakest link, fix it, then move to the next.

Own the unit economics of every bet by tying each brief to LTV, CAC payback, margin per lead, or revenue per active user. If you cannot put a number on the upside, it is not a brief yet.

Model value before anything is built, using rough sizing of expected impact so engineering time goes to things that move money, not things that only feel nice.

Write one-page briefs built around problem, evidence, and expected impact, then hand them off and trust the execution.

Ship experiments weekly, kill failures fast, and scale winners.

Pull your own data directly; there should be no analyst between you and the truth.

Track competitor changes closely and know what they shipped before users tell you.

This is not for you if

You measure success in features shipped.

You cannot tie a feature to a number.

You want to manage the sprint and own the delivery. That is a different role.

What we expect from you (first 3 months)

We do not do long onboarding. Access on day one, context in days, a real problem in week one. We hire people who create value with incomplete information, because that is the job every day after probation too.

End of month 1: you know the platform as a real user does because you have used it like one; you have mapped the weakest points in the funnel, ranked with evidence and value; and you have handed off your first accepted brief.

End of month 3 (the bar): multiple shipped changes with measurable results you can defend, with at least one of them moving a core metric such as activation, churn, LQS, or revenue per user. A live experiment pipeline exists so something is always being tested. Your validated brief backlog is deep enough that the team never waits on you for direction. We trust your "this is worth building" without re-checking it.

How We Work With You: We use honest checkpoints at 2 weeks, 1 month, and 2 months. We judge trajectory, not perfection. Wrong fast and corrected beats slow and safe. If the fit is wrong, both sides should know by month 2 and say it out loud.

Nice to Have

Experience in startup or fast-scaling tech environments.

Experience in marketplace, SaaS, real estate, lead generation, or other performance-driven digital businesses.

Familiarity with experimentation systems, product analytics, and growth-focused product work.

What We Offer

Impact: Work at the core of a product-led, AI-powered startup where your decisions directly affect business performance.

Autonomy: High ownership, low bureaucracy, and real authority over product direction.

Flexibility: Remote-first culture with flexible hours and async-friendly communication.

Compensation: Competitive salary above the market average.

Team: Join a smart, passionate team that moves fast, supports each other, and builds cool stuff.

Time Off: Three weeks paid vacation plus 5 paid sick days annually.

Growth: Unlimited learning policy — paid courses, books, and growth resources.

AI-Heavy Environment: AI is deeply embedded across prospecting, research, and workflows.

Ownership: Real decision-making power and direct ownership of your outcomes.

Field Sales Representative

Location: Stoke-on-Trent, covering Stoke-on-Trent or surrounding areas (fully field-based)

£50,000–£90,000 OTE (£30,000–£54,000 base salary + uncapped commission, based on experience) + £800 monthly car allowance and a comprehensive benefits package

Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services have made life harder for them, with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe, bringing together payments, business accounts and other business tools with simple technology and real human support. From card payments and business accounts to financing solutions, we help our Members spend less time worrying about their finances and more time doing what they love.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you’re ambitious, enjoy meeting new people and want to make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Mission

We’re looking for ambitious, driven people to join our growing Field Sales team and help bring Teya to more local businesses across the UK.

As a Field Sales Representative, you’ll take ownership of your own territory, getting out into your local community, meeting business owners face-to-face and showing them how Teya can help their businesses thrive.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being out in the field, building relationships and winning new business. You’ll have the freedom to manage your territory, the support of a team that wants you to succeed, and the opportunity to build a rewarding career in sales.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own your territory: Proactively identify and engage local businesses through face-to-face prospecting, networking, referrals and other opportunities to generate new business.

  • Build meaningful relationships: Get to know business owners, understand their challenges and identify how Teya’s products and services can make their lives easier.

  • Win new Members: Use a consultative, value-led approach to demonstrate Teya’s solutions, build trust and turn conversations into long-term customer relationships.

  • Deliver results: Take ownership of your sales performance, maintain a healthy pipeline and consistently work towards your commercial targets.

  • See things through: Take responsibility for your Members’ experience from the first conversation through to onboarding, ensuring they’re set up successfully and ready to start using Teya.

  • Keep learning: Develop strong knowledge of our products, competitors and sales methodology through structured training, coaching and feedback.

  • Represent Teya: Be a trusted face of Teya in your local community, delivering the genuine care and hospitality that we want every Member to experience.

  • Help us improve: Share insights from the field to help us continuously improve our products, sales approach and Member experience.

Your Story

We believe great salespeople come from all kinds of backgrounds.

You might already be an experienced field sales professional with a strong track record of winning new business. Or you might be earlier in your career, with the ambition, drive and potential to become an exceptional salesperson.

What matters most to us is your mindset, your ability to connect with people and your willingness to learn and improve.

We’re looking for people who bring:

  • Ambition and drive: You’re motivated to succeed, enjoy working towards challenging goals and take pride in delivering great results.

  • A competitive mindset: You enjoy winning, hold yourself to high standards and are always looking for ways to improve.

  • Resilience and determination: You’re comfortable with rejection, stay positive when things get tough and don’t give up easily.

  • Strong people skills: You enjoy meeting new people, build rapport naturally and can have meaningful conversations with business owners from all walks of life.

  • Curiosity and commercial awareness: You ask good questions, listen carefully and want to understand what makes a business successful.

  • Coachability: You’re open to feedback, willing to challenge yourself and committed to developing your skills.

  • Ownership and self-discipline: You’re organised, proactive and comfortable managing your own time and priorities in a field-based role.

  • A genuine care for others: You understand that great sales isn’t just about closing a deal. It’s about doing what’s right for the customer and building trust that lasts.

Experience in field sales, business development, payments or financial services is an advantage, but not essential for every level. We care just as much about your potential as your experience.

You’ll also need:

  • Fluency in English.

  • A full UK driving licence and access to a car.

  • The right to work in the UK.

  • Willingness to work in a fully field-based role, travelling regularly throughout your territory.

The Perks

We believe great performance should be recognised and rewarded. Alongside the opportunity to build your career in a growing European fintech, you’ll receive:

  • £30,000–£54,000 base salary, depending on your experience and demonstrated capability.

  • Uncapped commission.

  • £800 per month car allowance (£9,600 annually), on top of your salary and commission.

  • 25 days of paid annual leave, plus UK bank holidays.

  • Bupa private healthcare and life insurance.

  • Employer pension contributions through our company pension scheme.

  • Free gym membership through Wellhub, alongside one-to-one therapy sessions, meditation and digital fitness and nutrition apps.

  • Structured onboarding, practical sales training, ongoing coaching and opportunities to grow your career at Teya.

What Happens Next?

Our recruitment process is designed to help us get to know you, understand your strengths and give you a genuine opportunity to show us what you can do.

Stage 1 - Introductory conversation (30 minutes)
A conversation with our Talent team to learn more about you, your motivation and what you’re looking for in your next role.

Stage 2 - Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)
An opportunity to explore your experience, how you approach challenges and what makes you successful.

Stage 3 - Final Assessment (60 minutes)
You’ll meet members of our Sales leadership team, present a short territory plan and take part in a practical sales role-play. We’ll share everything you need to prepare in advance.

We know interviews are a two-way process, and we’ll make sure you have plenty of opportunities to ask questions and get to know us along the way.

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with managerial scope, focused on building automation, tooling, and reporting infrastructure that reduces manual work and drives faster, smarter decisions across the team.

You will act as the primary analytics owner for a set of problems that sit across fraud, credit, and risk: consolidating fragmented reporting, building shared backtesting frameworks, and deploying AI-assisted tooling to free up the team's time for higher-leverage work.

  • Own end-to-end automation and tooling for manual and redundant analytics tasks across fraud and risk

Qualifications

Required

  • Demonstrated analytical ability and comfort diving into messy, complex data

  • Experience with BI tooling (Sigma preferred; Tableau or similar accepted)

  • Experience with Git

  • Clear, effective communicator who can translate analytical findings into decisions

  • Bias toward action — takes initiative, ships solutions, and doesn't wait for perfect conditions

  • Roughly 3–6 years of relevant analytics experience, though skill set matters more than tenure

Nice to Have

  • Experience with LLMs and prompt engineering

  • Background in fintech or a high-growth tech startup

  • Exposure to fraud, credit risk, or financial domain analytics

  • Experience building or scaling analytics functions from scratch

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Leading configured work computers of your choice

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

  • Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA

  • 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

Job Description:

Technical Director, Aviation Sector | Parsons Corporation

Shape the Future of Global Aviation Modernization

Parsons is seeking an exceptional Technical Director, Aviation Sector to serve as the senior technical authority for one of the most consequential missions in critical infrastructure: the modernization of air traffic management, aviation weather, and national airspace systems worldwide.

This is a highly visible, externally facing technical leadership position at the center of how Parsons partners with the FAA, international air navigation service providers (ANSPs), airports, the Department of Defense, and leading aviation technology OEMs to modernize the systems that keep the skies safe.

If you are a recognized technical leader in CNS/ATM, aviation weather, air traffic management, or safety-critical systems integration — someone who has earned credibility with government and industry customers through demonstrated delivery, not just theory — this role offers the scope, autonomy, and mission impact to make your mark on the next generation of aviation infrastructure.

Why This Role Matters

Aviation modernization is entering a pivotal decade. Aging infrastructure, growing airspace complexity, emerging technologies like AI and digital engineering, and the integration of new entrants such as UAS and UAM are converging to reshape how air traffic is managed and how aviation weather is sensed, processed, and delivered to operational decision-makers.

As Technical Director, you will be the person customers, executives, and engineering teams turn to when the technical stakes are highest: when a modernization program needs a credible architecture, when a proposal needs technical teeth, when an integration risk needs to be surfaced early, or when a customer needs to trust that Parsons understands their mission as well as they do.

What You'll Be Doing

Setting Technical Direction

  • Define and evolve the Aviation Sector's technical strategy, translating business and customer mission needs into executable plans.
  • Assess which emerging technologies (AI, digital engineering, cloud, advanced data platforms) are genuinely ready for safety-critical aviation use — and which are not.
  • Establish Parsons as the technically credible, vendor-neutral partner for complex aviation integration challenges.

Serving as Technical Authority for CNS/ATM and Aviation Weather

  • Provide senior technical leadership across communications, navigation, surveillance, air traffic management, ATC automation, and airspace operations.
  • Guide the technical approach to aviation weather sensing, forecasting, and dissemination, and its integration into ATM and airport decision-support systems.
  • Evaluate competing architectures, technologies, and vendor claims with operational rigor.

Leading Complex Systems Integration

  • Provide technical oversight for multi-system, multi-site, multi-vendor programs — from architecture through deployment and cutover.
  • Instill engineering discipline across requirements, configuration management, interface control, and verification/validation.
  • Surface integration risks early, before they become cost, schedule, or safety problems.

Driving Program and Pursuit Success

  • Provide technical leadership to major programs, captures, and proposals across FAA, international ANSP, airport, DoD, and OEM opportunities.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for difficult architecture, integration, or delivery challenges.
  • Ensure what gets proposed is what can actually be delivered.

Engaging Customers and Industry

  • Build trusted relationships with FAA, international civil aviation authorities, ANSPs, airports, DoD organizations, and OEM partners.
  • Represent Parsons at industry forums and executive briefings as a senior technical voice.
  • Translate customer and market insight into recommendations for talent, partnerships, and investment.

Establishing Technical Governance

  • Lead independent technical reviews, architecture reviews, and readiness assessments.
  • Promote disciplined, phased delivery with clear readiness gates for safe, predictable modernization in live operational environments.
  • Ensure schedule or commercial pressure never compromises safety, security, or quality.

Building Technical Talent and Capability

  • Define the sector's technical capability model and close critical skill and succession gaps.
  • Recruit, mentor, and retain senior technical professionals; build career paths for chief engineers and architects.

Driving Innovation Responsibly

  • Lead practical application of digital engineering, AI, and enterprise data integration in regulated, safety-critical environments.
  • Clearly distinguish what's ready for operational deployment from what's still experimental.

What Success Looks Like

  • Established a clear, actionable technical strategy for the Aviation Sector.
  • Strengthened Parsons' technical credibility with the FAA, ANSPs, airports, DoD, and international customers.
  • Improved the technical realism and competitiveness of major proposals.
  • Built repeatable playbooks for systems integration, testing, and operational transition.
  • Grown a deeper bench of CNS/ATM and aviation weather technical leadership.
  • Contributed directly to new contract awards and strategic growth.

What Required Skills You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, aviation, meteorology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • 25+ years of progressive experience in aviation systems, aerospace, CNS/ATM, aviation weather, air traffic management, systems engineering, defense aviation, or a closely related field.
  • Local to DC Preferred, but can work anywhere.
  • 10+ years of senior technical or engineering leadership experience.
  • Deep, demonstrated technical experience in CNS/ATM, air traffic management, aviation weather, or closely related safety-critical aviation systems.
  • Experience leading complex systems integration, enterprise architecture, modernization, deployment, or sustainment efforts.
  • Direct experience working with FAA, ANSP, civil aviation authority, airport, DoD, OEM, or major systems-integrator customers.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary technical teams and influence across organizational and customer boundaries.
  • Experience supporting major captures, proposals, or strategic customer engagements.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, briefing, and executive communication skills.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain required government or customer clearances, where applicable.

What Desired Skills You'll Bring

  • Master's degree in systems engineering, aerospace/electrical/computer engineering, computer science, aviation, meteorology, or business.
  • Direct experience with FAA/NAS modernization or comparable international ATM modernization programs.
  • Experience integrating aviation weather capabilities into ATM, airport, or airspace decision-support systems.
  • Experience with large-scale, multi-site, multi-vendor aviation deployments.
  • Experience with digital engineering, model-based systems engineering, AI/ML, cloud computing, or enterprise data integration.
  • Experience leading distributed, matrixed, or multi-partner technical organizations.
  • Experience with strategic partnerships, technology licensing, or capability acquisitions.
  • Professional Engineer, INCOSE, PMP, Agile, cloud, or cybersecurity certifications.
  • Established professional reputation and network within CNS/ATM, aviation weather, or global ATM modernization communities.

The Keet engine team works on the core that makes Keet tick: connecting peers, replicating data, syncing rooms, and keeping calls and file transfers fast and reliable across every kind of network. We're looking for an organized, curious Junior Project Manager to help keep that work moving.

You'll work closely with a globally distributed team of senior engineers, help turn priorities into clear plans, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks between releases.   • Track engine work across sprints and releases, keeping issues, milestones, and roadmaps current

  • Familiarity with software development lifecycles, Git, and release processes

  • Some exposure to JavaScript/ or experience working alongside a dev team

  • Interest in privacy, decentralization, or open-source software

  • Agile/Scrum knowledge or a certification (PSM, CAPM, etc.)

  • Experience working across many time zones

jobs.description:
Field Sales Representative

Location: Sevenoaks, covering Sevenoaks or surrounding areas such as Tunbridge Wells (fully field-based)

£50,000–£90,000 OTE (£30,000–£54,000 base salary + uncapped commission, based on experience) + £800 monthly car allowance and a comprehensive benefits package

Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services have made life harder for them, with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe, bringing together payments, business accounts and other business tools with simple technology and real human support. From card payments and business accounts to financing solutions, we help our Members spend less time worrying about their finances and more time doing what they love.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you’re ambitious, enjoy meeting new people and want to make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Mission

We’re looking for ambitious, driven people to join our growing Field Sales team and help bring Teya to more local businesses across the UK.

As a Field Sales Representative, you’ll take ownership of your own territory, getting out into your local community, meeting business owners face-to-face and showing them how Teya can help their businesses thrive.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being out in the field, building relationships and winning new business. You’ll have the freedom to manage your territory, the support of a team that wants you to succeed, and the opportunity to build a rewarding career in sales.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own your territory: Proactively identify and engage local businesses through face-to-face prospecting, networking, referrals and other opportunities to generate new business.

  • Build meaningful relationships: Get to know business owners, understand their challenges and identify how Teya’s products and services can make their lives easier.

  • Win new Members: Use a consultative, value-led approach to demonstrate Teya’s solutions, build trust and turn conversations into long-term customer relationships.

  • Deliver results: Take ownership of your sales performance, maintain a healthy pipeline and consistently work towards your commercial targets.

  • See things through: Take responsibility for your Members’ experience from the first conversation through to onboarding, ensuring they’re set up successfully and ready to start using Teya.

  • Keep learning: Develop strong knowledge of our products, competitors and sales methodology through structured training, coaching and feedback.

  • Represent Teya: Be a trusted face of Teya in your local community, delivering the genuine care and hospitality that we want every Member to experience.

  • Help us improve: Share insights from the field to help us continuously improve our products, sales approach and Member experience.

Your Story

We believe great salespeople come from all kinds of backgrounds.

You might already be an experienced field sales professional with a strong track record of winning new business. Or you might be earlier in your career, with the ambition, drive and potential to become an exceptional salesperson.

What matters most to us is your mindset, your ability to connect with people and your willingness to learn and improve.

We’re looking for people who bring:

  • Ambition and drive: You’re motivated to succeed, enjoy working towards challenging goals and take pride in delivering great results.

  • A competitive mindset: You enjoy winning, hold yourself to high standards and are always looking for ways to improve.

  • Resilience and determination: You’re comfortable with rejection, stay positive when things get tough and don’t give up easily.

  • Strong people skills: You enjoy meeting new people, build rapport naturally and can have meaningful conversations with business owners from all walks of life.

  • Curiosity and commercial awareness: You ask good questions, listen carefully and want to understand what makes a business successful.

  • Coachability: You’re open to feedback, willing to challenge yourself and committed to developing your skills.

  • Ownership and self-discipline: You’re organised, proactive and comfortable managing your own time and priorities in a field-based role.

  • A genuine care for others: You understand that great sales isn’t just about closing a deal. It’s about doing what’s right for the customer and building trust that lasts.

Experience in field sales, business development, payments or financial services is an advantage, but not essential for every level. We care just as much about your potential as your experience.

You’ll also need:

  • Fluency in English.

  • A full UK driving licence and access to a car.

  • The right to work in the UK.

  • Willingness to work in a fully field-based role, travelling regularly throughout your territory.

The Perks

We believe great performance should be recognised and rewarded. Alongside the opportunity to build your career in a growing European fintech, you’ll receive:

  • £30,000–£54,000 base salary, depending on your experience and demonstrated capability.

  • Uncapped commission.

  • £800 per month car allowance (£9,600 annually), on top of your salary and commission.

  • 25 days of paid annual leave, plus UK bank holidays.

  • Bupa private healthcare and life insurance.

  • Employer pension contributions through our company pension scheme.

  • Free gym membership through Wellhub, alongside one-to-one therapy sessions, meditation and digital fitness and nutrition apps.

  • Structured onboarding, practical sales training, ongoing coaching and opportunities to grow your career at Teya.

What Happens Next?

Our recruitment process is designed to help us get to know you, understand your strengths and give you a genuine opportunity to show us what you can do.

Stage 1 - Introductory conversation (30 minutes)
A conversation with our Talent team to learn more about you, your motivation and what you’re looking for in your next role.

Stage 2 - Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)
An opportunity to explore your experience, how you approach challenges and what makes you successful.

Stage 3 - Final Assessment (60 minutes)
You’ll meet members of our Sales leadership team, present a short territory plan and take part in a practical sales role-play. We’ll share everything you need to prepare in advance.

We know interviews are a two-way process, and we’ll make sure you have plenty of opportunities to ask questions and get to know us along the way.

Teya is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including those without a traditional sales or commercial track record.

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

  3. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  4. Strong attention to detail when reviewing operational data and documentation.
  5. Proficiency in logistics software, management systems, and tracking tools.
  6. Experience handling diverse cargo, distribution models, or multimodal transportation networks.
  7. Ability to collaborate effectively in remote project environments.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate has extensive practical experience in logistics and supply chain operations, strong analytical skills, and the ability to explain complex processes clearly. They can evaluate operational scenarios, identify errors, and provide actionable feedback to improve AI performance.
