jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityCompliance at SEC- and FINRA-regulated firms still runs on manual review and noisy keyword tools, and the costs are rising.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Compliance at SEC- and FINRA-regulated firms still runs on manual review and noisy keyword tools, and the costs are rising.

  • Legacy surveillance tools generate hundreds of false positives every week.

  • A typical 5-person team loses ~3,000 hours a year to triage and status chasing, about $250K in leakage per mid-market firm.

  • Recent SEC penalties for off-channel communication and recordkeeping failures topped $536M.

  • Market: 19,000 US RIAs and broker-dealers, 7,800 mid-market targets, ~$500M SAM at a $40K ACV.

The Venture

Backed by AI venture builder FutureSight, FinLext is building a compliance operations platform for broker-dealers, registered investment advisers, and wealth managers. We help compliance teams handle more review work, resolve issues faster, and retain the evidence behind their decisions. Compliance professionals keep final approval authority.

Our initial focus is marketing review: helping firms review marketing materials and client communications before publication. The product brings together submitted content, applicable rules, firm policies, proposed corrections, and reviewer decisions in one workflow. Managed and controlled AI and LLMs deliver consistent and differentiating analysis in moments, not hours or days.

The value to customers is concrete:

  • Fewer rounds of revision before approval. Reviewers receive findings tied to specific passages, supporting sources, and proposed corrections. Marketing teams and advisors get actionable feedback that helps them move submissions toward approval.

  • More capacity for compliance teams. AI handles repeatable first-pass analysis and prepares findings for review. Compliance professionals can spend more time assessing substantive concerns and exercising judgment–helping grow their firms rather than performing mundane reviews.

  • Recommendations reviewers can inspect. Each finding connects the content under review to the relevant rule or firm policy. Reviewers can assess the reasoning, challenge the recommendation, and make an informed decision.

  • More Reliable and Consistent Decisions. Better, faster decisions mean fewer fines, better audit outcomes, and much higher user satisfaction.

Marketing review gives us a focused starting point for demonstrating customer value. The broader opportunity is to connect related compliance work, including electronic communications and trading oversight. Underlying these process transformations is regulatory intelligence incorporating law, regulations, interpretations and firm policy.

Backed by AI venture builder FutureSight, FinLext is the compliance operations platform for broker-dealers, RIAs and wealth managers: one auditable system for regulatory intelligence, supervisory review, remediation, human approval and retained records. AI creates capacity and consistency; compliance professionals keep authority. Our moat is a high-trust architecture and superior outcomes, not generic AI.

The Partnership

FinLext was founded by Richard Hulit (ex-Boomi, Appian, FIS, Nasdaq OMX), supported by an advisory board of ex-regulators, CCOs and legal counsel. The market work is done; now we need a technical and product co-founder to lead the build.

This is a Technical and Product co-founder role. You receive founder-level equity, co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising and strategy, a board or observer seat as the stage allows, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.

Role & Responsibilities

You will define how AI, software, and professional judgment work together in a regulated environment. That includes the underlying platform and the interfaces compliance teams use to delegate work, inspect findings, request revisions, and make decisions.

For a technical co-founder, this means owning the product and architecture from the outset. You will turn customer discovery into production software and solve practical problems in AI reliability, source grounding, and secure enterprise workflows. Working alongside an experienced financial technology founder and compliance advisors, you will shape both the first product and the business it becomes.

The build spans three connected areas:

  • Agentic product experiences. Design interfaces where users can assign review work, follow its progress, inspect supporting evidence, and act on proposed corrections. Determine where agents can analyze, research, or route work independently, and where they need clarification or human intervention. Make uncertainty and decision ownership visible, with compliance professionals retaining final approval.

  • Applied AI and orchestration. Build systems that interpret submitted content against relevant regulations and firm policies, retrieve supporting sources, and produce useful findings and proposed revisions. Own model selection, retrieval, tool use, and cross-task coordination. Establish evaluations for missed issues, unsupported findings, citation accuracy, and reviewer acceptance, alongside latency and cost.

  • The platform behind the workflow. Architect the services for document ingestion, versioning, workflow state, permissions, and retained decision history. Build secure customer boundaries and integrations with firms’ existing systems. Develop the observability and recovery mechanisms needed to understand failures, reproduce results, and operate reliably as usage grows.

Marketing review provides a focused first application. The broader engineering opportunity is to build reusable capabilities for evidence, policy interpretation, agent execution, and human review that can support additional compliance workflows. Initial work is underway; you will own final design and platform delivery.

You will own these product and architecture decisions, working directly with customers and domain experts to establish what earns trust and delivers measurable value.

As Technical and Product Co-founder, you will own both how we build and what we build.

  • Architecture: write the first production code and design the bounded agent system and its orchestration.

  • AI/LLM: own model strategy, RAG over SEC/FINRA rules and firm policy, private deployment where needed, and continuous evaluation.

  • Explainability and reliability: every verdict cites its rule; build the evidence ledger, observability and regression testing so results hold up in the field.

  • Security: SOC 2 readiness, tenant isolation, encryption and audit logging from day one.

  • Product Sense: turn discovery and pilot feedback into a sharp vision and wedge; design human-in-the-loop workflows CCOs trust; decide where AI acts, suggests or only observes.

  • Execution: own the roadmap and prioritization from MVP to GA; scope ruthlessly, ship weekly with design partners and convert pilots into paying customers.

  • Analytical: define and instrument success metrics (review time saved, false-positive reduction, accuracy, override rate); quantify customer ROI to support pricing, sales and fundraising.

  • Team: hire and lead the founding engineering and applied-AI team and set its culture.

Your first 18 months

  1. Months 1–3: ship the Marketing Review + Evidence Ledger MVP with 2–3 signed pilots.

  2. Months 4–6: convert 1–2 pilots to paying customers with proven ROI and auditability.

  3. Months 7–9: release GA v1, adding communications and trade surveillance and audit reporting.

  4. Months 10–18: expand into regulatory filings and enterprise integrations; reach 10+ paying customers and $1M ARR.

Co-Founder Profile

You are a builder who has shipped AI into production where wrong answers had real consequences, and who thinks as hard about the product as about the code.

  • Shipped LLM-powered systems into production where incorrect outputs carried real consequences, not prototypes or demos.

  • Full-stack depth across applied LLMs, RAG and retrieval, agent orchestration, deterministic rules engines, human-in-the-loop workflows and observability.

  • Experience building secure multi-tenant SaaS: SOC 2, tenant isolation, encryption, audit logging.

  • Strong product sense: you have defined what to build from customer discovery and owned a roadmap, not just executed one.

  • Bias towards action: you ship fast, cut scope ruthlessly and make decisive calls with imperfect information.

  • Analytical rigour: you define metrics, build evaluations and let data settle debates.

  • Well-formed convictions about explainability and reliability, developed in production.

  • Ready to operate as a principal: setting the agenda, owning outcomes, and representing FinLext to customers, partners and investors as its technical and product voice.

Strongly Preferred

  • Prior early-stage Technology and Product co-founder experience.

  • Background in RegTech, legal tech, fintech compliance, healthcare or another high-trust regulated vertical.

  • Familiarity with US wealth management and SEC/FINRA workflows: marketing review, communications surveillance, trade monitoring, books-and-records.

  • Hands-on experience self-hosting or privately deploying foundation models.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

You will join the team behind a leading network source-of-truth (NSoT) platform, used by thousands of organizations - from fast-growing tech companies to Fortune 500 enterprises - to model, document, and automate their network infrastructure.

CodiLime engineers work within the platform's Observability team, which builds the software responsible for network discovery and reconciliation (keeping the platform's documented network state in sync with what is actually discovered on the network), network observability and monitoring, as well as the agents and fleet management that collect data from customer networks. The team develops both closed-source and open-source components, used by the product's large community. Observability is a key part of network automation: it keeps the platform's view of the network accurate and up to date.

The platform is built AI-first, with its own Claude Code agent skills and MCP server, and that mindset carries over to how the team works: AI-assisted development is actively cultivated day to day to help the team move fast and consistently land high-quality results.

The scale is significant - some of the platform's largest customers manage hundreds of thousands of devices, each with multiple interfaces, across globally distributed environments.

As the observability offering keeps growing, the team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can strengthen coverage in US time zones.

Technology stack:

  • Programming languages: Go (primary language), Python (tests and tooling)

  • APIs: gRPC, Connect RPC, with Protobuf

  • Data & messaging: PostgreSQL (including migrations), Redis, RabbitMQ

  • Architecture: multi-tenant services, event-driven systems

  • Security: OAuth2 / OIDC

  • Observability: OpenTelemetry, metrics and instrumentation, Grafana, Prometheus

  • Network & device protocols: SNMP, gNMI, CLI-based collection, MQTT

  • Containerization & Orchestration: Docker (Docker Compose for local/test environments), Kubernetes

  • Cloud: AWS

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Ansible

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, MCP servers, Anthropic tooling

What else you should know:

  • Small, cross-functional team with strong ownership of code quality, security and tests

  • The team is distributed across Europe and the US, and we are looking for someone to strengthen coverage in US time zones (ideally Eastern Time), including customer support, production issues and on-call

  • AI tools are part of the daily workflow, including AI-assisted test writing and internal data/feed management tooling

  • This is a backend-focused role

  • Startup-like vibe: proactive, ownership-driven, fast-paced

We work on multiple interesting projects at a time, so it may happen that we’ll invite you to an interview for another project if we see that your competencies and profile are well suited for it.

Your role

As a part of the project team, you will be responsible for:

  • Designing and building Go services for network discovery and reconciliation, network observability and monitoring, and agents and fleet management

  • Designing multi-tenant ingestion pipelines for network device data, with clear delivery guarantees, idempotency and predictable behavior under load

  • Collecting device identity and state from network devices using protocols such as SNMP, gNMI and CLI

  • Building and evolving gRPC and Connect RPC APIs defined in Protobuf, and working with PostgreSQL, Redis and RabbitMQ

  • Instrumenting services with OpenTelemetry and keeping metrics clean and meaningful

  • Exploring and applying AI-assisted engineering practices - such as interactive, Claude Code-driven testing flows - to make development and testing faster and more reliable

  • Writing technical specifications with diagrams and contributing to architecture and design decisions

  • Supporting customers, production issues and on-call in US time zones

  • Writing clean, maintainable, well-tested code and participating in code reviews

Do we have a match?

As a Senior Software Engineer, you must meet the following criteria:

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience

  • Strong professional experience with Go

  • Experience with gRPC and/or Connect RPC APIs defined in Protobuf

  • Experience with PostgreSQL (including migrations), Redis and RabbitMQ

  • Experience with multi-tenant services and OAuth2 / OIDC

  • Deep knowledge of observability and instrumentation, including OpenTelemetry

  • Fluency and experience with Docker, Docker Compose

  • Experience with Kubernetes

  • Experience with event-driven systems, including at-least-once delivery and idempotent consumers

  • Solid understanding of networking: devices, configuration, protocols and layers

  • CI/CD experience (ideally GitHub Actions)

  • Hands-on, everyday use of AI coding tools (ideally Claude Code)

  • Availability to work in US time zones (ideally Eastern Time)

  • Good knowledge of English (minimum C1 level)

Beyond the criteria above, we would appreciate the following nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with MQTT or other device/IoT protocols, or gNMI

  • Experience with Python, pytest, Django, FastAPI, REST

  • Experience with Swagger and/or Postman

  • Experience with Playwright or other E2E testing frameworks

  • Experience with Cloud computing (Ideally AWS, e.g. EC2, S3, EKS)

More reasons to join us

  • Flexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office or hybrid

  • Professional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budget

  • Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start

  • A great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their work

jobs.description:
Our mission at Synera is to redefine how engineers work - making automation and AI co-workers a natural part of product development. As a Product Manager, you’ll shape how next-generation engineering teams design, automate, and collaborate. You won’t just build software, you’ll help build the future of how software builds hardware.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

At Synera, we build empowered product teams: cross-functional groups of Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, and AI Experts who own outcomes, not outputs. We don’t run a feature factory. We trust our teams to discover the most impactful problems and deliver solutions that customers love and the business values.

As a discovery-led Product Manager, you’ll collaborate closely with UX, Engineering, and AI to shape customer outcomes - not just ship features. You’ll regularly engage with leading customers such as BMW, NASA, and Miele to uncover their needs and pain points, guiding our R&D efforts to create products that truly make a difference.

You’ll join Bohdan, Dima, Fabian, Rieke, Salar, Sven and Thorsten - together known as the Chaotic Chimeras - a cross-functional product team pioneering how engineers build products for the future. They are the minds behind Synera Run, our web-based execution platform, that is unified with our low-code desktop editor and customer portal to craft one seamless, powerful experience.

By joining us, you’ll help turn our bold product vision into repeatable customer value, shaping the future of engineering with Synera.

👉 Your main focus areas:

  • You lead discovery and validation by engaging with internal stakeholders (e.g. Customer Success, Sales) and directly with customers to uncover user needs and pain points.

  • You collaborate with the Chimeras - our development team of product, design, and engineering experts - to translate insights into impactful product decisions.

  • You join the usual rituals such as daily standups, review meetings and retros. You clarify scope and customer value during the implementation.

  • You frame hypotheses and define measurable product outcomes, such as streamlining customer onboarding or increasing node adoption.

  • You own a problem space, not a backlog: you deeply understand users, map opportunities, and co-create strategy with design and engineering.

  • You continuously prioritize and refine opportunities with your team, balancing customer value, technical feasibility, and business impact.

  • You align with leadership on product goals and success metrics (e.g. adoption, retention, conversion) to ensure meaningful, outcome-driven progress.

⚡In 6 months:

  • You have a clear understanding of our platform, customers, and workflows.

  • You independently run at least one end-to-end discovery cycle: identifying user pain points, validating hypotheses, and sharing insights that shape roadmap priorities.

  • You ship one initiative that measurably improves customer experience or activation (e.g. increases activation rate, reduces onboarding time).

⚡ In 12 months:

  • You own a core product area and deliver measurable business or user impact (e.g. retention).

  • You establish a healthy, predictable discovery–delivery rhythm with your team: balancing learning, experimentation, and shipping.

  • You are recognized internally as a key voice in product strategy and prioritization, actively shaping discussions on where to invest for customer and business impact.

Here is our team at last year’s summer event - join us at the next one! 👋

🌱 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

We believe in transparent conversations about compensation from the start. For this role, our planned salary ranges are:

  • Experienced Level: 68.900 - 89.500 EUR annually

  • Advanced Level: 85.100 - 112.900 EUR annually

We determine the level we hire you for based on your experience, the scope of responsibilities you'll take on, and the impact you can drive. While we typically hire within these bands, we're open to some flexibility for candidates who bring exceptional value to the role.

Check out this page to learn how we approach salary, career growth, and creating an environment where everyone can shine.

What we offer beyond salary:

  • You’ll have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and help strengthen Synera as a leader in agent-driven engineering.

  • You’ll take ownership from day one, driving meaningful outcomes with real impact.

  • Work with exceptional engineers and designers united by a passion for solving real-world problems.

  • Home office setup support + access to our office in Bremen.

  • Personal development budget of €2,000 to attend conferences and trainings or buy interesting books to improve in an area of your choice.

  • Prefer two wheels over four? 🚲 We’ve got you covered with JobRad.

  • Regular team events, virtual coffee breaks, and spontaneous afterworks. We also get together as a whole company for 2-3 day off-sites twice a year! 🌈

Requirements

🚀 WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

  • You resonate with Synera's Core Values - they're central to how we work, and we'll explore them together in your first interview.

  • You understand and apply modern techniques of product discovery and delivery, focusing on outcomes, not output.

  • You bring at least 5-8 years’ experience working on technology-powered products as a Product Manager or Product Designer, ideally in a start-up or scale-up B2B SaaS environment.

  • You solve complex problems with sound judgment, balancing constraints and communicating your reasoning clearly through data-informed narratives.

P.S. Synera is a place where everyone can grow. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come to work every day, and be prepared to share with us how your perspective will bring something unique and valuable to our Chimeras team.

AllVoices is an AI-native employee relations platform that helps employees raise issues at work and helps company leaders resolve them. We give HR and ER teams one unified system for reporting, case management, and investigations, that is trusted by companies like Sweetgreen, Zoom, Panera Bread and Warby Parker. Employee relations has historically run on spreadsheets, inboxes and folders. We are replacing that with an AI-powered, secure platform that makes this important work more efficient, fairer, and creates a better workplace for all employees.

VP of Marketing: Job Description

Location: Remote (US) | Department: Marketing | Reports to: CEO

The Role

We are hiring a VP of Marketing to lead our marketing function and the team behind it. You will report to the CEO, sit on the senior leadership team, and own brand strategy, positioning, pipeline, website and product marketing.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the direction, develop your team and partners, and roll up your sleeves when the work calls for it. We are looking for a leader who brings a clear point of view, grounds decisions in data, and brings Sales, Product and Customer Success along on one shared story.

What You'll Do

Set the Strategy and Own Pipeline

  • Build and run the 2027 marketing plan and budget, tied to the company's revenue goal.
  • Own marketing-sourced pipeline targets with Sales and Rev Ops, and report on them weekly.
  • Set the channel mix across paid, content, events, community, partnerships and outbound support. Measure it and shift spend to what works.
  • Use AI tools to help the team produce more, faster, without lowering the bar on quality.

Lead the Team and Unify the Message

You will lead a cross-functional group of people and partners:

  • Head of Content, Community & Events: Lead and support them as they grow the podcast, webinar and events program. Help plan and execute a unified program so our content, the events we attend and our community efforts reinforce the same priorities.
  • Product Marketing Manager (open headcount): Hire and develop a Product Marketing Manager to drive product marketing with you.
  • Rev Ops and Marketing Ops: Set their priorities and lead them in building automated campaigns and tracking pipeline performance.
  • Agencies and contractors: Direct our web design agency, web developer, paid media agencies and freelancers, and hold their work to one messaging standard.

Beyond your team, you will align Marketing, Product, Sales and Customer Success around one messaging framework, so every deck, campaign, web page and sales conversation tells the same story.

Product Marketing

Your team owns product marketing for AllVoices. You will hire and lead a Product Marketing Manager to drive this work with you.

  • Own our ICP, value propositions, positioning and competitive differentiation across the ER and HR tech market, and keep them current as we move upmarket.
  • Ground positioning in evidence: win/loss analysis, buyer interviews and what we hear in sales conversations.
  • Run product launches with Product, including tiering, naming, messaging, enablement and the launch calendar.
  • Keep all sales assets and the website current with our latest value propositions and capabilities. This includes the Sales Resource Library: sales decks, case studies, business case materials, video, competitive collateral.
  • Run customer marketing: the weekly customer newsletter, quarterly product roadmap webinars and in-app announcements for major releases.

Content, Community & Events

  • Plan and execute content, events and community efforts focused on the topics our buyers care about most.
  • Expand our content program into SEO & AEO (answer engine optimization), with the right tools and partners.
  • Connect content, community and events to pipeline, so we know what is working and can invest in it.

Website

We work with a web design agency and have a web developer on retainer. You own the website backlog and drive conversion through both content and optimization.

  • Make sure our messaging drives conversion, reflects our competitive differentiators clearly and promotes demo bookings.
  • Optimize landing pages and site experience for paid media campaigns.
  • Prioritize the backlog with our design and development partners, then test and iterate.

Paid Media

We partner with two paid media agencies. With them and your Rev Ops team, you will drive the qualified pipeline we need to hit our sales goals.

  • Meet with each agency regularly to set direction and review performance.
  • Own audience strategy and campaign messaging.
  • Direct campaign creative, from concept to final review.
  • Run analysis with Rev Ops and optimize spend toward qualified pipeline.

AI Optimization

This role uses AI and automation to help a lean team do more. You will:

  • Build automated campaigns using Gong, Claude and HubSpot Prospector, with your Rev Ops and Marketing Ops team and in close partnership with Sales.
  • Identify opportunities to automate content and creative production without sacrificing quality.
  • Surface insights from prospect and customer conversations and emails, and build them into our messaging and competitive differentiation.

How Success Is Measured

  • Marketing-sourced pipeline: Target set with the CEO and Sales in your first 60 days.
  • Pipeline conversion and win rate on marketing-sourced deals: Target set with the CEO and Sales in your first 60 days.
  • Website conversion and demo bookings: Trending up quarter over quarter.
  • Sales use of enablement content: Used in active deals, measured by the Sales team.
  • Product launches: Shipped on the agreed date with enablement in place.

What You Bring

Required

  • 10+ years in enterprise B2B SaaS marketing (selling to mid-market and enterprise companies, not SMB), including 3+ years leading a marketing team.
  • Ownership of pipeline targets and a marketing budget, with results you can walk us through.
  • Strong product marketing: positioning, messaging, competitive marketing and launches that Sales used.
  • A track record of leading and developing marketers, and of managing agencies and outside partners.
  • A hands-on approach. You are comfortable building a deck, writing copy or reviewing creative alongside your team, using tools like Canva and AI.
  • Hands-on experience building automated campaigns and AI workflows with tools like Gong, Claude and HubSpot Prospector.
  • Startup or growth-stage experience, and comfort leading a lean, high-output team.
  • A strong writer who can move between a competitive brief, ad copy and a customer newsletter.
  • A collaborative leader who brings evidence to decisions and builds alignment with Sales, Product and Customer Success.

Preferred

  • HR experience is a huge plus: time working in HR or HR tech, or marketing to HR, Legal and Compliance buyers.
  • Experience marketing an AI product, or using AI to run marketing.
  • Experience moving a company upmarket into mid-market and enterprise accounts.

Compensation and Benefits

Salary range: $180,000 to $210,000 base, plus company equity.

Competitive benefit package, company equity, 401(k) matching, medical, dental and vision insurance, unlimited paid time off, paid holidays, remote flexible work and company equipment.

As an Inbound Business Development Representative, you will be the first conversation many of these suppliers have with us. You will respond quickly, uncover real business problems using Same Side Selling, and turn inbound interest into the qualified pipeline that fuels TradeCentric’s growth.
Reporting to the BDR Manager, you will work as part of a win team with Marketing, Account Executives, and Solution Engineers, using the Same Side Selling methodology to hand AEs well-qualified Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) that turn into real deals.

Pay Range: Base salary ranges from $55,000 to $65,000, with an OTE of up to $90,000.
Final compensation is determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications.

-Raleigh, North Carolina
-Chicago, Illinois
-Boston, Massachusetts
-Charlottesville, Virginia
-Minneapolis, Minnesota

What You'll Do:

Respond Fast, Convert Interest

  • Research prospects, their companies, and key personas (procurement, IT, eCommerce, and digital leaders) to personalize follow-up and deliver messaging that speaks to their world.
  • Supplement inbound with signal-based, account-based outbound, using intent data and trigger events to find the right accounts at the right moment.

Qualify Like a Consultant

  • A strong approach to code quality: maintainable code, useful automated checks, and refactoring that preserves behavior.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please note that all official communication will only come from our verified company email domain @Rippling.com

Who You Are

You are passionate about helping students achieve their educational goals. You thrive in a competitive and collaborative team environment. You are comfortable working remotely and have experience collaborating with others in a virtual environment. You possess a strong attention to detail.    

At ACE, we rely on our IT infrastructure to help our business reach and succeed with students all over the world. You are an experienced systems administrator who’s eager to use and grow his or her technological skills on a global stage. In this role, you will protect our critical information, systems, and assets, build solutions, implement new software and hardware, provide training, and assist in the development of an overall IT strategy. From early on, you’ll help empower our breakthrough innovations, be given challenging assignments, lead initiatives, and take ownership and responsibility. You’ll receive world-class training to help you become a leader in your field.

Compensation

ACE is committed to paying a competitive wage while staying true to our mission of maintaining high quality, affordable programs for our students. The starting salary for this position is $90,000 plus all full-time employees are eligible for an annual bonus. Offers vary depending on education, prior experience, and expertise being applied to the role.

What We Look for in the Ideal Candidate

  • Demonstrates self-reliance by meeting/exceeding workflow needs. 
  • Demonstrates positive attitude and motivation, concern for students, teamwork, and excellent time management skills. 
  • Follows established processes as outlined by organization and leadership. 
  • Completes assigned duties based on daily business needs and individual skill set. 
  • Consistently produces a high volume of quality work. 
  • Capable, adapts as needed, to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines. 
  • Proven ability to work independently with limited supervision and with other department personnel. 
  • Must support and embrace the College’s Impact mission to improve the people and communities we serve through our civic engagement initiatives.  
  • Must have exceptional communication, organization, and time management skills. 
  • Must be "self-motivated" as well as creative and efficient in proposing solutions to complex, time-critical problems. 
  • Must be collaborative in driving decisions and a team-player. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail. 
  • Builds and maintains student satisfaction. 
  • Recognizes and anticipates student needs. 

Day to Day Responsibilities

In this role you will wear different hats, but your skills will be especially essential in the following areas: 

  • Install, configure, and maintain servers, networks, and other IT infrastructure components.
  • Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues to ensure optimal operation.
  • Performs server administration tasks, including user/group administration, security permissions, group policies, print services, research event log warnings and errors, and resource monitoring, ensuring system architecture components work together seamlessly.
  • Implement and manage security measures to protect against unauthorized access and cyber threats.
  • Takes lead and develops an enterprise network that consists of dev, qa, and prod architecture that is in support of networking best practices.
  • Improves network connectivity to and across servers to minimize business disruption to support high availability.
  • Performs routine/scheduled audits of the systems, including all backups.
  • Deploys and releases scheduled and nonscheduled pipeline builds.
  • Maintains and manages all DevOps pipelines and release builds including but not limited to pipeline steps with security to ensure code quality.
  • Focuses on Improving release management processes to minimize outage duration.
  • Enhances DevOps security when it comes to pipelines and deployments.
  • Utilizes Azure where we see fit to remain current and on cutting-edge in terms of technology.
  • Document system configurations, procedures, and changes.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

  • Associate's degree in technology or similar field.
  • Related professional certifications.
  • Proven work experience in IT.
  • Experience with or knowledge of programming languages and operating systems; current equipment and technologies, enterprise backup and recovery procedures, system performance-monitoring tools, active directories, virtualization, HTTP traffic, content delivery, and caching.
  • Experience in project management, application design and integration, and cloud computing (specifically Microsoft Azure).
  • Creating volumes, assigning to servers and remote replication.
  • Manage and maintain enterprise networking to ensure high availability with high security standards and practices.
  • Knowledge of server and network administration best practices.

Our Commitment to Employees

Just as we strive to empower our students for success, we also aim to enrich the lives of our employees. For 6 consecutive years, ACE was recognized as one of Indiana’s Best Places to Work, winning the #1 spot for medium-sized companies in 2020. In addition, ACE has earned national recognition since 2022 for being a USA Today Top Workplace. As a virtual first organization, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating a family-like inclusive work environment. For our full-time employees, we offer the following benefits:

Physical Demands

The physical demand described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.  While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to communicate with and receive communications from students and ACE employees in real time using online and other electronic media.

Commitment to Culture

At American College of Education, we’re all about building a one-of-a-kind, supportive community where everyone—students, faculty, and staff—can thrive. Guided by our mission and values, we focus on everything from innovative curriculum design to personalized instruction and student support to intentional planning, inclusive initiatives, and strategic resource allocation. We’re dedicated to creating an environment that celebrates freedom of expression, diversity of thought, open dialogue, and mutual respect. We believe in fostering a sense of belonging and wellness so that every member of our ACE family feels empowered, valued, and ready to reach their full potential. Together, we’re creating a vibrant, resilient, and connected learning community where everyone matters.

Additional Notes

jobs.excerpt: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Key Accountabilities:

Clinical Trial Site Activation:

  • Initiate and coordinate activities and essential documents management during start up towards the compilation of a high quality Investigator Initiation Package (IIP) leading to approval for site initiation
  • Provide support to resolve issues or concerns and timely escalation of site issues where applicable
  • Prepare, validate and submit regulatory documents such as completed IIP, Institutional Review Board (IRB) approval forms, FDA 1572/Attestation Form, for internal regulatory approval within required timelines
  • Manage and coordinate with other supporting roles to ensure timely site activation and operational activities
  • Support the compilation of the Central Investigator Review Board package and submissions to approval of the study (where applicable) and other committees as per country requirements
  • Coordinate the timely communication, documentation and responses between client and central ethics committee to bring clinical study to approval (country dependent)
  • Support investigators sites with local IRB workflow from preparation, submission through approval
  • Assist with the preparation, handling, and distribution of clinical documentation and reports according to the scope of work and standard operating procedures
  • Support and implement activities in Shared Investigator Platform (SIP) to align with the client’s strategy as it relates to the role

Clinical Trials Conduct:

  • Post site activation, initiate and coordinate activities and essential documents management with the investigator’s sites towards the compilation of a high quality documents and updates through the life cycle of a study such as the documents management for protocol amendments, FDA 1572/Attestation revisions, ethics committee annual approvals and other activities required during study conduct
  • Ensure maintenance of IRB/Ethics and other committees’ activities as applicable
  • Responsible for timely filing of documents to Trial Master File (TMF) and assisting with periodic quality review of study files for accuracy and completeness
  • Accurately update and maintain clinical trial systems that track site compliance and performance within project timelines
  • Supports investigator sites, and study teams in preparation for and providing responses to site audits / inspections

Communication:

  • Maintain ongoing contact and communication with the study team and respond promptly to study team and investigator site requests
  • Provide functional updates on a country and site level as required
  • Establish tools for efficient updates to study team as needed regarding site status, issues, delays, approvals
  • Disseminate central or local ethics approval to study team and Investigator sites where applicable
  • Communicate local sites approvals to study team members and stakeholders

Clinical Trial Site Support:

  • As needed, perform, awareness session with site personnel on client requirements and to ensure ongoing compliance with study documentation in accordance with prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and client standards
  • Identify and resolve investigator site issues within required timeframes; align with study team and local country colleagues on corrective and preventative actions to close open issues and to prevent recurrence / persistence of issues

Subject Matter Expert (SME):

  • A good understanding of the site activation requirements and processes within the country/region and be able to learn and potentially implement in more than one country
  • May be assigned as Site Activation Partner Point of Contact (PoC) on a study conducted in multiple countries
  • May be assigned as an SME on a system and/or process, and represent the SAP function as applicable
  • May represent the SAP role on global initiatives
  • Able to act as an SME on projects and initiatives, as requested
  • Support the mentoring of new hires on processes/ systems

Compliance with Parexel standards:

  • Complies with required training curriculum
  • Completes timesheets accurately as required
  • Submits expense reports as required
  • Updates CV as required
  • Maintains a working knowledge of and complies with Parexel processes, ICH-GCPs and other applicable requirements

Skills:

  • Knowledge of clinical research and development processes, key operational elements of a clinical trial, and ability to gain command of process details
  • Understand the quality expectations and emphasis on right first time
  • Compliance with all applicable company, regulatory and country requirements
  • Attention to detail evident in a disciplined approach
  • Ability to work independently and also as a team member
  • Ability to organize tasks, time and priorities, ability to multi-task
  • Understand basic medical terminology, GCP requirements and proficient in computer operations
  • Ability to use and learn systems, and to use independently
  • Microsoft Suite o Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS)
  • Electronic Trial Master File o Electronic Investigator Site File (e.g. Florence)
  • Document exchange portals o Shared Investigator Platform o Ethics, National Networks and Governing Bodies Portals and platforms (as needed)
  • Flexible and adapt to off working hours in a global environment (when applicable)
  • Able to travel as needed, including some international travel possible

Knowledge and Experience:

  • Experience working in the pharmaceutical industry/or CRO in study site activation preferred
  • Knowledge of clinical trial methodologies, ICH/GCP, FDA and Global and local country regulations
  • Must be fluent in local language and in English. Multilanguage capability is preferred
  • Individuals based in Canada: Bilingualism (French, English) is preferred
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills in relating to colleagues and associates both inside and outside of the organization
  • Good technical skills and ability to learn and use multiple systems

Education:

  • School diploma or certificate with equivalent combination of education, training and experience or Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Arts or equivalent
  • Education in life sciences discipline is preferred
  • Minimum 2 years relevant experience in clinical site management

Job Title: Graduate Intern – R&D Execution, Operations & Strategy (R&D EOS) (Summer 2027)

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Graduate Intern – R&D Execution, Operations & Strategy (R&D EOS) (Summer 2027)

What You Will Do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. We have multiple openings for graduate level students to further their educational goals. This internship will be approximately 12 weeks and includes both project-based and experiential learning. The intern will be an integral member of the R&D Execution, Operations & Strategy (R&D EOS) organization, which is focused on driving innovation beyond the molecule and applying digital (and other) strategies to simplify processes. The 4 functional areas within R&D EOS are:

  • Strategy: Powering-up industry-leading R&D through strategy, functional transformation, and performance excellence
  • Portfolio & Program Management: Turning product strategy into execution to bring medicines to patients faster
  • R&D Business Operations: Innovating excellence and navigating efficiency to manage R&D operational activities, including budget planning and contracting, suppliers, laboratories, workforce strategy and environmental, social & governance (ESG)
  • R&D Knowledge & Learning: Transforming and advancing digitization and contemporized learning as well as cultivating talent & culture for a people-centric and inclusive workforce

As a member of Amgen's R&D EOS organization, your work will be highly collaborative across multiple functions and levels within Amgen, including Research & Development, Chief Medical Office, Chief Technology Officer, Quality & Compliance, and others. You will be uniquely responsible for one or more key projects that will advance R&D EOS’ mission, including the following:

  • Supporting a project within one of our functional areas
  • Working collaboratively with cross-functional teams on projects and/or programs that strive to improve R&D’s competitiveness through speed, agility and excellence in execution
  • Leveraging your analytical, leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills to work in teams, identify problems, conduct research, develop recommendations through qualitative and quantitative analysis, and deliver final projects
  • Presenting your deliverables/findings through various forums including an intern-wide poster session and a final readout to executive management
  • Engaging in learning activities, networking with colleagues across the company, and enjoying full access to Amgen’s Employee Resource Groups

This description serves as a general outline for the responsibilities of a graduate intern in R&D EOS. The specific tasks and requirements may vary depending on the nature of the project.

Program Eligibility Requirements

  • Must be available to work a full-time schedule.
  • Expected continued enrollment in an accredited college or university following the internship program / co-op
  • Student must be located in the United States for the duration of the internship program

What We Expect of You

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The [vital attribute] individual we seek is a [type of person] with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

Amgen requires that all individuals applying for a grad internship or a co-op assignment at Amgen must meet the following criteria:

  • 18 years or older
  • Graduated with a bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university
  • Currently enrolled in an MBA program for an MBA internship OR a Master’s program for a Master’s internship OR a PharmD program for a PharmD internship OR Ph.D. for a PhD internship from an accredited college or university and completion of the first year of MBA OR Master’s OR Pharm D OR Ph.D. program before the internship starts

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Pursuing a degree in Business, Finance, Management Sciences, Life Sciences, Engineering, Communications, Psychology, Human Resources, or a similar field
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Highly organized, with an ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Enthusiastic, proactive, and a willingness to learn.
  • Adaptability in navigating and effectively responding to ambiguity and evolving circumstances and priorities.
  • Basic understanding of project management concepts is a plus.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience

What You Can Expect of Us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The base pay range for this opportunity in the U.S. is $35.34 - $41.20 per hour.

  • Build a network of colleagues that will endure and grow throughout your time with us and beyond.
  • Bring your authentic self to the table and become the professional you’re inspired to be through accepting a culture that values the diversity of thought and experience and will flex to your strengths and possibilities.
  • Participate in executive and social networking events, as well as community volunteer projects.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

  • It's platform AND product. You build reusable platform capability while enabling product teams to ship features fast - balancing leverage with velocity.
  • It's domain-first, not tech-first. You'll learn our customers' operational domain; the best platform choices come from understanding how the work actually runs.

Core Platform Services

  • Design and build core backend services - APIs, orchestration, and access control - as reliable, well-tested production systems.

Multi-Tenant SaaS & Integration

  • Build for multiple customers on shared infrastructure: isolation, quotas, and usage metering done properly.

Ownership & Reliability

  • Own services end to end: design, implementation, tests, deployment, and on-call for what you ship.

Delivering Value with Product & Customers

  • Work with product teams and customers to validate results and outcomes, prioritizing by value.

jobs.title: SEO Manager
jobs.excerpt: About the company Turning marketing into a market-domination weapon, iSpeedToLead created a new category — the marketplace for future customers.
jobs.description:
About the company
Turning marketing into a market-domination weapon, iSpeedToLead created a new category — the marketplace for future customers. Businesses shop for leads as they shop for products in e-commerce: they can see key details before buying, with more transparency, control, and predictable outcomes. iSpeedToLead helps real estate wholesalers, investors, flippers, and increasingly agents buy motivated home-seller leads — homeowners who want to sell their property — through a live lead marketplace.

Why this role exists
iSpeedToLead ranks well for its own brand name, but has very limited visibility beyond branded search today. The company currently ranks for roughly 50 keywords, while direct competitors rank for around 3,900, and that gap is especially visible in the non-branded real estate lead-generation terms that bring in new customers. We need someone who treats SEO as a strategy discipline, not a link-buying function — someone who can build a real keyword strategy for our niche, close the gap against named competitors, and get technical fixes actually shipped, not just recommended.

Role overview
We are looking for a Senior SEO Manager to own the search growth layer of our business across both classic SEO and AI search visibility. You will build a true keyword strategy for the niche, improve technical foundations, strengthen our visibility in AI search, and make sure high-intent commercial pages attract qualified non-branded traffic. This is a high-ownership role for someone who can connect strategy, execution, reporting, and business outcomes — not someone who treats SEO as a narrow content or backlink function.

What You'll Be Doing:
• Build a prioritized keyword strategy for our niche: real estate lead generation, focused on buyer-intent terms rather than just branded or broad SEO traffic.
• Map category, comparison, wholesaler, investor, and agent lead-generation searches, benchmarked against named competitors such as PropStream, RealEstateBees, PropertyLeads, and LeadZolo.
• Own technical SEO fundamentals including title tags, meta descriptions, alt text, schema/structured data, canonical tags, crawlability, and related site-health basics.
• Continue and expand AEO / GEO work so classic SEO and AI-search visibility improve together rather than one being neglected in favor of the other.
• Shape content and page-level strategy for the site’s highest-intent commercial pages, especially the marketplace, landing pages, and signup funnel.
• Run regular competitive and keyword-gap analysis using Ahrefs, Semrush, or equivalent tools, and report on actual market position rather than vanity growth percentages.
• Work directly with the dev team by writing clear, dev-ready tickets and following through until technical fixes actually ship.
• Build reporting that clearly separates non-branded keyword and traffic growth from branded traffic growth and AI-citation counts so leadership sees the real acquisition picture.

Requirements:
• Proven track record in technical and strategic SEO, not just content or link-building, ideally in a marketplace, lead-generation, SaaS, or real estate business.
• Hands-on experience with keyword research and competitive gap analysis tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, or equivalent.
• Solid understanding of on-page and technical SEO fundamentals including schema/structured data, meta tags, canonicalization, crawlability, and Core Web Vitals.
• Working knowledge of AEO / GEO and how AI answer engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and AI Overviews surface and cite content.
• Experience working directly with a dev or engineering team to scope, ticket, and ship SEO fixes.
• Comfortable owning both strategy and reporting, with the ability to show leadership real numbers rather than vague directional updates.
• Strong English communication and comfort working asynchronously across multiple time zones.

What success looks like:
• Meaningful, measurable growth in non-branded keyword rankings for real estate lead-generation terms, not just branded search volume.
• Visible progress in closing the keyword-count gap with direct competitors, currently described as roughly 50 versus 3,900.
• Core commercial pages passing basic technical SEO checks, including correct title tags, meta descriptions, schema, and alt text.
• Technical fixes being shipped within an agreed SLA instead of remaining stuck in backlog.
• Classic SEO and AEO / GEO metrics reported together with clear attribution of what is actually driving growth.
• Growth in qualified signups from organic and AI search, especially wholesalers, investors, and agents rather than low-intent traffic.

This is not for you if
• You see SEO mainly as buying backlinks or authority posts rather than owning search strategy more broadly.
• You treat branded traffic growth or AI-citation wins alone as proof of success.
• You deprioritize technical SEO basics such as schema, title tags, and metadata.
• You prefer a passive advisory role where recommendations are documented but not pushed through to implementation.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in the real estate investing, wholesaling, or lead-generation space specifically.

  • Experience with WordPress SEO, including Rank Math, and Elementor-based sites.

  • Familiarity with link-building and authority-post strategy, so you can evaluate and improve existing vendor relationships rather than simply continue them by default.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager, North America
jobs.excerpt: Nexford University is seeking a hands-on Performance Marketing Manager to join a motivated, highly creative, and innovative marketing team, grow qualified demand, and improve enrollment outcomes across North America.
jobs.description:
Nexford University is seeking a hands-on Performance Marketing Manager to join a motivated, highly creative, and innovative marketing team, grow qualified demand, and improve enrollment outcomes across North America.

You will manage B2C paid media day to day while taking ownership of how campaigns connect to the broader enrollment funnel. Success requires strong campaign execution, analytical judgment, and close collaboration with Sales, Admissions, Marketing Operations, and Creative.

Cross-functional ownership is a core expectation of this role. We are looking for someone who follows performance challenges beyond the ad platform, brings the right people together, and drives agreed actions forward. Whether the opportunity involves lead quality, nurture, application completion, creative, or Sales follow-up, you will be expected to contribute proactively and coordinate improvements across teams.

Adaptability is equally important. Nexford operates in an evolving environment where business priorities, programs, messaging, and enrollment needs can change. You must be comfortable working through ambiguity, reassessing plans as new information becomes available, and communicating tradeoffs clearly. We value someone who raises concerns constructively, proposes solutions, and follows through when priorities shift.

This is an individual contributor position with direct responsibility for execution and project ownership. You will work with internal specialists and external partners, respect their expertise, and remain accountable for moving your initiatives forward. You do not need to execute every function yourself, but you must be willing to work across functions to deliver enrollment results.

What you will own:

Paid media strategy and execution

  • Plan, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.
  • Own campaign structure, targeting, bidding, budget pacing, tracking requirements, and ongoing optimization.
  • Build monthly media plans aligned with enrollment priorities, historical performance, seasonality, and the applicant decision cycle.
  • Allocate spend based on qualified demand, downstream conversion, and acquisition efficiency.
  • Maintain a prioritized testing plan for audiences, creative, offers, and landing pages.

Funnel performance and demand generation

  • Monitor the journey from lead generation through application starts, completed applications, and enrollment.
  • Identify where prospects drop off and coordinate improvements with the teams responsible.
  • Own NAM campaign and audience requirements for nurture initiatives, including segmentation, messaging, and conversion goals.
  • Partner with Marketing Operations on implementation, testing, and measurement of nurture and automation.
  • Evaluate campaign performance beyond lead volume and cost per lead.

Sales and Admissions alignment

  • Maintain regular communication with Sales and Admissions on lead quality, follow-up, objections, and conversion barriers.
  • Use feedback and funnel data to recommend campaign, messaging, and targeting adjustments.
  • Coordinate campaign launches with team capacity and relevant enrollment dates.
  • Bring clear recommendations and follow through on agreed actions.

Creative and conversion optimization

  • Develop clear creative briefs with audience insights, hooks, messaging, calls to action, and testing hypotheses.
  • Work with Creative to produce and improve campaign assets.
  • Partner with the website and digital teams on landing pages, forms, and conversion experiments.
  • Share performance feedback that helps teams understand what to improve and why.

Reporting, forecasting, and accountability

  • Maintain accurate dashboards and deliver reporting on the agreed cadence.
  • Explain results in the context of spend, seasonality, attribution, campaign maturity, and conversion timing.
  • Contribute to enrollment forecasts and clearly communicate assumptions, risks, and resource needs.
  • Translate reporting into decisions, experiments, and next steps.
  • Keep Asana tasks, documentation, deadlines, and project status current.

Vendor and cross-functional project ownership

  • Manage relevant paid media and demand generation vendors, including briefs, deliverables, timelines, and performance.
  • Own assigned initiatives from planning through completion, coordinating contributions from other teams.
  • Flag blockers early and propose practical solutions.
  • Support enrollment-focused webinars, partnerships, and events where campaign expertise is needed, with responsibilities and priorities agreed in advance.

AI-enabled efficiency

  • Use appropriate AI tools to support research, analysis, campaign development, and routine workflows.
  • Review outputs for accuracy, brand alignment, and suitability before use.
  • Assess AI applications based on their contribution to efficiency and marketing outcomes.

What you bring

  • At least four years of B2C hands-on performance marketing or demand generation experience.
  • Demonstrated experience managing paid B2C campaigns targeting U.S. audiences.
  • Strong working knowledge of Google Ads and Meta Ads; experience with LinkedIn Ads is a plus.
  • Evidence of improving downstream conversion and acquisition efficiency, beyond generating inexpensive leads.
  • Experience working with Sales on a considered-purchase journey or a multi-stage conversion funnel.
  • Proficiency with HubSpot or a comparable CRM, GA4, campaign attribution, and reporting tools.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to build realistic plans from historical data.
  • Experience briefing creative teams, coordinating vendors, and managing projects across functions.
  • Clear communication, reliable follow-through, and comfort raising concerns constructively.
  • Higher education or adult learner acquisition experience is preferred.

How success will be measured

Targets will be established using historical performance, available budget, sales capacity, and conversion timing. Measures will include:

  • Qualified lead and application generation.
  • Application completion and lead-to-enrollment conversion.
  • Cost per qualified lead, completed application, and enrollment.
  • Budget pacing and forecast accuracy.
  • Results from creative, audience, landing page, and nurture experiments.
  • Timely delivery, documentation, and completion of agreed projects.
  • Effective collaboration with Sales, Admissions, and Marketing Operations.

What to expect

You’ll join a motivated, creative, and innovative marketing team that enjoys testing ideas, solving challenges, and finding better ways to reach learners. You’ll have room to bring your perspective, shape campaigns, and see the impact of your work.

At Nexford University, you’ll help expand access to education built around the needs of today’s learners and employers. As an online university serving a global community, Nexford brings together people who believe education can open doors to new opportunities. For a marketer, that means meaningful stories to tell, new ideas to explore, and the chance to connect learners with programs that support their ambitions. You’ll join an international team where creativity, fresh perspectives, and collaboration help shape what comes next.

Collaboration goes beyond Marketing. You’ll work closely with Sales, Admissions, Creative, and Marketing Operations to turn ideas into action and improve the enrollment journey.

As Nexford grows, you’ll help the team explore new opportunities and adapt campaigns to changing learner and business needs. The Head of Marketing provides strategic direction and helps align priorities, while you bring initiative, hands-on execution, and ownership of your projects.

Redwood Finance Automation Solution Designer, Spain

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Spain. Day rate: EUR 450 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineering team can build. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the record-to-report processes with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design across close, reconciliation, journals and intercompany, written up as the solution design. Decisions on what standard Redwood capability covers and where an extension is justified. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems. Balance sheet auto-certification rules, controls, approvals and audit trail designed into the solution, so the automated close stands up to audit. Guidance to the engineers through build, and review of what they deliver against the design. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users. A roadmap for the next waves of automation once the first processes are live.

What you bring

Solution design ownership on at least one live Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance) implementation, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. 8 or more years in finance transformation, finance systems or record-to-report process design. A working understanding of SAP FI/CO, or the Oracle equivalent, and how close and reconciliation data flows between the ERP and the automation layer. Experience running workshops with finance users and turning what they say into a design that can be built and tested. The standing to work with senior finance stakeholders and hold a design position when it is challenged.

Useful but not essential:

Hands-on build experience on Redwood, so you know what your design asks of the engineers. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A finance qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar). Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and which design decisions were yours.

What does a day in the life of a Technical Support Engineer like?

Customer Support & Issue Resolution:

  • Provide advanced technical support for complex enterprise software issues, including automation, integrations, exports, and UI behavior.
  • Investigate and resolve customer-reported issues via tickets (SUP cases), Slack threads, and direct communications, documenting findings and resolutions.
  • Identify root causes of recurring issues and escalate critical problems to engineering with full reproduction steps, logs, and analysis.
  • Respond to escalations, including system errors, automation failures, or workflow interruptions, ensuring timely and accurate resolutions.

API & Integration Support:

  • Assist with integration of APIs such as client's API, guiding teams and customer through record creation, updates, and custom workflows.
  • Troubleshoot API errors using tools like Insomnia, Postman, or custom Python scripts.

Automation & Scripting:

  • Develop, maintain, and debug automation scripts in Python and Playwright for testing, exports, app installations, and workflow orchestration.
  • Automate repetitive tasks such as app exports, installations, and record updates to improve team efficiency.
  • Ensure automation scripts are robust, reusable, and aligned with system rules and constraints.

Quality Assurance & Testing:

  • Conduct comprehensive testing of platform features, including display blocks, dynamic/static picklists, export/import workflows, record selections, and custom aspect and etc.
  • Identify, document, and track bugs with clear steps, screenshots, logs, and environment details.
  • Perform retests to validate fixes and ensure functionality across multiple scenarios.
  • Collaborate with engineering to implement enhancements and prevent regression issues.

Monitoring & Analytics:

  • Use monitoring tools such as Datadog to analyze system logs, track recurring errors, and identify performance bottlenecks.
  • Detect patterns in system failures or automation issues and propose preventive solutions.
  • Collaborate with engineering on data-driven troubleshooting and debugging initiatives.

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing:

  • Create clear, detailed technical documentation for workflows, API usage, automation scripts, and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Maintain internal cheat sheets, guides, and best practices for the support team.

The Sales Director – Retail Private Brands, Personal Care Solutions will serve as the architect for building PLZ’s retail private-label personal care business from the ground up. This position is remote with up to 50% travel across the US and Canada.

Key Responsibilities:

Retail Growth Strategy

  • Work with the Retail Category Director and other team members to develop and execute a retail private-label personal care growth strategy focused on building PLZ’s presence from the ground up across prioritized national and regional retail customers.

  • Monitor consumer trends, retailer strategies, competitive activity, and category insights to identify assortment gaps, innovation platforms, and retailer-specific growth opportunities.

Customer Development & Relationship Management

  • Develop and maintain relationships with retail buyers, private brand leaders, category managers, sourcing teams, procurement leaders, broker partners, and other key customer stakeholders.

  • Develop retailer-specific product concepts and account strategies that align customer needs with PLZ’s manufacturing, innovation, quality, regulatory, supply chain, and financial objectives.
  • Serve as the primary commercial point of contact for assigned customers and prospective accounts while influencing internal stakeholders to support customer priorities and launch requirements.

Broker & Partner Management

  • Manage broker networks, sales agencies, and external partners supporting retail growth initiatives.
  • Establish performance expectations, account priorities, business development objectives, and opportunity tracking processes.
  • Ensure partner activities align with strategic growth priorities and targeted customer opportunities.
  • Drive accountability for customer engagement, pipeline progression, and new business development results.

Pipeline, Pricing, & Commercial Execution

  • Own the sales pipeline from prospecting through commercialization, including opportunity qualification, RFPs/RFQs, pricing, contract negotiations, customer onboarding, forecasting, and successful business launch.

  • Maintain accurate CRM reporting on opportunity size, probability, timing, financial impact, risks, customer requirements, and next steps.
  • Partner with Finance and business leadership to evaluate pricing, margins, customer profitability, investment decisions, and commercial trade-offs.
  • Drive disciplined portfolio and opportunity management to maximize strategic and financial value.
  • Analyze win/loss performance and implement continuous improvement actions to strengthen commercial effectiveness.

Cross-Functional Commercialization

  • Partner with R&D, Product Development, Operations, Quality, Regulatory, Procurement, Supply Chain, Marketing, and Customer Service teams to successfully commercialize new products and programs.
  • Translate customer requirements into executable project plans, including product specifications, formulations, packaging, regulatory requirements, testing, launch timelines, and operational readiness.
  • Ensure customer commitments align with manufacturing capabilities, quality standards, lead times, and service expectations.
  • Facilitate issue resolution and remove barriers that could impact customer approval, commercialization, or launch timelines.
  • Support post-launch business reviews and account growth initiatives to expand customer partnerships.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Chemistry, Consumer Products, Supply Chain, or related field required; MBA preferred.
  • Minimum 7-10 years of progressive sales, business development, or commercial leadership experience within consumer products, retail, private label, personal care, beauty, or related industries.
  • Mandatory: Proven private-label experience, including direct involvement with retailer-owned brand or store brand programs.
  • Mandatory: Experience selling directly to retailers, including mass, drug, grocery, club, specialty, beauty, or regional retail customers.
  • Mandatory: Experience managing brokers, sales agencies, or external commercial partners.
  • Strong understanding of retail customer development, private-label commercialization, category management, line reviews, RFP/RFQ processes, assortment gap identification, and retailer decision-making processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop retailer-specific product concepts and translate customer/category insights into commercially viable programs.
  • Proven ability to build, prioritize, and convert a strategic sales pipeline within complex retail environments.
  • Strong financial acumen, including pricing strategy, margin management, customer profitability, demand forecasting, launch economics, and business case development.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product Development, Operations, Quality, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Marketing, and Customer Service teams.
  • Strong executive-level communication, negotiation, presentation, influence, and collaboration skills.
  • Entrepreneurial, highly accountable builder/hunter who can create a new business while bringing the broader organization along and leveraging capabilities already in place.

  • Contract manufacturing and branded-product experience are preferred, not required.
  • CRM proficiency required.

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Hybrid or remote office environment with extensive use of computer, phone, and video conferencing technology. Preferred location is the Chicago area to support proximity to PLZ headquarters, Coal City, and strategic retail customers; Minneapolis may also be considered.

  • Design and implement protocols for communication in a highly scalable, distributed system.
  • Develop reliable and performant code for our collector deployed at tens of thousands of customer sites.
  • Help expand the depth and breadth of our solution based on your deep knowledge of networking devices and protocols.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product management to deliver software components to meet the needs of our customers.
  • Apply AI-enabled techniques to solve complex engineering problems, using intelligent tooling, automation, and data-informed debugging to build scalable systems, improve reliability, and accelerate delivery across the stack.
