Job Description Summary

The ASC Solutions Architect is the commercial solutioning and deal-architecture lead for complex ambulatory surgery center opportunities. This role partners with ASC Development Leaders, regional and account sales teams, product specialists, finance, Healthcare Financial Services, service, legal, compliance, operations, and other stakeholders to translate customer requirements into coordinated, customer-centered, financially sound, and executable multi-modality solutions. The Solutions Architect owns the development of integrated equipment and service bundles, configurations, quotes, financing pathways, deal economics, approval materials, and commercial execution plans while supporting a consistent experience from discovery through booked order and implementation handoff.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

Solution Design and Configuration

  • Partner with the ASC Development Leader and commercial teams to translate the customer’s clinical strategy, procedure mix, facility plan, workflow, timeline, budget, and growth objectives into a coordinated solution architecture.
  • Design scalable ASC bundles across relevant GE HealthCare equipment, software, digital, service, training, and partner capabilities, balancing customer requirements, clinical workflow, standardization, implementation readiness, and commercial objectives.
  • Coordinate modality inputs, technical requirements, room and infrastructure assumptions, product dependencies, compatibility considerations, and configuration decisions. Document open items, owners, risks, and required decisions.
  • Develop repeatable standard configurations and modular ASC offerings that can be adapted to independent, health system, MSO, private equity, and joint-venture customer models.

Commercial and Financial Solutioning

  • Build and evaluate deal economics, including equipment and service scope, pricing, margin, customer value, projected savings, financing structure, cash-flow considerations, revenue recognition inputs, risk, and expected commercial outcomes.
  • Partner with Finance and Healthcare Financial Services to evaluate capital purchase, lease, financing, phased deployment, and other approved commercial structures that align with the customer’s capital strategy and GE HealthCare requirements.
  • Perform horizontal pricing analysis across modalities and offerings, identify tradeoffs, and develop recommendations that improve competitiveness while maintaining pricing discipline, compliance, and profitability.
  • Prepare clear financial models, scenario comparisons, approval summaries, and executive-level decision materials that simplify complex data and enable timely action.

Quoting, Governance, and Approvals

  • Coordinate the development, consolidation, quality review, and submission of multi-modality quotes, proposals, single-signature packages, and supporting commercial documentation.
  • Engage required stakeholders early and facilitate pricing, risk, legal, compliance, contracting, finance, and Delegation of Authority reviews. Track approvals and resolve gaps or escalations.
  • Maintain strong process discipline in CRM, quoting tools, opportunity documentation, version control, assumptions, milestones, and handoffs.
  • Ensure proposed solutions comply with applicable company policies, pricing governance, commercial approval requirements, contracting standards, and customer commitments.

Pursuit and Cross-Functional Execution

  • Serve as the solution-development partner to the ASC Development Leader, who remains the opportunity quarterback and owner of market development, executive relationships, opportunity strategy, pipeline, forecast, and commercial outcomes.
  • Lead cross-functional working sessions to align account sales, product specialists, clinical resources, service, applications, project management, installation, finance, legal, compliance, supply chain, and external partners around one solution and action plan.
  • Support customer-facing discovery and solution reviews when technical, financial, workflow, implementation, or commercial expertise is required.
  • Anticipate execution risks, dependencies, lead times, partner requirements, and implementation constraints, and develop practical mitigation plans before customer commitments are finalized.
  • Provide a structured handoff after contract execution or order booking so project, installation, service, applications, and clinical teams understand scope, assumptions, dependencies, and customer commitments.

Standard Work and Continuous Improvement

  • Develop, document, and continuously improve ASC solutioning standard work, intake requirements, configuration guides, financial templates, quote checklists, approval workflows, and handoff tools.
  • Apply Lean and structured problem-solving methods to identify root causes, remove delays and rework, simplify processes, and improve speed, quality, transparency, and scalability.
  • Capture lessons learned and provide upstream feedback to product, finance, commercial enablement, service, operations, and leadership to strengthen future ASC offerings.
  • Champion appropriate tools, analytics, automation, and knowledge-sharing practices that improve repeatability and team effectiveness.

Measures of Success

  • Time from qualified request to coordinated solution, approved quote, and customer-ready proposal.
  • Accuracy and completeness of configurations, pricing, financial models, documentation, and approval packages.
  • Multi-modality attach rate and adoption of repeatable ASC bundles and standard configurations.
  • Pricing and margin performance within approved guardrails, with transparent management of exceptions and risk.
  • Quality of cross-functional coordination, customer experience, implementation readiness, and post-booking handoffs.
  • Reduction in quote rework, cycle-time delays, missed dependencies, and preventable escalations.
  • Contribution to ASC opportunity progression, win rate, orders, revenue, profitability, and strategic account growth.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 5 years of commercial, financial, operational, proposal, deal-desk, or solution-development experience in healthcare, medical technology, capital equipment, financial services, or a related industry.
  • Demonstrated experience with financial analysis, pricing, deal modeling, risk assessment, capital planning, financing solutions, or complex commercial structures.
  • Proven project-management capability, including facilitation, scheduling, prioritization, risk management, follow-up, tracking, documentation, and communication.
  • Ability to develop and coordinate complex, multi-stakeholder solutions in a highly matrixed organization.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert detailed financial, technical, and commercial information into clear recommendations.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across commercial, clinical, technical, operational, financial, and executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to travel 30% of the time.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Commercial solutioning background with experience structuring integrated equipment, service, digital, and financing offerings.
  • Strong financing solutions profile, including experience with leases, capital financing, cash-flow modeling, return-on-investment analysis, and alternative transaction structures.
  • Firsthand experience supporting ambulatory surgery centers, MSOs, private equity-backed healthcare platforms, IDNs, physician groups, de novo facilities, or complex outpatient capital projects.
  • Knowledge of the ASC market and the stakeholders involved in planning, building, financing, equipping, implementing, and operating an ASC.
  • Experience with cardiovascular, interventional, imaging, ultrasound, patient monitoring, anesthesia, digital, service, or other multi-modality healthcare solutions.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency with PowerPoint, Word, Teams, SharePoint, CRM, quoting, and proposal tools.
  • Ability to visually present complex, data-rich information in a simple format that enables efficient decision-making.
  • Functional knowledge of pricing compliance, revenue recognition, contracting, Delegation of Authority, commercial approvals, and risk management.
  • Experience with large-scale process improvement, Lean methods, workflow automation, and development of repeatable standard work.
  • Excellent process discipline and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple urgent priorities without sacrificing quality.
  • Comfortable coordinating across modalities, regions, functions, operating businesses, and external partners without direct authority.
  • Customer-facing experience and the ability to understand and represent the customer’s business, clinical, operational, and financial perspective.
  • Ability to remain calm, objective, and solutions-focused under pressure.

Lead Duties (60% approximately 24 hours/Week)

- Cover out of office staff assignments (i.e. closing out pending queries, re-reviews, DRG MM etc.)

- Monitors internal key indicator metrics and develops corrective action plan when metrics not achieved.

- Clearly communicate program updates, concerns or client requests that are out of scope to the Manager and Director of CDI

CDI Duties (40% approximately 16 hours/Week)

- Facilitates appropriate clinical documentation to support appropriate diagnosis and procedure coding.

- Collaborates with HIM coding staff to promote complete and accurate clinical documentation and correct negative trends.

- Communicates with physicians, case managers, coders, and other members of the care team to facilitate comprehensive medical record documentation to reflect treatment, decision-making and severity of illness.

- Assigns a working DRG using official coding guidelines on initial and subsequent follow up reviews.

- Updated working DRG for Case Management team per facility specific process

- Queries providers on a concurrent (and as appropriate retrospective) basis. Collaborates with providers per facility policy to clarify documentation in the medical record.

- Formulate compliant and credible clinical documentation clarifications to improve clinical documentation of principal diagnosis, procedures, co-morbidities, present on admission (POA), quality core measures, and patient safety indicators (PSI’s). (Following ACDIS, AHIMA and CMS guidelines for effective and compliant query process.)

-Utilizes software system (including CDI and Encoder technology) to collect, track and report outcomes. Maintains integrity of data collection.

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Romania. Day rate: EUR 450 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineering team can build. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the record-to-report processes with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design across close, reconciliation, journals and intercompany, written up as the solution design. Decisions on what standard Redwood capability covers and where an extension is justified. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems. Balance sheet auto-certification rules, controls, approvals and audit trail designed into the solution, so the automated close stands up to audit. Guidance to the engineers through build, and review of what they deliver against the design. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users. A roadmap for the next waves of automation once the first processes are live.

What you bring

Solution design ownership on at least one live Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance) implementation, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. 8 or more years in finance transformation, finance systems or record-to-report process design. A working understanding of SAP FI/CO, or the Oracle equivalent, and how close and reconciliation data flows between the ERP and the automation layer. Experience running workshops with finance users and turning what they say into a design that can be built and tested. The standing to work with senior finance stakeholders and hold a design position when it is challenged.

Useful but not essential:

Hands-on build experience on Redwood, so you know what your design asks of the engineers. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A finance qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar). Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and which design decisions were yours.

Missão do Cargo

Atuar na arquitetura, no desenvolvimento e na implementação de soluções avançadas de Engenharia de Dados, com forte domínio em Databricks e integração de dados provenientes do ecossistema SAP. Será responsável por construir e otimizar pipelines de dados, implementar arquiteturas Lakehouse, desenvolver processos de ETL/ELT e garantir a qualidade, a escalabilidade, a governança e a disponibilidade das informações para ambientes analíticos e estratégicos.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando Databricks, garantindo eficiência, escalabilidade e performance no processamento de grandes volumes de informações;

  • Atuar na extração, integração e transformação de dados provenientes do SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC e demais soluções do ecossistema SAP;
  • Implementar integrações entre SAP e Databricks utilizando APIs, OData, conectores e mecanismos de ingestão de dados;
  • Desenvolver soluções de processamento em batch e streaming, conforme as necessidades dos projetos;
  • Implementar boas práticas de governança, qualidade, segurança, linhagem e monitoramento de dados, incluindo recursos do Unity Catalog;
  • Realizar otimizações de performance em consultas SQL, jobs e workflows no ambiente Databricks;
  • Atuar na automação e orquestração de pipelines, garantindo a confiabilidade e a disponibilidade dos processos;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de Arquitetura, BI, Analytics e áreas de negócio na construção de soluções orientadas a dados.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Dados, com atuação em projetos de arquitetura e processamento de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Experiência avançada e prática com Databricks, incluindo desenvolvimento, implementação e otimização de pipelines de dados;
  • Domínio de Apache Spark, PySpark e Spark SQL;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Delta Lake, Delta Tables e arquitetura Lakehouse;
  • Experiência com arquitetura Medallion (Bronze, Silver e Gold);
  • Conhecimento em Databricks Workflows, Jobs e recursos de orquestração;
  • Experiência com Unity Catalog, governança, controle de acesso e linhagem de dados;
  • Domínio de SQL e Python aplicados à Engenharia de Dados;
  • Experiência em processos de ETL/ELT e integração de múltiplas fontes de dados;
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema SAP, especialmente SAP S/4HANA e/ou SAP ECC;
  • Experiência com extração e integração de dados SAP por meio de APIs, OData, RFC, IDoc ou outros mecanismos;
  • Conhecimento em SAP Datasphere, SAP BW/4HANA ou SAP Data Services;
  • Vivência com ambientes em nuvem, preferencialmente AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud.

Vamos gostar muito se, além disso tudo, você tiver:

  • Experiência com processamento de dados em tempo real (streaming);

  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas e ambientes corporativos de grande porte.

Innovation never stops, it only accelerates.  

The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in machine learning and statistical modeling, as well as genomics and sequencing data analysis. The successful candidate will be instrumental in developing and expanding state-of-the-art machine learning methods for early detection of cancer, and will provide technical leadership and mentorship within a highly collaborative team.

  • Design, implement, and validate novel machine learning and statistical methods to solve problems in cancer diagnostics
  • Establish and promote best practices in model interpretability, uncertainty estimation, and reproducibility
  • Design robust feature engineering and extraction pipelines tailored to cfDNA methylation and sequencing data
  • Collaborate closely with molecular biologists on experimental design, ensuring data integrity and quality control
  • Mentor other scientists and foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and scientific excellence
  • Lead and actively participate in code and design reviews

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • PhD in Bioinformatics, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, with 4 to 8+ years of post-PhD experience
  • Hands-on experience in cancer genomics or epigenomics; experience with cell-free DNA or methylation sequencing data is a plus
  • Strong foundation in quantitative reasoning, statistical analysis, and applied machine learning; experience with deep learning frameworks is a plus
  • Proven track record of developing computational methods for high-throughput sequencing data analysis
  • Strong programming skills, with hands-on experience in Python and its scientific library stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn)
  • Experience with Linux command-line tools, shell scripting, version control (Git), workflow managers (e.g., Nextflow, Snakemake), and cloud or HPC compute environments
  • Ability to perform hypothesis-driven research, visualize findings, and summarize results in oral and written form
  • Experience mentoring or technically leading other scientists

• Support transfer monitoring and ingestion operations: expected vs received, timeliness/completeness checks, alert triage/escalation, scheduling/re-runs, defect logging, and operational metric reporting.
• Assist with downstream exports/feeds to internal consumers (CDM, analytics, programming) by preparing and validating outputs against defined data contracts and refresh expectations.

Die Position kann entweder hybrid an unserem Standort in Nürnberg oder vollständig remote innerhalb Deutschlands ausgeübt werden.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Product & Methodology: Konzeption und Weiterentwicklung methodischer Ansätze für Media-Measurement-Produkte entlang des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus

  • Product Development: Übersetzung von Markt-, Kunden- und Business-Anforderungen in methodische Produktkonzepte und konkrete Anforderungen für Data- und Tech-Teams
  • Validation & Scalability: Definition geeigneter Validierungsansätze sowie Bewertung neuer Methoden hinsichtlich Qualität, Machbarkeit, Robustheit und Skalierbarkeit
  • Expert Track: Fachliche Beratung von Product-, Tech- und Commercial-Teams zu Methodik, Annahmen, Datenanforderungen und Limitationen
  • Methodology Communication: Strukturierte und verständliche Aufbereitung methodischer Konzepte für interne und externe Stakeholder

Schwerpunkte in den ersten 6–12 Monaten

  • Weiterentwicklung + Innovation der methodischen Product Roadmap für Cross-Media Measurement, Reach & Frequency, Sales Lift und Brand Lift
  • Entwicklung und Operationalisierung neuer Messansätze unter Nutzung disaggregierter und hybrider Datenquellen
  • Übersetzung von Markt- und Kundenanforderungen in skalierbare Produkt- und Methodenkonzepte
  • Methodische Begleitung von Prototypen und Pilotprojekten inklusive Definition von Go/No-Go-Kriterien und Validierungsanforderungen
  • Bewertung neuer Datenquellen, Modelle und Technologien hinsichtlich ihres Potenzials für bestehende und zukünftige Produkte
  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Methodology Documentation, Guidelines und Best Practices
  • Rolle als methodische:r Sparringspartner:in für Product, Data Science, Technology und Commercial

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Media Measurement, Product Management, Data Science, Analytics oder vergleichbaren methodisch geprägten Bereichen
  • Measurement Know-how: Sehr gutes Verständnis von Media Measurement, idealerweise in Bereichen wie Reach & Frequency, Attribution, Sales Lift oder Brand Lift
  • Methodische Stärke: Fundierte Kenntnisse in Statistik, Modellierung, Data Fusion, Kalibrierung, Imputation und/oder Datenharmonisierung
  • Product Mindset: Fähigkeit, methodische Konzepte nicht nur analytisch zu bewerten, sondern in standardisierbare und skalierbare Produkte zu übersetzen
  • Analytics & Tech: Kenntnisse in R und/oder Python sowie Verständnis moderner Datenarchitekturen, automatisierter Datenverarbeitung und KI-basierter Ansätze
  • Business-Fokus: Fähigkeit, methodische Entscheidungen mit Produktnutzen, Kundenanforderungen und Business Outcomes zu verbinden
  • Kommunikation: Fähigkeit, komplexe methodische Zusammenhänge präzise und adressatengerecht zu vermitteln, auch gegenüber Senior Stakeholdern
  • Sprache: Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

The Senior Informaticist serves as a strategic analytics partner supporting Humana Clinical Pharmacy Review (HCPR) and the pharmacy Prior Authorization (PA) process. The Senior Informaticist will use governed data and modern analytical tools to evaluate Prior Authorization activity and operational performance, identify trends and opportunities, investigate potential drivers of outcomes, and help business partners understand not only what is occurring, but why it is occurring and what actions may improve results.
Your success requires a combination of healthcare and pharmacy knowledge, analytical curiosity, and business partnership. You are comfortable working with Prior Authorization, pharmacy claims, membership, clinical, operational, and other healthcare data while operating within a regulated environment.

The Senior Informaticist serves as a strategic problem solver supporting Humana Clinical Pharmacy Review and pharmacy Prior Authorization operations. You will partner across business, clinical, operations, technology, and analytics teams to address complex and often ambiguous challenges affecting PA processes, operational performance, regulatory reporting, and outcomes.



You will identify opportunities, framing problems, evaluating data and potential solutions, and developing recommendations that help HCPR leaders make informed decisions. Success requires the ability to create clarity in complex situations, understand the operational processes behind the data, and develop practical solutions when perfect information is not available.



Important responsibilities include:

  • Lead complex analytical programs supporting HCPR and pharmacy Prior Authorization, with accountability from problem identification through recommendation, implementation, and measurement of results.
  • Translate complex or ambiguous PA, clinical, operational, and business questions into structured analytical approaches and applicable recommendations.
  • Analyze Prior Authorization activity and operational performance to identify trends, potential drivers, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Combine information across multiple data sources and operational processes to develop a complete view of performance and identify causes.
  • Partner with HCPR leadership and teams to support regulatory and compliance reporting requirements and evolving pharmacy needs.

  • Take ownership of analytical projects, independently determining appropriate approaches, partner engagement, analytical requirements, and deliverables.
  • Identify opportunities to improve PA reporting, operational processes, data quality, and analytical capabilities while challenging assumptions and driving sustainable solutions.
  • Support modernization of HCPR analytics through tools and platforms such as Databricks and Power BI, while maintaining appropriate data governance and reporting standards.


We are looking for someone with exceptional critical thinking, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to connect data, Prior Authorization processes, regulatory requirements, and partner needs to practical solutions. You should be comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change quickly, the underlying business problem may not initially be fully defined, and analytical findings need to be translated into meaningful action.


Use your skills to make an impact

jobs.excerpt: Hello! Innersloth is a small remote team scattered mostly in North America.
jobs.description:
Hello!

Innersloth is a small remote team scattered mostly in North America. We released Among Us in 2018 and are now working on a new game. We are looking to expand our creative team with a full-time, contracted, UI/UX Designer.

Your focus will be on UI/UX Design: creating and maintaining UI/UX documentation, style guides, flows, wireframes, prototypes, mock-ups, and ready-to-implement designs. Your role will be very iterative, proactively developing solutions to address usability feedback from both playtesters and the development team.

You'll report to the project's Game Directors, take direction from the Game Designer, and work alongside the art team. We don’t want to overscope this, but because we are a small team, sometimes responsibilities overlap - a willingness to learn and help is essential. You will not be working alone, and our team prioritizes providing support and ensuring you are thriving in your role.

We especially encourage marginalized groups and people from underrepresented backgrounds, genders, and locations to apply.Diverse voices make Innersloth better, and we strive to continue creating a diverse and welcoming space from the ground up.

Please note this is not an entry-level position, but we'll consider strong candidates with general experience working in games, UI/UX development, and/or visual design that accounts for the required skillset. Please absolutely include these things in your application!

What we're looking for:

Proactivity, independence, and accountability are extremely important for this position. If you show an aptitude for working well with others, handling conflict, and understanding UI/UX design for games, we want to hear from you!

This job opening is only valid for residents living in North America.

We're aiming for a January 11th, 2027 start date.

AI-dependent workflows are not a fit for this position. Candidates should be able to demonstrate their work, reasoning, and problem-solving without AI assistance.

The following points outline the knowledge, skills and abilities that we strongly prefer. None of these are strict dealbreakers, but reflect the type of experience we feel would lead to finding the right candidate for this position.

Our expectations:

  • You have a degree/diploma/certificate in Human-Computer Interaction, Game Design, Graphic Design, Information Science, or a related field. (Equivalent experience is highly valued)
  • You have at least 3 years of prior experience as a UI/UX Designer for games (mobile, PC and/or console) with a strong portfolio that clearly communicates your skill and approach
  • You understand and apply best practices for UX flow and accessibility
  • You pay strong attention to detail and have a keen eye for aesthetics
  • You are proficient in industry standard design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Miro, and Figma
  • You have excellent written and oral communication skills and can clearly articulate your ideas, designs, and suggestions
  • You are comfortable giving and receiving feedback, and can rapidly iterate based on playtest and team feedback
  • Can collaborate and work well in a team-based, dynamic, cross-functional setting
  • You are a highly organized, self-sufficient person who is task-oriented

Nice to have:

  • Experience working within Unity and the Unity UI Toolkit
  • Experience using version control tools (e.g. Git)
  • Experience designing UI/UX for mobile games
  • Experience designing responsive interfaces that accommodate localized text
  • Experience/understanding on running user testing initiatives
  • An understanding of general console certification requirements as they pertain to UI

What you'll be doing:

  • Create original UI/UX designs that exhibit a strong understanding of layout, composition, iconography, typography, and accessibility, while aligning with the art direction and gameplay goals
  • Create and maintain UI/UX documentation, style guides, flows, wireframes, prototypes, mock-ups, and ready-to-implement designs
  • Design UI elements such as menu interfaces, HUD, input controls, navigational components, informational components, and dialogue boxes
  • Design UI/UX that is responsive across multiple platforms, aspect ratios, and screen orientations
  • Report to the game directors while working closely with the game designer, artists, and engineers to help bring the game interfaces to life
  • Identify and troubleshoot UX challenges and opportunities based on playtesting and team feedback
  • Demonstrate ownership and autonomy while delivering project priorities on time
  • Communication requirements include:
    • Responsive and proactive usage of ClickUp and Microsoft Teams
    • Attend and contribute to scheduled meetings when required

Our offer

  • A guaranteed 6 month, full-time, remote, work from home position.
    • While this original contract is set for 6 months, we're open to discussing an extension should the need be proven and required for project completion.
    • Your work week cannot exceed 40 hours/week and must include and relate to Innersloth's Monday to Friday working schedule. Our company core hours are 10 AM to 2 PM PST. You would be expected to be online during this time but how you make up the rest of your day is up to you.
    • You will be responsible to ensure you can perform your job effectively and efficiently.
    • Due to the length of this contract, we are unable to offer health benefits to anyone outside of the United States of America. If our perfect candidate lives internationally, we will offer a fair salary in lieu of benefits.
  • A competitive, fixed, monthly rate of payment.
  • A guarantee that your position is safe and stable for the duration of this project - regardless of what's happening around us, we have a very healthy financial runway.
  • A collection of friendly, diverse workmates and partner companies.

FAQ

  • What's the level of experience necessary?
    • There’s no hard requirement (3+ years is suggested), but ideally you have an applied understanding of UI/UX design workflows.
  • What’s the immediate team like?
    • You will be joining an established team of 6
      people, with three department leads, game designer, programmer, and artists working on the unannounced title.
    • You'll be managed by the game directors. You will communicate and collaborate with the rest of the team often.

Recruitment Process

**Applications close at 10:00 AM PST on November 19th, 2026.**

  • You'll get an email from us to acknowledge receipt.
  • We’ll review applications and contact everyone to let you know if you made it to the next stage or not.
  • Stage 2 will be a video call with 2-3 people from the team to get context on your technical experience, the depth of your technical skillset, and what you could bring to the company. There will be time for you to ask questions as well.
  • Stage 3 will be another video call with some of the wider team members you may work with at Innersloth. Here we will learn more about your experience as a problem solver and team member. There will be time for you to ask questions as well.
  • If all goes well you'll get a job offer.

Wow, you made it to the end!

Please press the button and send us your application. We look forward to hearing from you (and don't forget to upload/link us your portfolio!)

Salary: $9600/Month

jobs.description:
Why should you consider joining Auvik?

  • You want to work at a company that is building impactful, relevant technology. Auvik’s network management software helps IT teams by automating time-consuming tasks, streamlining operations, and mitigating risk. It’s more important than ever to be able to remotely monitor and manage network infrastructure, and with Auvik, IT professionals have that essential visibility and control.

  • You want regular opportunities for learning and growth. With ongoing feedback from leadership, you’ll find that Auvik encourages you to be your very best. Our onboarding process is thorough and informative because we want to make sure you’re prepared to have a great work experience. We also have programs designed to help you take the next steps you want for your career.
  • You want the flexibility to manage your work, your way. We’re a fully distributed team and we’re prepared to continue to support working from home (or the space you choose!). When we’re able, we’ll have Auvik hubs in Waterloo and Barcelona for you to leverage if needed. We trust you to get the job done where you feel most comfortable and effective.

What’s this role all about?

As an Account Executive, you will be the primary point of contact for new Auvik prospects. Using your energy, smarts, selling skills and personal brand, you will focus on closing net new sales opportunities.

What will I be doing?

You’ll be part of a rapidly growing sales team and based remotely. You will be responsible for working with customers to uncover their problems, the associated business impact, and help them understand how Auvik can solve their issues. This is a high-velocity sales role, with average sales cycle in the 30-45 day range so there is lots of opportunity to achieve and exceed your quota!

You will:

  • Work together with prospects to develop them into successful customers and partners.
  • Work with your assigned prospects to fully uncover the business problems they are trying to solve with network monitoring & management.
  • Help your prospects uncover and articulate the value associated with solving those problems.
  • Clearly articulate how Auvik solves those problems and provides value through effective demonstrations and assisting prospects in the trial/POC process.
  • Build and align detailed mutual action plans with your prospects to help them navigate through the buying process.
  • Be responsible for managing your funnel and ensuring that all your activities are tracked. We run a tight ship here.
  • Work with the Auvik partner and customer success teams to provide ongoing value to our partners.
  • Quota is the threshold for success, not the ceiling!

What are we looking for?

  • A tenacious self-starter with a drive to succeed.
  • Proven success meeting/exceeding targets in SaaS based sales or sales engineering.
  • A people person, with a friendly and positive manner.
  • Great communication skills, both verbally and in writing.
  • Candidates with experience selling networking and network-related, RMM/EMM, or PSA/ITSM solutions are preferred.
  • Must have technical aptitude or experience selling a highly technical product.

Are there bonus points?

Yes! We’ll give your application extra credit if you have one or more of these:

  • A track record of over achievement, such as annual sales awards or a history of exceeding sales targets.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce.
  • Experience with computer networking, selling SaaS products, or the managed service provider business model.

How do I apply?

Send us your resume, and tell us why your skills and experience are a great match for Auvik.

As one of Toronto’s fastest-growing tech companies, we regularly recruit for this role as our team expands, and we welcome strong individuals interested in future openings.

About Auvik

Auvik delivers cloud-based network management software that gives IT teams instant visibility and control over their infrastructure — whether on-site, remote, or dispersed across global networks. Our platform automates network discovery, mapping, monitoring, configuration backups, traffic analysis and alerting, so IT professionals and MSPs can manage complex, multi-site environments with ease.

We’re focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. We are happy to make any accommodations you may need throughout the interview process as well.

Auvik is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law.

Hiring Process

At Auvik, our hiring process is designed to be personal, transparent, and human-led. Our Talent Acquisition Partners review all resumes, connect with candidates whose skills and experience aligns with the role, and stay in communication with you throughout your journey. If our interests align, you'll meet with a hiring manager, as well as additional members of the hiring team in follow-up conversations. All of your interviews will take place via Zoom.

Before meeting with a hiring manager, we also ask candidates to complete a 5-minute Predictive Index (PI) assessment. This helps us understand and match your strengths and work preferences with roles that will set you up for success.

We use AI tools to support administrative tasks in the hiring process; such as helping source candidates, drafting communications, and interview summaries, so our team can stay focused and present during conversations. We do not use AI tools to interview, screen or assess candidates; or determine who moves forward in the process. We debrief and consider the full context of every conversation before making hiring decisions. We believe hiring requires judgment that can be augmented but, not replaced by AI.

Compensation Details

At Auvik, our compensation philosophy is to be market competitive, reward performance, reflect our commitment to equity and maintain transparency with our employees. We have defined job levels and compensation ranges for each of our markets we employ, based on research from various sources of market data, which are reviewed on a regular basis.

The hiring range for this position is listed below. Compensation offered for candidates in this role is based on a number of factors including job-related skills, knowledge, and experience. These factors may cause your compensation to vary within the range outlined below.

In addition to cash compensation, all full-time employees are granted stock options to share in Auvik’s future successes. Auvik employees are eligible to participate in additional benefits and programs including our comprehensive health and dental benefits plan, Wellness spending account, GRSP matching program, flexible paid time off, paid parental leave program, and are eligible for remote working subsidies.

jobs.title: Technical Co-founder - AI for Automotive Retail
jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityEvery used-car dealer's profit is made or lost the moment they buy the car — not when they sell it.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Every used-car dealer's profit is made or lost the moment they buy the car — not when they sell it. That decision runs on gut feel, spreadsheets, and whoever has a spare hour, inside a $500B+ industry that hasn't meaningfully modernized how it buys. We think that's an AI-native category waiting to be built, and we're going first.

The problem and solution are validated with a domain co-founder who lives this daily and has already hand

The Venture

Atrium is an always-on AI workforce, not a dashboard — agents that watch, learn, and earn the right to act on their own, deployed inside dealer groups' existing workflows. The same decision logic has to show up everywhere the work already happens — web, desktop, our own browser, mobile — so the workforce follows the person, not the other way around. One brain, every surface.

This isn't a weekend's worth of CRUD. Think dozens of specialist agents organized into a handful of coordinated workflows, sharing one memory, each one earning the right to act on its own track record — across four surfaces at once. If that sounds like a fun problem rather than a scary one, keep reading.

A real technical moat if built right, and a wide-open field — no dominant AI-native player has claimed this category yet. Specifics on the product, the model, and where we stand commercially are best shared in conversation; we're early and staying deliberately quiet in the market.

The Partnership

CEO and domain co-founder are in place; the problem is validated. We're looking for a technical co-founder to own product and engineering from the first commit — full authority, founder equity, a real seat at the table on every major call.

This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will take over the production code and continue building the product (the first lines of production code), set the technical direction, and lead execution end-to-end.

  • Own the core architecture decision that shapes everything else — how the agents actually see and act in a dealer's world, and how one system stays coherent across a web app, a desktop app, our own browser, and mobile, without four separate products drifting apart

  • Design the autonomy model: how an agent earns the right to act alone, and how that trust is never assumed

  • Build the integration layer into a data ecosystem that won't always cooperate

  • Build partnerships with ecosystem data providers and third-party systems to land unconventional integrations no standard API gets you

  • Own unit economics as an architecture problem, not an afterthought — this many agents, across this many surfaces, has to add up

  • Own the design and layering of the system for the dev team, and keep the build matched to what the business and sales side actually need

  • Be the technical voice with dealers, design partners, and investors

  • Hire and lead the founding engineering team

Co-Founder Profile

Must Have:

  • Has shipped agentic or LLM systems into production where being wrong actually costs something

  • Has shipped desktop and mobile apps connected to a larger web platform — comfortable with one product living across multiple facets and surfaces, not just a single app

  • Has shipped LLM-based products, but also worked with SLMs and SLM fine-tuning

  • Has dealt with the real nuances of web scraping — anti-bot defences, rate limits, brittle DOMs, the gap between "works in a demo" and "works at scale against a site that doesn't want you there"

  • Has built complex, modelled data graph layers for intelligence — not just a data pipeline, but a structure that reasoning can actually run on

  • Comfortable owning infra, data, and product alone — then hiring past yourself

  • Treats guardrails and reversibility as core product, not overhead

  • Good to have: edge computing and power-constrained systems, high-frequency distributed computing infrastructure

Great to Have:

  • Experience building against locked-down or adversarial third-party data

  • Vertical/operational domain grit (Automotive)

  • Pragmatic and creative — a solution finder who gets to "working" fast and iterates from there

  • Co-operative, strategic, and hands-on in equal measure

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.title: Teammanager Silverein
jobs.excerpt: 24–36 uur | Meerdere locaties | € 3. 592,96 tot € 6.
jobs.description:
24–36 uur | Meerdere locaties | € 3.592,96 tot € 6.171,02 bruto per maand

Wil jij niet alleen leidinggeven, maar ook écht bouwen aan de toekomst van de zorg? Als Teammanager bij Silverein krijg je de ruimte om jouw team te ontwikkelen, je eigen talenten in te zetten én vanuit jouw expertise bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van jouw regio.

Wat ga je doen als Teammanager?

Als Teammanager geef je leiding aan een team van 40tot 50 medewerkers op fulltime basis. Je creëert een omgeving waarin medewerkers zich kunnen ontwikkelen, verantwoordelijkheid nemen en hun talenten optimaal kunnen inzetten. Je begrijpt dat ieder team iets anders nodig heeft. Daarom pas je jouw leiderschapsstijl aan op de situatie: coachend waar het kan en sturend waar nodig. Je weet mensen met elkaar te verbinden en krijgt de ruimte om samen met jouw team verder te bouwen.

En dat bouwen nemen we letterlijk. We zoeken Teammanagers die een uitdaging niet uit de weg gaan en die energie krijgen van ontwikkelen en verbeteren. Je denkt in kansen, laat je niet snel van je koers afbrengen en ziet een lastige situatie vooral als een kans om samen verder te komen. Je kijkt naar wat er al goed gaat én ziet waar ruimte ligt om de volgende stap te zetten.

Naast de ontwikkeling van jouw team ben je verantwoordelijk voor een gezonde bedrijfsvoering. Je hebt daarbij aandacht voor onder andere formatie, budgetten, verzuim, re-integratie en het werven en behouden van medewerkers.

Ruimte voor jouw talent

Bij Silverein kijken we niet alleen naar wat de functie van jou vraagt, maar juist ook naar wat jij meebrengt. Daarom krijg je onder andere een zelfevaluatiescan waarmee we samen kijken waar jouw kracht ligt, waar jouw ontwikkelpotentieel zit en hoe je dit in de praktijk kunt inzetten.

Ook binnen jouw regio krijg je de mogelijkheid om een eigen expertise in te zetten. Weet jij bijvoorbeeld veel van het verbeteren van kwaliteit van zorg? Of ligt jouw kracht juist op het gebied van verzuim? Dan kun jij binnen jouw regio het aanspreekpunt worden voor dit onderwerp. Zo benutten we niet alleen de talenten binnen jouw team, maar ook die van jou.

Samen bouwen aan betere zorg

Als Teammanager kijk je verder dan alleen jouw eigen team. Je werkt nauw samen met andere Teammanagers en collega's binnen de regio en neemt actief verantwoordelijkheid voor ontwikkelingen die de hele regio raken.

Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om mee te werken aan projecten die de zorg ten goede komen en jouw kennis en ervaring daarin actief in te zetten. Vanuit de visie van Silverein werk je zo iedere dag aan twee dingen die onlosmakelijk met elkaar verbonden zijn: een fijne werkomgeving voor medewerkers en een mooie woonomgeving voor bewoners.

Wij bieden jou:

Een uitdagende rol waarin je veel ruimte krijgt om invloed uit te oefenen op de ontwikkeling van je team, jouw regio én jezelf. Je ontvangt een salaris tussen € 3.592,96 en € 6.171,02 bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur per week.

Daarnaast bieden wij:

  • Een contract voor 24 tot 36 uur per week;

  • Werkdagen en uren in overleg;

  • Een laptop en mobiele telefoon;

  • Veel ruimte om jouw team verder te ontwikkelen;

  • Ruimte om jouw eigen expertise binnen de regio in te zetten;

  • Mogelijkheden om mee te werken aan projecten die bijdragen aan de zorg;

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling;

  • Goede primaire en secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de cao VVT;

  • Een organisatie die volop in ontwikkeling is en waarin jij daadwerkelijk kunt meebouwen.

Wat breng je mee?

Je bent een verbindende en daadkrachtige manager die mensen in beweging weet te krijgen. Je houdt overzicht, durft keuzes te maken en weet medewerkers mee te nemen in verandering. Daarbij blijf je ook als het uitdagend wordt rustig, duidelijk en gericht op wat wél mogelijk is.

Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je beschikt over hbo werk- en denkniveau;

  • Je hebt een afgeronde management- en/of coachopleiding op hbo-niveau;

  • Je hebt bij voorkeur minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare leidinggevende functie;

  • Je hebt kennis van relevante zorgwetgeving en kwaliteitsbeleid;

  • Je hebt ervaring met veranderprocessen;

  • Je bent bekend met methodieken zoals oplossingsgericht werken, systeemdenken en/of Agile-Lean.

Enthousiast geworden, maar heb je nog vragen?

Heb je vragen over de vacature of de procedure? Bel of app met één van onze collega's:

  • Driebergen en Soest: Niek de Geest – 06 13 36 34 79

Title: Manager, Gas Markets

Location: Preferably in or around the Reston, VA area; however, open to remote candidates.

About the role


ICF is seeking a North American Natural Gas Markets subject matter expert (SME) and Manager to join the North American Natural Gas Markets team within the Energy Digital Infrastructure and Investment Line of Business. This role is for a hands-on natural gas market consultant and modeler who can connect rigorous quantitative analysis with clear, decision-ready advice for public- and private-sector clients.


The Manager will contribute directly to ICF’s quarterly North American Natural Gas Base Case long-term outlook and consulting engagements using ICF’s proprietary Gas Market Model (GMM) which is similar to the Gas Pipeline Competition Model (GPCM). Prior experience with GPCM is preferred. The successful candidate must bring strong regional experience with North American natural gas markets and understanding of market dynamics so they learn GMM quickly.


This is a balanced technical and client-facing role. The Manager will independently lead projects or major workstreams, guide analysts, communicate findings to clients, and collaborate with ICF colleagues across natural gas, power, economics, utilities, and investment advisory services.


Key responsibilities

  • Serve as a gas regional market expert and hands-on natural gas market modeler, developing assumptions and scenarios and translating model results into insights on prices, basis, supply, demand, pipeline flows, capacity utilization, storage, and infrastructure needs.
  • Learn and apply ICF’s proprietary GMM to run, maintain, calibrate, troubleshoot, document, and quality-check North American natural gas market forecasts; contribute to model and workflow improvements.
  • Lead a group of analysts that run and maintain GMM.
  • Support production of ICF’s quarterly North American Natural Gas Base Case and related subscription products.
  • Analyze North American natural gas fundamentals across production basins and demand sectors, including residential and commercial load, industrial demand, power generation, LNG exports, pipeline exports, and storage activity.
  • Evaluate pipeline and storage infrastructure, transportation constraints, regional basis formation, project timing, market need, utilization, reliability, and the effects of expansions or other market changes.
  • Lead or manage consulting workstreams involving market outlooks, scenario and risk analysis, pipeline and storage assessments, gas utility planning and supply portfolios, asset valuation and due diligence, regulatory and policy analysis, LNG, and gas-to-power or large-load development.
  • Design analytical approaches, manage schedules and budgets for assigned work, coordinate contributors, identify risks early, and deliver accurate reports, presentations, and quantitative models.
  • Present methods, results, uncertainties, and strategic implications clearly to clients and internal stakeholders; respond to technical questions with sound market judgment.
  • Mentor analysts and consultants through structured review, coaching, and knowledge transfer while remaining directly engaged in the technical work.
  • Collaborate across ICF to integrate natural gas analysis with power-market modeling, infrastructure advisory, economics, regulatory, and other related capabilities.
  • Contribute to proposals, scopes of work, client discussions, and thought leadership by helping shape technically sound approaches and communicating ICF’s capabilities.

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in economics, engineering, energy, statistics, mathematics, data science, public policy, finance, or a related quantitative field.
  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience inNorth American natural gas fundamentals and market analysis, energy consulting, market research, a utility or a pipeline/midstream company, an upstream company, trading or commercial analytics, government, or a related field
  • Demonstrated experience using a natural gas market model or comparable quantitative market-forecasting framework to evaluate supply, demand, transportation, storage, prices, basis, or infrastructure scenarios.
  • Experience managing analytical projects or substantial workstreams, including defining tasks, coordinating contributors, monitoring budget and schedule, reviewing work, and delivering client-ready outputs.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and demonstrated ability to work with large, complex datasets; proficiency in AI tools.

Preferred qualifications

  • Master’s degree in a relevant quantitative, energy, economics, engineering, policy, or business discipline.
  • Experience with nodal or network-based natural gas market modeling such as GPCM, supply-demand equilibrium modeling, production economics, pipeline flow and capacity analysis, or basis forecasting.
  • Experience calibrating models to historical data, conducting backcasts, validating outputs, documenting assumptions, and implementing repeatable model QA/QC processes.
  • Experience with one or more of the following: pipeline expansion and market-need studies; utility gas supply and integrated resource planning; storage valuation or optimization; midstream asset valuation; LNG market analysis; power-gas coordination; regulatory proceedings; or large-load/data-center gas supply assessments.
  • Working knowledge of Python, R, SQL, VBA, statistical software, databases, data visualization, automated analytical workflows, Claude, and other AI tools.
  • Experience supporting proposals, client development, presentations, publications, or other market-facing activities.
  • Ability to learn a proprietary modeling platform quickly and become proficient in running, maintaining, troubleshooting, interpreting, and quality-checking GMM.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical methods and results to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and ability to work independently in a collaborative consulting environment.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

jobs.description:
Precision for Medicine is looking for a Site Contracts and Budget Manager to join our European Team. The position can be fully remote from Poland, Slovakia, Serbia, Romania, or Hungary.

Position Summary:

The primary focus of this role is global clinical trial budget template development. You will be responsible for translating complex clinical trial protocols and study documentation into accurate, comprehensive, and negotiation-ready global/site budget templates across multiple countries. Demonstrated hands-on experience developing investigator/site budget templates for global, sponsor- or CRO-managed clinical trials is required.

The role will also include reviewing, drafting, negotiation and tracking of a variety of legal agreements including confidentiality agreements, master confidentiality agreements, clinical study agreements and amendment agreements. You will work closely with Clinical Operations study team and play a key role to ensure deliverables are in alignment with defined study timelines.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:
Global Clinical Trial Budget Template Development – Primary Responsibility:
  • Review clinical trial protocols, including amendments, SoAs, manuals, and other study documentation to identify all activities with potential site-level cost implications.
  • Translate protocol requirements into detailed, accurate, and scalable global/site budget templates.
  • Map procedures and activities to applicable study visits and payment milestones.
  • Develop per-patient, per-visit, conditional, invoiceable, and one-time study costs.
  • Identify costs that may not be apparent from the SoA, including site start-up, pharmacy, laboratory, imaging, record retention/archiving, maintenance, close-out, screen failures, unscheduled visits, participant reimbursement/travel, institutional/overhead, and other pass-through or invoiceable fees.
  • Ensure budget structures support appropriate payment terms and CTA exhibits.
  • Incorporate approved country-specific cost information and available benchmarks into global and country-level budget templates.
  • Establish proposed negotiation targets, parameters, and escalation pathways.
  • Perform detailed QC of budget templates before release to assigned SCM negotiators, including verification of formulas, visit totals, conditional procedures, invoiceable items, and patient-cost calculations.
  • Confirm consistency between protocol/SoA requirements and completed budgets and clearly document budget assumptions and negotiation parameters.
  • Maintain version control and an auditable record of budget-development decisions.
  • Review protocol amendments and revised study documents to identify financial impact and update master/site budget templates accordingly.
  • Clearly identify added, removed, or modified procedures and associated financial impacts for SCM.
  • Serve as a budget-development SME for SCM and study teams and clarify budget assumptions and unusual protocol requirements.
  • Support continuous improvement and standardization of global budget templates, tools, SOPs, work instructions, and training.
  • Identify opportunities for automation and increased efficiency in clinical trial budget development.

Site Contracts – Secondary Responsibility

  • Review, draft and negotiate a variety of agreements including master services agreements, site contracts, consulting agreements, vendor agreements, confidentiality agreements, and other client contracts.
  • Work with supervisor and various internal/external key stakeholders to resolve/escalate contractual issues.
  • Ensure adherence to company policies, procedures and contracting standards.
  • Update relevant study team members regarding the status of contract negotiations and execution.
  • Establish, track, report and manage site contract metrics.
  • Support the maintenance of contract files and databases, including contract archiving.
  • Assist in designing and implementing policies and procedures to affect the timely execution of contracts.
  • Recognize where processes can be improved and take corrective action.
  • Other tasks as assigned.

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • Graduate, postgraduate, or 4-year college degree.
  • Experience in a CRO, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare environment.
  • At least 5 years of relevant clinical research experience, including substantial hands-on experience developing investigator/site budget templates.
  • Demonstrated experience developing global and/or multi-country clinical trial budget templates for sponsor- or CRO-managed studies is required.
  • Strong ability to interpret complex protocols, SoAs, amendments, and supporting study documents and translate requirements into complete site-level costs.
  • Experience using country-specific cost information and/or benchmarking data to develop budget assumptions and negotiation parameters.
  • Knowledge of CTA budget exhibits, clinical trial payment terms, and site budget negotiation processes.
  • Relevant experience in drafting, reviewing and negotiating site Clinical Trial Agreements, Vendor Contracts and Site Budget negotiations.
  • Experience leading interactions with Study Teams and Sponsors.
  • Experience with oncology and/or other complex clinical trial protocols.

Preferred:

  • Bachelors in scientific fields, business administration or equivalent degree
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills and attention to detail
  • Successful handling relationship study team and/or with CRAs/Start-up Associate/(S)BSCA to meet study timelines.

Skills and Competencies:

  • Possesses strong organizational/written communication skills and the ability to multi-task and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.
  • Executes time-sensitive matters while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Exhibits high self-motivation and is able to work and plan independently as well as in a team environment.
  • Demonstrates a high degree of professionalism, as evidenced by punctuality, ability to deliver on commitments, an understanding of the service culture and positive interactions with customers and teammates, including good interpersonal skills.
  • Displays sound business judgment and a proactive, independent work style.
  • Proficient in MS Office software programs and computer applications
  • Handles sensitive issues with discretion.
  • Works well independently and cooperatively with others to achieve common goals in a virtual environment.
  • Develops, maintains, and strengthens relationships with others inside or outside of the organization who can provide information, assistance, and support.

jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Manager, Talent Brand and Social Impact, you will be tasked with shaping how the world experiences SentinelOne as an employer while helping bring our commitment to community impact to life. Reporting to the Vice President, Internal Communications and Talent Brand, you will lead creative storytelling, employer reputation programs, and social impact initiatives that showcase our people, culture, and purpose. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, requiring an exceptional storyteller, creative problem-solver, and collaborative partner who can turn ideas into compelling experiences and measurable results.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Develop and execute a global talent brand strategy that strengthens SentinelOne's reputation as an employer of choice, brings our employee value proposition to life, and supports our ability to attract and engage exceptional talent.
  • Lead our Great Place To Work certification and workplace recognition programs, managing award strategy, submissions, timelines, stakeholder coordination, and opportunities to amplify recognition across internal and external channels.
  • Own the editorial strategy and execution of the Life@S1 blog, identifying and developing authentic employee stories that showcase our culture, career opportunities, values, and global community.
  • Support the strategy and day-to-day management of the S Foundation, including grant cycles, application and review processes, nonprofit partnerships, program coordination, and communications that demonstrate the impact of our community investments; coordinate CyberSafe University initiatives and partner with Employee Engagement on S1 Cares to promote employee volunteerism, community engagement, and social impact opportunities, collaborating with internal teams and external organizations to strengthen participation, amplify program visibility, and showcase our commitment to giving back.
  • Serve as a liaison for student engagement initiatives, coordinating relationships with educational institutions, student organizations, and internal partners to support early-career awareness, community engagement, and emerging talent programs.
  • Partner with Corporate Marketing, Social Media, Talent Acquisition, and internal stakeholders to develop compelling talent brand and social impact content across LinkedIn, Instagram, and other relevant channels, coordinating campaigns and content calendars to maximize reach, engagement, and consistency; create engaging recruitment marketing materials, presentations, digital assets, and candidate-facing experiences that communicate what makes SentinelOne a compelling place to build a career.
  • Manage and optimize our employer presence on Glassdoor and Indeed, including employer profiles, reputation management, content updates, employee review insights, and opportunities to strengthen candidate perception.
  • Create polished, executive-ready presentations, visual narratives, and creative assets that translate complex ideas into clear, engaging stories for talent brand campaigns, social impact programs, and leadership audiences.
  • Apply AI tools thoughtfully to strengthen content creation, research, storytelling, campaign planning, analytics, and workflow efficiency, identifying opportunities to use AI to improve the quality, speed, personalization, and impact of talent brand and social impact initiatives.
  • Partner with Internal Communications, People Team leaders, Talent Acquisition, Marketing, and other stakeholders to amplify employee experiences, culture, recognition, and community impact through coordinated storytelling and communications; manage multiple initiatives, creative workflows, agency relationships, budgets, and deadlines while using data, feedback, and performance insights to continuously improve program effectiveness and business impact.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 10 or more years of experience in talent brand, employer branding, communications, content marketing, social impact, or related fields, with demonstrated success developing and executing high-impact programs.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex ideas into compelling, authentic content that connects with diverse audiences; strong visual storytelling and presentation design capabilities, including hands-on experience developing polished, executive-ready slide decks and creative presentations that communicate clearly and inspire action.
  • Demonstrated AI fluency, including practical experience using generative AI tools to accelerate content development, improve workflows, generate insights, and enhance creative and operational outcomes.
  • Experience developing and executing employer brand strategies across digital, social, and candidate-facing channels, with an understanding of how to strengthen employer reputation and attract talent; experience managing employer recognition programs, workplace award submissions, or similar initiatives requiring cross-functional coordination, compelling storytelling, and attention to detail.
  • Experience supporting corporate social responsibility, employee giving, nonprofit partnerships, grants, or community impact programs, with the ability to manage programs thoughtfully and measure results.
  • Strong digital content creation skills, including experience with presentation software, visual design tools, social media platforms, and content management systems; familiarity with employer reputation platforms such as Glassdoor and Indeed, including profile management, content optimization, and performance analysis.
  • Excellent project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate stakeholders, meet deadlines, and deliver consistently high-quality work; experience managing program budgets, tracking expenditures, forecasting costs, and allocating resources effectively to maximize impact and ensure financial accountability.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data, engagement metrics, and audience insights to inform strategy, evaluate performance, and improve outcomes.
  • A collaborative, relationship-driven approach, with the confidence to partner across functions and levels, including senior executives, creative teams, external agencies, nonprofit organizations, and employee communities; a growth mindset, intellectual curiosity, and a willingness to experiment with new technologies, creative approaches, and ways of working.
  • High emotional intelligence, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to navigate sensitive topics with empathy, professionalism, and discretion, along with a strong connection to SentinelOne's values of Trust, Accountability, OneSentinel, Relentlessness, Ingenuity, and Community.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

Supply Chain Finance Manager

Our client is seeking a Supply Chain Finance Manager to serve as a key business partner and influence decision-making across the end-to-end supply chain. In this highly visible role, you will partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, Commercial, and Accounting leaders to translate financial and operational data into actionable insights that improve profitability, working capital, and overall business performance.

Our client's office is located in New York City. Candidates based in the New York City area are expected to work on a hybrid schedule, while candidates outside the area may work remotely.

What You Will Do

  • Lead financial analysis and reporting across manufacturing, inventory, warehousing, and logistics.
  • Support annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and long-range planning, and explain the drivers behind performance.
  • Deliver clear variance analysis against budget, forecast, and prior-year results, with practical recommendations.
  • Oversee standard costing and analyze labor, overhead, yield, production, and other manufacturing variances.
  • Partner with Operations and Procurement to identify cost savings, productivity improvements, and improve manufacturing efficiency.
  • Monitor inventory aging, obsolescence, valuation, and working capital, and improve visibility through effective reporting tools.
  • Support cycle counts, inventory reconciliations, and month-end inventory close activities.
  • Build models that evaluate product, customer, channel, category, and SKU profitability.
  • Support pricing decisions, new product launches, promotions, commercial terms, and business cases.
  • Participate in S&OP and IBP processes, assessing the financial impact of demand, supply, production, inventory, and service-level decisions.
  • Prepare management reporting that translates complex data into clear business insights and recommendations.
  • Strengthen financial controls, data quality, reporting processes, and analytical capabilities across the organization.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • At least five years of progressive experience in supply chain finance, manufacturing finance, cost accounting, FP&A, or a related area.
  • Hands-on experience with standard costing, inventory accounting, production variance analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling.
  • Experience in consumer products, manufacturing, food, beverage, or a related industry is strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of US GAAP; IFRS knowledge is a plus.
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience analyzing large data sets.
  • Experience with an ERP system such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, SAP, NetSuite, Oracle, or a comparable platform.
  • Power BI or other business intelligence experience is preferred.
  • Strong communication and business-partnering skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Credentials

  • An MBA, CPA, CMA, or another relevant advanced qualification is a plus.

Compensation

The budgeted base salary for this position is $120,000, plus eligibility for an annual bonus. The final compensation package will be determined by the company based on the selected candidate's skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

  • Incident Management & Escalation: PagerDuty, Jira, ServiceNow

  • Advanced monitoring expertise: In-depth experience designing alert thresholds and monitoring complex distributed environments (cloud micro-services, networks, APIs, schedulers).
